About the Department
The Department of Computer Applications at SRM Institute of Science and Technology has always been on the top as the paradigm of quality with the most modern curriculum and syllabus. Ever since its inception in 2006, the department has attained unprecedented heights and stands on par excellence among its counterparts in Tamil Nadu and India. The Department has proven its academic prowess and success with an extensive range of courses offered both at the Undergraduate and Postgraduate levels. The Department offers
BCA
BCA Data Science
at the UG level, and
MCA
M.Sc Applied Data Science
at the PG level.
Consistently ranked among the top Computer Applications programs in India, the Computer Applications Department at SRM offers a flexible curriculum designed to allow students to explore their own interests in increasing depth. The curriculum is revamped to suit the industry needs with an emphasis on theory and application that demarcates SRM Computer Applications from most colleges.

Welcome message
The Department of Computer Applications is dedicated for ensuring great careers for students joined for pursuing Undergraduate or Postgraduate. The excellent infrastructure, teaching faculty of the best kind of the Department ensuring quality education such as interaction among students, parents, and staff, along with a Training and Placement Cell ensures a bright future to its students. We strongly encourage innovation in research, in teaching, and in service to the profession, the local community, and industry. Our faculty and students are constantly striving to excel and to advance the state of the art in Computer Applications.
The primary focus of our curriculum is to impart technical knowledge, promote problem solving skills, and innovation of new technologies. The department offers a wide variety of elective courses for providing wide spectrum of options to the students to pursue their interests. The course contents are periodically updated for introducing new scientific and technological developments.  Undergraduate and Postgraduate students are encouraged to undertake various research projects.
We provide ample opportunities to learn more about Computer Applications as a student; we love to share our passion with every student. Learn how to not only use computational tools but how to work in teams, share ideas, present, communicate in short, join creative teams that make a positive difference.
We believe that our approach to teaching-learning, coupled with practical experience gained during Industrial Training in reputed organizations, equips our students to handle the challenges posed by the software industry.
We look forward to continue to offer our students a greater learning experience in the field of Computer Applications and welcome prospective students to join us and become ambassadors of Computer Applications.
Programs Offered
BCA
The Department of Computer Applications offers undergraduate programmes based on world-class syllabus. The curriculum helps students to explore the field of Computer applications and Data Science. It also helps students to identify their skills and enhance their knowledge with creativity. The Computer Applications program focuses on the development of software and applications, computer programming, database management, and web development.
MCA & M.Sc
The Department of Computer Applications offers postgraduate programmes including core courses as well as elective independent study. It provides latitude for the students to explore the new technology. The syllabus is designed with the metrics of research as it helps students to enhance themselves with the knowledge of incorporating methodology, exploration, and interpretation in the field of research.
PhD
The PhD program in the Department of Computer Applications has been specially designed to cater to the scholarly needs. The department gives privilege to the research scholars to do their research in their respective domains.  The research supervisors empower the research scholars to do authentic research work. The institution supports the research endeavors of faculty and students by providing incentives for publications and patents.
Placements
The Computer Applications Department, in collaboration with the Placement and Career Center at SRMIST, is committed to facilitating suitable opportunities in the IT industry for eligible students, enabling them to demonstrate their abilities and talents effectively. Additionally, within the department, a faculty member serves as the placement coordinator, responsible for bridging communication between the Placement and Career Center and students, as well as offering mentorship and guidance to help students navigate their career paths effectively.

About the Department
Excellence of Chemistry @SRMIST in Ranking #251-300 in the world in QS World University Ranking – 2026.
SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University)’s Chemistry Department has been engaged in opening up the fascinating world of Chemistry to students since 1985. The Department offers B.Sc., B.S(4 Year), M.Sc. and Ph.D Programmes. The primary goal of the department is to advance the field of chemistry and to carry out use-inspired research in the emerging areas of energy, environment, sustainable chemistry and health.
Department of Chemistry has a group of vibrant, talented and passionate faculty members whose areas of expertise cover a broad spectrum of topics: Energy and Materials science, Synthetic chemistry, Chemical biology, Physical chemistry and Computation. The Department has well-equipped modern research laboratories with state-of-the-art facilities like High Performance Computing System, HR-MS, Powder X-ray diffractometer, Thermo Gravimetric Analyzer, Differential Scanning Calorimeter, BET surface area analyzer, Time-resolved photoluminescence setup etc.
The Department was supported by DST-FIST, Govt. of India with a total outlay of Rs. 146 lakhs during 2015-2020. Faculty members are awarded DST-SERB Fast Track / SRG / CRG / CSIR / UGC – Startup / Indo-Poland projects with a total outlay of Rs.30 crores. The Department has tie-ups with recognized institutions, industries and R&D laboratories for student projects, training and research activities. Faculty members of our department have been publishing research articles in various peer-reviewed journals of Nature Publishing, American Chemical Society, Royal Society of Chemistry, Elsevier, and Wiley etc.”

About the Department
The Department of Physics and Nanotechnology (Supported by DST-FIST, Govt. of India) strives to provide a broad spectrum of fundamental knowledge and expertise that has worldwide significance in the fields of Physics and Nanotechnology. This serves as the foundation for interdisciplinary research, applied research, national and international collaborations.
The Department offers rigorous training in Physics and Nanotechnology at Undergraduate, Post Graduate and Doctoral levels with highly qualified team of faculty members having several years of post-doctoral experience from leading international and national institutions. Our students are exposed to an innovative, dynamic and challenging environment through a combination of research-based teaching, project work, high degree of interaction with industry and state-of-the-art laboratory facilities holding modern equipment and computational tools.
Our faculty members have received sponsored research projects with a total outlay of 38.82 crores from various funding agencies such as DST-FIST, DST-SERB, DST-NANOMISSION, BRNS, MNRE, ISRO ARFI, ISRO RESPOND, US ONRG, MoES and AOARD to carryout cutting edge research in the areas of Materials Science and Engineering, Nanotechnology, Energy, Environmental Science, Condensed Matter Physics, Optics and Photonics, Particle Physics and Atmospheric Science. Faculty members of our department have been publishing research articles in various peer reviewed journals of American Physical Society, Nature Publishing, American Institute of Physics, Institute of Physics (UK) American Chemical Society, Elsevier, and Wiley, etc.

About the Department
Excellence of Mathematics @SRMIST in QS World University Ranking # 401-450 (2026)
The Department of Mathematics at SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST) stands as one of the most distinguished and enduring pillars of the institution. Founded in
1985
, it is among the oldest and most foundational departments of SRMIST.
Over four decades, it has grown into an internationally recognised centre of excellence in mathematical education and research. The department is proud to be ranked in the QS World University Rankings 2026 (Mathematics) –
401-450 band
, placing it among an elite group of mathematics departments worldwide and 6th among private institutions in India.
At the heart of this department is an exceptional team of
141+
faculty members, every one of whom holds a doctoral degree — a benchmark that reflects the department’s uncompromising commitment to scholarly depth and intellectual rigour. Many among them bring with them postdoctoral research experience from some of the world’s most prestigious institutions, enriching the department with global perspectives and research sophistication.
The department is further distinguished by the guidance of eminent adjunct professors who represent the finest in Indian academia: Prof. Peeyush Chandra — IIT Kanpur, Prof. Mohan K. Kadalbajoo — IIT Kanpur, Prof. Debabrata Datta — BARC, Mumbai, Prof. S. Ponnusamy — IIT Madras, Prof. N. Sukavanam — IIT Roorkee, Prof. Neeraj Misra (HAG) — IIT Kanpur. Their involvement brings an extraordinary dimension of mentorship, academic leadership, and research vision to the department’s programmes and initiatives.
Research is given equal importance alongside teaching. With
105+
recognised research supervisors and
11+
active research groups, the department fosters a vibrant scholarly culture. Regular research colloquia promote meaningful interaction between experts, faculty, and students — keeping the intellectual environment dynamic and forward-looking. In recent years, the department has secured research funding of over
3 crores
from prestigious agencies such as DST, ANRF, MoES, NBHM, BRNS, and SRMIST, reflecting its strong research culture and commitment to innovation. There is a dedicated focus on ensuring funding is in place so that research projects and studies progress satisfactorily. The Department offers financial support for attending conferences and workshops, promotes high-quality research output, and recognizes excellence through research incentives.

About the Department
The department of Data Science and Business Systems (DSBS) started in 2021 with the pivotal objective of evolving students to acquire information and knowledge by acquainting technical expertise and skills, thus transforming them into entrepreneurs and product developers pertaining to the field of Data Science and Business analytics. Leveraging the ever-growing business data, the department ensures that the students acquire sound fundamentals in theory and project based learning experience in various data science related tools and technologies. Augmenting to this the department is strongly committed to impart sound domain knowledge in mathematics, business system and engineering sciences.
Every business is driven by data in today’s evolving technological world. The department ensures the students have strong fundamentals in theory, project experience in various data science related tools and technologies, and domain knowledge in mathematics, business system and engineering science.

Welcome message
It is my pleasure to welcome you to the Department of Aerospace Engineering of SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Kattankulathur, one of the renowned institutions in India and abroad. The Institution promotes various aspects such as teaching, research, co-curricular activities, and several extra-curricular activities to kindle the young minds and thereby shape the future of the nation. With positive thoughts and an optimistic mind, I take an opportunity to lead the department in various academic and research activities. I am delighted to have a team of dedicated faculties who are ready to take up future challenges. We have a good alumni network to provide mentorship to our upcoming budding engineers. The department is also taking various initiatives to build a strong relationship with reputed aerospace industries. I welcome you all to our website, which will be informative to students, industry people, and visitors.
Programs Offered
Undergraduate
The undergraduate program imparts students with mastery in the field of Aerospace Engineering.
Postgraduate
The Postgraduate program imparts students with mastery in the field of Aerospace Engineering.
Research
The department offers doctoral programs in various areas of aerospace engineering.
Research
The Department of Aerospace Engineering focuses on a variety of Research areas that includes Aerospace and general applications. We have a good number of faculty members with extensive research experience from nationally and internationally reputed labs/institutions. We also have three Research Track faculty members focussing on fundamental and applied research. Our research areas are grouped into major domains like Aerodynamics, Structural Mechanics, Propulsion, and other topics like Flight Dynamics, Space Mechanics, and various interdisciplinary areas.
The Aerodynamics Domain focuses on areas like Airplane/Airfoil Aerodynamics, Unsteady Aerodynamics, Aerodynamics of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), Bio-Inspired Aerodynamics Optimization and Theoretical / Experimental / Computational Aerodynamics, under incompressible aerodynamics. Applied research on Aerodynamics focuses on Automotive Aerodynamics, Wind Turbine Aerodynamics, Heat Transfer Enhancement Techniques, Flow Control Techniques and Wind Assisted Ship Propulsion. In compressible aerodynamics, we focus on Supersonic Flow Measurements and Visualizations by using Pitot-tube with Pressure Scanner, Schlieren and Shadowgraphy. Jet flow research is one of the most sought topics by research scholars/students and our in-house developed jet facility aids research topics like studies on High-Speed Jets, Jet Flow Control, Multi-stream Coaxial Jets and Jet Flow Aeroacoustics. On the very high-speed regime, we focus on Re-entry Aerodynamics, Hypersonic Aerothermodynamics of Space vehicles, Rarefied Gas Dynamics simulations using Direct Simulation Monte Carlo (DSMC). Fundamental studies on Multiphase flows are also carried out via experiments (by using High Speed Camera Visualizations) and Computational Fluid Dynamics (ANSYS Fluent and OpenFOAM®). The topics include studies on bubble and droplet dynamics with/without phase change (Evaporation, Boiling and Condensation).
The Structural Mechanics Domain focuses on areas like Aircraft/Aerospace Structural Mechanics, Composite Structures and Vibrations. Research areas in Vibrations include Random Vibrations, Vibration analysis of passive and active landing gears, Stability Analysis and Controllers via Matlab Simulink and Ansys. The studies on composite structures include Tapered and Curved Laminates, Sandwich Structures, Hybrid Laminates and Multi-scale Laminated Composites. The advanced studies on composite structures include high strain rate characterization and impact mechanics using advanced techniques like the Digital Image Correlation (DIC). The other research areas like recycling of Fibre Reinforced Polymer composites, repair on laminated composites and structural health monitoring focuses on the maintenance of Aircraft/Aerospace Structures. Emerging topics like Aircraft System Design via Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning are also considered.
The Propulsion Domain focuses on Propulsion, Combustion and Thermal Sciences. The specific interests are in the areas of Aircraft and Rocket Propulsion like performance characterization of Solid, Liquid and Hybrid Propellants. Advanced techniques like electric propulsion are also being studied extensively. Experimental and computational methods are involved to study various propulsion and combustion phenomena. Reacting Flows, Combustion, Heat Transfer and Turbomachinary are other research areas considered for research. Flame Dynamics, Thermo acoustics and Fire Dynamics in Normal and Microgravity are advanced topics researched presently.
The Flight Dynamics topics include Flapping Wing mechanisms and performance, UAV Flight Dynamics and performance of Aerial Robots/Drones. The space mission related research focuses on Spacecraft Dynamics like Attitude Control and Trajectory Optimization. The general space research includes topics like Space Debris Mitigation, Spacecraft Collision Avoidance System, Deep Space Exploration and Autonomous automation. The interdisciplinary research areas include Fluid Structure Interaction, Aero-elasticity, Flame Dynamics studies with Non-linear Dynamics and usage of statistical tools in various aerospace domains.

About the Department
The department of Mechatronics Engineering at SRM Institute of Science and Technology was started in the year 2005, the first of its kind in a private university in India, with a vision to impart multidisciplinary skills and knowledge to the students, which is a most sought skill at present. The advancement of Robotics, automation, and Industry 4.0 has increased the demand and reach of mechatronics engineering. The department offers multiple programs with key emphasis on experiential learning.
The department is known for its state-of-the-art facilities and multi-domain faculties, making the program unique in our university. The department, apart from the regular program, is engaged in many other activities such as industrial consultancy, industrial training, academic and industry-collaborated research, organizing workshops, seminars and conferences. The department has four main academic laboratories equipped with modern industrial standard items such as industrial collaborative robot arm, autonomous mobile robots, mixed signal oscilloscopes, advanced control plants, advanced pneumatics systems, programmable logic controllers, embedded controllers, real-time controllers, machine vision systems, high precision test and measurement equipment.
The laboratories also host a number of engineering software for design, analysis and simulation of mechatronics systems. Faculty members from different domains of engineering with many specialized in mechatronics engineering becomes one of the unique strengths of our department. With more than a decade of existence, our alumni are working around the globe in reputed companies/institutions, which further adds feathers to our success.

About the Department
The Department of Chemical Engineering was established in 1995 as a part of SRM Engineering College. Initially, it offered a B.Tech. Chemical Engineering program. Later on, from the academic year 2002 – 2003, it began offering an M.Tech. Chemical Engineering program. The department started functioning under SRM Institute of Science and Technology (Deemed to be University) from the academic year 2003 – 2004. The doctoral (PhD) program in Chemical Engineering was introduced in the year 2004. The department is equipped with highly qualified faculty members who hold a PhD degree from reputed institutes such as IIT, IISc, BARC, and foreign universities. Faculty members have extensive experience in renowned academic institutes and industries and maintain close interactions with institutes like IIT Madras, NIOT Chennai, NIT Trichy, IGCAR Kalpakkam, and several private industries. Our department has a two-pronged approach to research. Firstly, we concentrate on research initiatives that have a positive impact on society. Secondly, we work with industrial partners to solve their problems and develop useful products. Students have graduated and gone on to pursue higher studies in some of the most prestigious institutes in the world, such as MIT, NUS, and the University of Texas. The students who joined the department have access to various job opportunities in a range of industries such as refineries, fertilizer, pharmaceuticals, energy, and IT-enabled sectors. The department regularly updates its curriculum to keep up with advancements in multiple disciplines such as process automation and immersive technologies. This ensures that students are equipped with the latest software tools and sophisticated instrumentation, integrating core chemical engineering concepts. As a result, they are well-prepared for the highly promising career prospects in this field.

Welcome message
On behalf of the faculty, staff, research scholars, and students, I warmly welcome you to the Department of Chemical Engineering at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Kattankulathur. As a Silver Jubilee department, we take pride in our rich legacy and the achievements of 26 batches of B.Tech. and 21 batches of M.Tech. graduates.
Choosing to study chemical engineering with us comes with numerous advantages: an industry-relevant curriculum, value-added training, research opportunities, and a strong placement record. Our department boasts modern infrastructure to enhance the learning experience, including well-equipped laboratories, advanced classrooms, and interdisciplinary research facilities. Our distinguished faculty, drawn from renowned institutes both in India and abroad, bring with them extensive teaching, research, and industry experience to provide personalized mentorship throughout the learning process.
Chemical engineers play a crucial role in shaping the modern world. Some of their key contributions span across sectors like sustainable development, healthcare innovation, energy solutions, materials development, environmental protection, and food production and safety. The challenges faced by chemical engineers are often global in scope, necessitating collaboration across borders. They work in multidisciplinary teams to address pressing issues such as climate change, resource scarcity, and public health.
By choosing to study here, you’re not just pursuing a degree; you’re embarking on a journey of discovery and innovation. Explore our website for more information on admission requirements and the exciting opportunities awaiting you.
Thank you for your interest, and we look forward to welcoming you to our vibrant community!

The undergraduate program imparts students with mastery in the field of chemical engineering.
Postgraduate

The department of Chemical Engineering offers research in thrust area of Environmental Engineering, Bio Chemical Engineering, Separation Purification Technology, Membrane science and Technology, Chemical Process Design, Modelling & Simulation.
Placement
Chemical engineering offers diverse career options in various areas, including chemical processing, environmental management, food and beverage manufacture, minerals and mining, oil and gas refining, petrochemicals, and pharmaceuticals. Freshly graduated Chemical Engineers can look at job prospects in these sectors and industries. Apart from being part of traditional industries such as the petroleum industry and bulk chemical production, chemical engineering is also fast becoming part of new and upcoming fields such as machine learning, process optimization, information technology, alternative energy, and pollution control technology. Their contribution is vital in industrial processes across a broad spectrum, from manufacturing fibers, paints, fabrics, medical drugs, biomaterials, gasoline, and lubricants, among others necessary for the sector’s proper functioning.
They have vast opportunities as a beginner in government and privately-owned organizations alike. Chemical Engineers can also pursue research careers in R & D units, design companies, and technical institutes/universities. They can also join post-graduate programs in Indian or foreign universities of repute after clearing examinations and start promising careers after that.

About the Department
The Department of Biotechnology incepted in 2003 comprises qualified and competent faculty, both full-time and visiting, with national and international experience in diverse fields of biosciences and bioengineering. The B.Tech., and M.Tech., programmes have been accredited by the NBA for a period of six years (2021–2027) and three years (2025–2028) respectively. Due to persistent improvement, the department could maintain the UG and PG student enrolment above 95%.
Semester Abroad Programme (SAP) offers students the opportunity to spend one semester abroad at prestigious universities (Harvard Medical School, USA, Lehigh University, USA, Uppsala University, Sweden, and Tzu-Chi University, Taiwan) around the globe, where they will learn to do advanced research. So far, >100 students have benefited from SAP. Research is the major thrust of our department, with diversified domains such as Medical Biotechnology, Marine and Animal Biotechnology, Plant Biotechnology, Environmental Biotechnology and Bioprocess Engineering.
The department has been supported by DST-FIST and DBT, Government of India for research and skill development in advanced life science technologies. Furthermore, various funding agencies such as ICMR, ANRF, DST, DBT, MNRE, AICTE, International agencies such as EBP Inc., Japan, University of Switzerland, Unique Therapeutics Global, Czech Republic and few industries have financially supported our faculty members through sponsored projects with a total outlay of Rs. 741.61 Lakhs in last 3 years. There are 11 government funded research laboratories, 3 industry sponsored research facilities, and 8 academic labs with sophisticated infrastructure facilities.

About the Department
Biomedical Engineering at SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST) is one of the few programs in India offering B.Tech., M.Tech., and Ph.D. degrees in the discipline, with a legacy of over 20 years of excellence in teaching, research, and innovation. Biomedical Engineering is inherently interdisciplinary, bringing together engineers, clinicians, and life scientists to design and develop medical devices, healthcare technologies, and translational solutions that improve human health and quality of life.
Established in 2004, the Department of Biomedical Engineering at SRMIST was founded with a strong and active clinical partnership with SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre, enabling seamless integration of engineering innovation with real-world clinical needs. Since its inception, the department has consistently engaged in diverse research activities, high-quality teaching, and industry-oriented training, evolving into one of the leading biomedical engineering departments in the country.
The department is supported by state-of-the-art research laboratories spanning key domains such as Bioimaging, Biomaterials, Biomechanics, Biosignal Processing, and Medical Image Processing, providing students and researchers with hands-on exposure to advanced tools and technologies. To further strengthen industry engagement and translational research, students are actively encouraged to collaborate with industry through the Centre for Biomedical Research and Healthcare Innovation (CBRHI), an industry-associated initiative that fosters product development, innovation, and entrepreneurship.
A recent and significant addition to the department is the Centre for Analysis of Movements, Ergonomics Research and Animersion (CAMERA) — a first-of-its-kind multidisciplinary hub dedicated to advancing the science and application of human movement analysis, ergonomics, and immersive technologies. CAMERA integrates biomechanics, wearable sensing, motion capture, and extended reality (XR) platforms to address challenges in healthcare, rehabilitation, occupational ergonomics, and human–machine interaction.
The department also emphasizes global exposure and experiential learning. Through the Semester Abroad Program (SAP), students have undertaken coursework and research projects at leading international partner institutions such as Harvard University, Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Drexel University, and Lehigh University, among others.
Connecting a strong academic foundation with future aspirations, the department maintains robust industry linkages and an excellent placement ecosystem. Our recruiters include leading multinational and healthcare technology companies such as Capgemini, Siemens, Medtronic, GE Healthcare, Abbott, Johnson & Johnson, Amazon, Braun, Baxter, Stryker, BPL Medical Technologies, Boston Scientific, Meril, Biorad Medisys, LifeSigns, and Fisher & Paykel Healthcare. Alumni of the department are placed across top multinational corporations, biomedical industries, government and private hospitals, IT sectors, and premier research laboratories, reflecting the program’s academic rigor, industry relevance, and global outlook.

Welcome message
It gives me immense pleasure to extend a warm welcome to all of you on behalf of the Department of Biomedical Engineering, SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Kattankulathur campus. Our field stands at the exciting intersection of healthcare and technology, where every innovation has the potential to transform lives, improve health outcomes, and advance medical science.
Our department has always strived to be at the forefront of pioneering breakthroughs in biomedical technology, fostering an environment where science meets compassion. As biomedical engineers, we work to bridge the gap between medicine and engineering, creating solutions that improve the quality of life and reshape the future of healthcare.
Whether it’s cutting-edge medical devices, life-saving diagnostics, or advanced computational methods for healthcare, the development of next-generation medical devices, we are committed to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible to improve human health and well-being.
Our department thrives on the collective contributions of our faculty, researchers, and students, whose passion for advancing human health and well-being continues to inspire groundbreaking work. I am confident that our ongoing efforts will contribute not only to academic excellence but also to making a tangible difference in the world of healthcare.

Placements
There is a huge demand for energetic biomedical engineers in the healthcare industry. These engineers would be involved in designing and developing cutting edge technology in the healthcare domain. Graduates of BME have opportunities in Government and private companies for installation, maintenance, and design and development of new healthcare devices, assisting medical professionals in major surgeries, and being involved in new product development. They also help in the regulatory aspects of Medical devices.
Industry-Institute Collaboration Initiative:
As part of an industry-institute collaboration addressing the needs of the modern healthcare sector, the Department of Biomedical Engineering at SRMIST, in partnership with Capgemini India Ltd, has introduced two two-credit value-added courses: “Requirement Engineering and Medical Device Regulations” and “Verification and Validation of Medical Devices.” Students who enroll in these electives will receive preferential consideration during Capgemini’s recruitment process. Additionally, the department’s partnerships with Jajal Medical Services and Panacea Medical Technologies represent significant milestones, paving the way for advancements in research, development, and innovation within biomedical applications. EEE Association
The Electrical and Electronics Engineering Association (EEEA) was established in 2004 to foster a sense of community among students and faculty within the department. All the students and faculties in the department are the members of  EEEA. The association operates under the leadership of annually elected office bearers who oversee its activities and initiatives.
The primary objective of the EEEA is to cultivate the managerial and leadership skills of its members. To achieve this, the association organizes a variety of events throughout the academic year. These events, encompassing technical and non-technical domains, serve as platforms for students to develop and showcase their abilities. Technical events may include design competitions, hackathons, seminars, workshops, etc. Meanwhile, non-technical events could focus on tours, sports, cultures etc.
By participating in the activities organized by the EEEA, students will have the opportunity to gain practical experience in event planning, coordination, and execution. These experiences not only complement their academic studies but also contribute to their personal and professional growth. Additionally, the association plays a crucial role in promoting a sense of camaraderie and collaboration among members of the department, fostering a supportive environment for learning and development.

About the Department
The Department of Civil Engineering is one of the founding and well-established departments at SRMIST, Kattankulathur established in the year 1985. The department offers two undergraduate programs namely Civil Engineering and Civil Engineering with Computer Applications as well as five postgraduate programs in Structural Engineering, Construction Engineering Management, Geotechnical Engineering, Environmental Engineering and Remote Sensing and GIS. B.Tech. Civil Engineering program at Kattankulathur Campus is accredited by Engineering Accreditation Commission (EAC) of ABET (
www.abet.org
) and National Board of Accreditation (NBA). M. Tech Structural Engineering program at Kattankulathur Campus is accredited by National Board of Accreditation (NBA). Currently, the department supports more than a hundred research scholars pursuing research in areas such as modern construction materials, structural systems, soil-structure interactions, construction engineering and management, environmental studies, watershed and wetland management, transportation engineering, remote sensing and GIS applications. The department takes pride in its distinguished, seasoned, and committed teaching faculty, excelling in both teaching and research. They actively contribute to academic and research advancement by publishing research articles, providing top-notch technical advisory support through various R&D projects and consultancy services to a wide array of organizations, as well as publishing patents, books, and consistently presenting papers in international and national conferences. With twelve basic and advanced laboratories catering to academic and research needs, ten signed MoUs, Eighty Four patents Published, Thirty Eight granted, Fifteen completed/ongoing externally funded projects, and five current (international/national) student chapters, the department has established a strong foundation. Besides, the department possesses excellent infrastructure facilities that meet international standards, enabling us to produce high- calibre civil engineers. Our network of alumni extends worldwide, featuring distinguished individuals in prestigious administrative roles and leadership positions across industries, government sectors, and academic institutions. Welcome message
Welcome to the Department of Civil Engineering at SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST), Kattankulathur, Chennai, India.
Established in 1985, the Department of Civil Engineering at Kattankulathur is one of the pioneer departments of the Institute. The department has excelled across academics, research, cultural activities, and sports, building a reputation that meets global standards.
Our undergraduate program, B.Tech. in Civil Engineering, is accredited by ABET (EAC) and the NBA, while our postgraduate program, M.Tech. in Structural Engineering, is also NBA-accredited. Currently, the department offers two undergraduate programs: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering and B.Tech. in Civil Engineering with Computer Applications. At the postgraduate level, we offer M.Tech. programs in Structural Engineering, Construction Engineering and Management, Environmental Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, and Remote Sensing and GIS. In addition, our robust Ph.D. program in Civil Engineering ensures we keep pace with emerging fields. The flexible framework of these programs provides ample opportunities for students to train as academicians, industrialists, researchers, or entrepreneurs. Over the years, the department has produced eminent engineers who are committed to the highest professional standards.
We are proud of our eminent, experienced, and dedicated faculty members, whose teaching and research excellence yields high-quality publications and impactful consultancy work. The department boasts state-of-the-art infrastructure on par with international standards, enabling us to nurture high-calibre civil engineers. Notably, the National Technical Textiles Mission (NTTM), under the Ministry of Textiles (Govt. of India), awarded a ₹5.09 crore grant to our department. This grant enables the institute to develop cutting-edge academic infrastructure and pioneer research in technical textiles. Furthermore, the department houses twelve basic and advanced laboratories to cater to academic and research needs, complemented by active MoUs, patents, several externally funded projects, and vibrant national and international student chapters.
We bridge the gap between classroom learning and industry practice through immersive internships, field visits, and collaborative research. Guided by stakeholder feedback, we constantly evolve our curriculum to empower students to tackle pressing societal challenges. Furthermore, we leverage our robust, highly active alumni network to fuel this progress. By facilitating regular interactions with these seasoned industry experts, we provide our students with invaluable experiential learning and a distinct competitive advantage in the global market.
The department is a vibrant hub where students prepare for career excellence, advanced academia, and impactful leadership. We are dedicated to nurturing professionals who will actively shape the future of our industry, our nation, and the global community.
I am honoured to lead our exceptional faculty and students as we work together to shape the future of civil engineering and sustain our department’s long-standing excellence.

Undergraduate
The undergraduate programme in Civil Engineering provides a strong foundation in core civil engineering disciplines, emphasizing analytical skills, professional ethics, sustainability, and the application of engineering principles to meet societal and industry needs.
Postgraduate
The postgraduate programmes offer advanced and specialized education in key areas of Civil Engineering, focusing on higher-order analysis, modern engineering tools, research aptitude, and solution development for complex engineering problems.
Research
The Department offers a Ph.D. programme that promotes quality research and innovation in Civil Engineering and allied areas, fostering interdisciplinary research, sustainable infrastructure development, and industry–academia collaboration
Research
The department consists of a group of experienced and well-equipped faculties who have published numerous articles in the SCI and Scopus indexed journals and Indian and International patent applications in the emerging field of science and technology. Welcome message
Greetings from the Department of Mechanical Engineering, SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Kattankulathur. Established in 1985, ours is one of the oldest and most distinguished departments of the university, built on a proud legacy of academic excellence and innovation. With a team of 105 highly dedicated faculty members—most of whom hold doctoral degrees—the department combines rich teaching experience with strong research expertise. Our faculty’s commitment to research is underscored by a robust record of publications, patents, and collaborative projects with leading industries and research organizations.
The department is equipped with state-of-the-art infrastructure, including 35 academic laboratories, advanced software and hardware facilities, and specialized research centers and centre of excellence. These resources ensure that both curricular and research requirements are met with the highest standards. Recognizing the importance of industry–institute collaboration, we have established strong partnerships with prominent industries and research organizations.
We offer a comprehensive range of programs for undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral studies. The undergraduate programs include B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering, B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering with specialization in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, and B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering with specialization in Automation & Robotics. The post graduate programs include M.Tech. in Computer-Aided Design, Robotics, Solar Energy, and Thermal Engineering. For the PhD program, research opportunities are available across diverse domains of Mechanical Engineering.
The B.Tech. Mechanical Engineering program at the Kattankulathur campus is accredited by both the Engineering Accreditation Commission of ABET and the National Board of Accreditation (NBA), underscoring our commitment to global standards of quality. Over the years, our graduates have emerged as eminent engineers, upholding the highest professional standards in Engineering and Technology.
We provide our students with an enriching educational experience that blends intellectual rigor, interdisciplinary breadth, and hands-on learning in a student-centered environment. Course curricula are periodically updated under the guidance of industry experts to reflect the latest scientific and technological advancements. Students are encouraged to participate in cutting-edge research projects, pursue semester-abroad programs at leading international universities, and continue higher studies in premier institutions in India and abroad.
With strong industry demand, excellent placement opportunities, and a vibrant academic culture, the Department of Mechanical Engineering at SRMIST continues to stand tall and proud—shaping the engineers of tomorrow and contributing meaningfully to the society.

Undergraduate
The undergraduate program provides strong foundational and advanced knowledge in Mechanical Engineering. It equips students with practical skills to design, analyze, and innovate mechanical systems for diverse real-world applications.
Postgraduate
The postgraduate program offers advanced specialization in emerging domains of Mechanical Engineering. It prepares students for research excellence, industrial leadership, and technology-driven problem solving across multidisciplinary areas.
Ph.D
The department’s research focuses on diverse domains including biomechanics, vehicle dynamics, condition monitoring, machine dynamics, tribology, additive manufacturing, composite materials, thermal systems, renewable energy, and advanced fluid-thermal studies.
Centers of Excellence

The department offers 5 undergraduate (UG), 1 Integrated, 3 Post Graduate (PG) and Ph.D. degree programs. Over the last three decades, the department has grown in both infrastructure and expertise in various fields related to Electronics and Communication engineering. The B.Tech (ECE) program at the Kattankulathur campus of SRMIST is accredited by the National Board of Accreditation (NBA), Government of India, and Engineering Accreditation Commission (EAC) of ABET, USA (https://www.abet.org).
In our mission to offer outcome-based education, the department follows an industry-relevant curriculum to promote problem-solving skills and ignite students’ innovative thoughts. We also have well-equipped laboratories with state-of-the-art research facilities to support our academic programs. Our faculty members have excellent academic credentials and promising research potential. The department also has strong collaborations with professional bodies such as IEEE, IE(I), IETE, and Optica in the form of student chapters to enrich the technical knowledge and personal skills of our students.
Quality education is imparted by adopting new teaching pedagogy and industry internships. One of the department’s missions is to produce successful practicing engineers nationally and globally. We are happy to share that the alumni of our department are pursuing higher studies at leading universities in India and abroad and many others hold top positions world over. With the growth of Indian semiconductor industries, there is a high demand for skilled professionals, and the department envisions playing a vital role in preparing students to meet global standards.

The Department of Computing Technologies (CTECH) fosters the future of computing world. The CTECH Department endeavors to be an important regional, national, and international resource center for the development of computing and its applications. The Department is excelling by keeping up with recent trends and evidence of exponential and exhilarating growth. CTECH boasts a vibrant student body of nearly 4000+ undergraduates, 50+ postgraduate students, 100+ research scholars, and a stellar faculty of Professors. During the year 2024-25, around 1200+ offers were bagged by  CTECH Department students in eminent industries like Microsoft, Amazon, Fidelity, etc. The students are exposed to a variety of opportunities, such as in-plant training, internships and workshops during the course of the study.

Technology is best when it brings people together.”
– Matt Mullenweg
As the Head of the Department of Computing Technologies, I am thrilled to welcome you to the dynamic world of our community, where innovation meets collaboration. In today’s digital age, our field plays a crucial role in connecting individuals and shaping the future.
In our ever-evolving field, innovation and creativity are at the forefront of technological advancement. As we embark on this journey together, I encourage each of you to embrace challenges, think critically, and collaborate with your peers. Our department is committed to fostering an environment where knowledge thrives and ideas flourish.
Our curriculum is crafted to equip students with the technical skills necessary for success, while also fostering the problem-solving abilities required to address real-world challenges effectively. Our experienced faculty are passionate about mentorship and research, guiding students to explore their interests and pursue their aspirations. We believe in the culture of collaboration, where students can work together on projects that make a difference.
I am proud to share that our students have achieved remarkable success, from innovative projects recognized in national and international competitions to secure internships at leading tech companies. These accomplishments reflect not only our hard work and dedication but also the vibrant learning environment we foster together. Let’s harness the power of technology to create a better world together.
‘The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.’
Let us inspire one another to reach new heights and make a lasting impact in the world of technology.”
“Together, we will shape the future of computing. Let’s make it remarkable! ”

Postgraduate

Research verticals
Our research centers are supported by a variety of government and industry sources in order to drive new research directions and perform high-quality research and development. Grant programs are supported from internal and/or external sources and offer research funding on competitive and non-competitive bases. They are initiated under four categories:
Visual Computing focuses on human-centric visual computing, which comprises work across computer vision and computer graphics with cross-over into artificial intelligence, machine learning, education, healthcare, human-computer interaction, and entertainment applications.
High Performance Computing spreads its wings across several areas, including optimizing compilers, performance modelling and optimization, parallel algorithms, software engineering, Supercomputing. Cluster, GRID and Cloud Computing
Natural Language Computing finds its widest pathway in computational linguistics and rule-based modeling of human language with statistical, machine learning, and deep learning models.
Theoretical Computer Science flies in an area that is not much explored by computer engineers and derives its motivation from practical and everyday computation.
Featured labs are initiated to empower students and faculty members to ideate and implement technology-based solutions in varied domains.
Open-Source Technology Lab, a fully equipped lab with Acer PC’s serves as an eminent center for placement testing to conduct online aptitude tests for students during the placement drive.
Brain Computer Interface Lab to cater to the research community who work on Human Computer Interfacing and related areas.
Natural Language and Machine Learning Lab, which makes the students learn the nuances of these domains for better landings in companies like Google, Microsoft, IBM, Thought Works, and Yahoo whose main focus is on NLP and Machine Learning.
Wireless Sensor Lab envisioned to provide a practical experience of designing, deploying, and implementing wireless sensor networks in both indoor and outdoor conditions.
Software Defined Networks Lab is equipped with advanced equipment to enable hardware-based, emulation-based and simulation-based studies for SDN and WSDN.
A virtual Lab – a remote-access to simulation-based Labs to provide a complete Learning Management System around the Virtual Labs with additional web-resources, video-lectures, animated demonstrations, and self-evaluation.

Research
Overview
SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST) have taken various research initiatives over the years to mobilize the available knowledge resources for research and also, to come up strongly with innovative solutions.
All the research centers of SRMIST function in a cooperative manner to identify and initiate applied as well as cross-disciplinary research projects, create and combine patentable Intellectual Property (IP) components, design and develop prototypes & proof of concepts, manage and market products & solutions (through know-how transferred incubated companies), win and work to deliver funded research projects.
Faculty and students are actively involved in research, as the university is
Committed to fostering and furthering research excellence
Specially focused on emerging areas of greate potential like Nanotechnology, Bioengineering, Energy, Environment, Materials and Embedded systems among others
Actively involved in a research projects that have nation building and public cause at their heart like for instance rural healthcare, among others.
Mission
Provide excellent research culture and infrastructure
Serve as a platform for strong interdisciplinary collaborations and knowledge sharing
Publish research findings in high quality journals of international repute
Create scientifically profound human resources for academic & industrial research
Promote industrial collaborations involving active and mutually beneficial R & D projects

Directorate of Research
Research is an integral and important feature of learning endeavors at SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST). Towards this end, many research focused initiatives have been taken up over the years. From the early days of SRMIST, our Founder – Chancellor Dr. T. R. Paarivendhar painstakingly emphasized and got us to focus on developing a research mindset in our teaching – learning process. His Leadership focus helped us chart a noteworthy trajectory in our investments into research that made available knowledge resources for research and also, to come up strongly with innovative solutions.
Projects
Highlights
Ph.D Admissions
Academic Research
SRM Institute of Science and Technology  organizes Conferences, Seminars and Workshops periodically. These activities and forums help expose young minds to the latest innovations and scientific trends, thereby generating an interest in research.
Students are also encouraged to take up innovative, socially relevant research projects. Such projects are funded by SRM Institute of Science and Technology.

Funded Research
SRMIST facilitates research pursuits of our faculty members, scholars and students at scale and it is the impact. There is a dedicated focus on ensuring funding is in place so that research projects and studies progress satisfactorily. Incentives in the form of awards and prizes are given out to those demonstrating excellence in research. Each department of SRMIST has the flexibility, freedom and encouragement to pursue various grants and funding from Government, Industry and Multilateral organizations. It is due to this prevalent culture of research that SRMIST enjoys the credibility as a committed and competent institution. This is affirmed in the scale of research grants that annually exceed 100s of crores of Indian Rupees.
Sponsored Research Projects Sanctioned - 2007 onwards
SRMIST invests in creating an ambience that makes it convenient for our researchers to engage in high quality research. The large multidisciplinary campus as well as increasing focus these days on inter-disciplinary research has long back prompted us at SRMIST to focus on creating platforms where scholars and students from diverse study areas and specializations come together to work on finding common solution through research and innovation.
Sponsored Research Projects Sanctioned
Thrust area of research
Thrust areas
Collaborations
Research collaborations with our foreign colleagues are crucial to the success of our global activities involving faculties and students. Within SRMIST, the research platform is significantly strengthened by the collaborative spirit between and among the various highly diversified streams of research undertaken at various centers and departments. This is a great advantage to any research minded scholar or student because this serves as an unparalleled platform to learn, work together and excel.  Our recent past collaborations have been with the following indicative list of researchers who have a high degree of accomplishment and are / have been affiliated with institutions of repute and standing.
Collaborations
Central Research Laboratories and Facilities
IIISM
To promote the research in the field of traditional system of Indian Medicine, including Siddha, Ayurveda and Unani, Interdisciplinary Institute of Indian System of Medicine (IIISM)was established in 2008.
REACH
REACH (Center for Research in Environment, Sustainability Advocacy and Climate CHange) was initiated at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Kattankulathur, Tamil Nadu with the desire to support and enhance a cohesive university-wide environment of research excellence where faculty are inspired
NRC
The Nanotechnology Research Center (NRC) with its state-of-the-art facilities is committed to the responsible development of nanotechnology as an important part of its environmental, health and safety research strategy.
CACR
The Center for Advanced Concrete Research (CACR) at SRM University was started in the year 2010, to carry out interdisciplinary research in the field of concrete, a most common material of construction in any built environment and a basic necessity for accelerated economic development.
SRM-DBT Platform
SRM Institute of Science and Technology in collaboration with Department of Biotechnology, Govt. of India has established this advanced research facility under the project “ SRM-DBT Partnership Platform for Contemporary Research Services and Skill Development in Advanced Life Science Technologies
Medical Research Centre
SRMIST’s aMRC established in 2008 promotes research in medical & allied sciences. In addition to helping PhDs Researchers, MRC among other things also mentors the faculty and the students in Scientific enquiry.
Center for Statistics
SRMIST’s Centre for Statistics is the hub of Statistical Training, Research and Consultancy and it It brings together students, research scholars, and faculty to bring fresh thinking and collaboration.
Earthquake Research Cell
Earthquake Research cell (ERC) established in 2012 to decipher causes for origin, occurrence and prediction of Earthquake by better understanding the geodynamical behavior of this natural disaster on the globe.
HPCC
Supercomputer center is a location with a supercomputer facility usually need for research work. The supercomputer is a computer with a high-level computational capacity compared to a general-purpose computer. Performance of a supercomputer is measured in floating-point operations per second (FLOPS) instead of million instructions per second (MIPS).
SCIF
SCIF portal consolidates the state-of-the-art research facilities available under the Directorate of Research in SRMIST and allows users to directly request & reserve time for use.

Career Centre
Gateway To Great Careers
Career Centre is the centre point of career development, interpersonal skills and placement activities. Career Centre is a target recruiting ground for all major recruiters and has strong linkages with industry and is highly regarded by employers.
The Career Centre in SRM Institute of Science and Technology plays a vital role in making SRM a favoured destination for many national and international organizations to recruit fresh talent nurtured at the Institute. Continuous institute-industry interaction, Pre-Joining learning initiatives, participating in industrial exhibitions, fairs, seminars to promote useful interaction with the industries and alumni activities are some of the initiatives of Placement Office. The excellent infrastructure of the Career Centre facilitates activities like pre-placement talks, written tests, group discussions, and interviews as per the requirements of the recruiting organizations.

Director's Message
The Career Centre at SRMIST encompasses the Placement Office and the Career Development Centre.
Career Development Centre helps to identify the interests and capabilities of students in relation to their career goals and academic progression. Students are encouraged to pursue their passion. Intensive coaching and training is provided in personality development and in shaping their leadership qualities.
The Placement Office besides, placement and training holds workshops, events like Hackathons, Quiz etc., conferences, talks by expert, internship, industrial visits to enable students to be up-to-date with contemporary trends and be ‘Market Ready’ by the time of graduation.

Admission Criteria
For majority of the programs, admission is done through National level entrance examination conducted by SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University) or authorized /statutory boards or agencies. For few programs, admission is done directly. In addition to the above, the eligibility for admission is subject to fulfilling the requirement of minimum marks in the qualifying examination as well.

B.TECH  / M.TECH Integrated  – ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA 2026-2027
Undergraduate Eligibility
Eligibility for B. Tech / M. Tech Integrated Programs Under Regular Stream:
Nationality and Age: Resident Indian.
Note: Non-Resident Indian (NRI), holders of PIO or OCI card issued by the Government of India should apply under International student application form only.
https://intlapplications.srmist.edu.in/international-application-2026
Should have attained the age of 16 years and 6 months on the 31st July of the calendar year in which the 12th Board examination is to be held.
Qualifying Examination:
Applicant should have passed in Higher secondary examination (10 +2 pattern) or appearing in Higher Secondary examination in the current academic year with a
minimum of 60% aggregate
(3 subjects) in Physics (mandatory) , Mathematics (mandatory) and at least one of Chemistry / Biotechnology / Biology / Computer Science / Information Technology / Informatics Practices / Engineering Graphics / Botany and Zoology as major subjects in regular subjects in regular stream from any board within India, CBSE, ISCE, IB or NIOS.
For B.Tech Programs offered by the Department of Biotechnology, Department of Genetic Engineering and Department of Biomedical Engineering –
minimum 60% aggregate
in PCM / PMB/PCB/PCB or Z (Botany or Zoology). Students admitted for the above programs and who have not studied Mathematics as one of the major subjects in 10+2 must undertake an additional 4-credit course in Mathematics during the First Year of B.Tech.
GCE A-level :
Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with  Chemistry/ Biotechnology/ Biology/ Computer Science/ Information Technology/ Informatics Practices/ Engineering Graphics as major subjects (equivalent to Advanced Placement level in each subject) in any International schools within India.
nternational Baccalaureate DIPLOMA/CERTIFICATE-
International Baccalaureate (IB) diploma or IB certificate
2 subjects in HL (equivalent to Advanced Placement level or Honors) and 1 subject in SL is mandatory

B.Arch Degree program
Pass in 10+2 scheme of examination with at least 50% aggregate marks in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics and also at least 50% marks in aggregate of the 10+2 level examination or passed 10+3 Diploma Examination with Mathematics as compulsory subject with at least 50% marks in aggregate.
Qualify an Aptitude Test in Architecture (NATA) conducted by the Council of Architecture or by a competent authority of the Central Government or the respective State Government complying with the admission norms prescribed by the Council of Architecture / competent authority.
Eligibility norms will be aligned as per the norms amended by the Council of Architecture from time to time.
B.Des Degree program
Pass in 10+2 scheme of examination or any other equivalent examination conducted by any authority recognized by SRMIST with at least 50% aggregate marks in 10+2 level examination.
A candidate can belong to any group of study (Science, Commerce, Fine Arts or any other stream).
Candidates with a UCEED score will be given preference.

Back in 2003, SRM set up an International Advisory Board (IAB) consisting of 31 Distinguished Deans, Directors and professors from top universities across the world. SRM’s IAB is the first across the Indian University system. IAB works towards helping SRMIST set Global Standards and Internationalize through bringing globally acclaimed curriculum, research and teaching methodology to its students and faculty members.
Now over 50+ Members are on IAB and they are from the best of the universities across the world including Harvard Business School, Kennedy Public School (Harvard University), MIT, Stanford, LSE, UC Berkeley, Cambridge, NUS among others.

Twining Program | Outward Mobility - SRMIST
Skip to content
Twining / Transfer Program
Home
International Relations
Outward Mobility
Twining Program
Twinning / Transfer programs allow SRMIST to offer Bachelors (UG) degree programs which will have their regular curricula. Through twinning / transfer programs, SRMIST students will be able to transfer their credits to the partnering universities after completing two year of their studies in SRMIST. Students, who opt for transfer, can then finish their degree by completing the remaining course duration at the partnering universities.
The number of credits for students admitted on transfer basis will be at the discretion of the partnering universities. Students enrolling in the Twinning  program in the partnering universities will be given degrees by the partnering universities after successful completion of study. Transfer students will be charged the prevailing tuition by the partnering universities.
International Office of SRMIST has a unit that functions to stimulate curiosity for learning and access for students to Transfer and Pathway Programs at Bachelors level.  Working closely with leading universities around the world, the unit offers a simple way of getting an international degree.
Program Structure
This is structured at the Bachelors level. For  instance, students enrolling  with  SRM  for  Undergraduate  engineering program  will complete  their  two  years  of  study  at  SRM, India and later move over to the partnering university in USA and  other  countries  and  complete  the  rest  of  the programme in the host foreign university to secure BS/MS from overseas.
Benefits
SRM is strengthened by access to the latest curricular development in the partnering institution
Substantial cost savings due to reduced number of years spent overseas
Take up overseas job with a lucrative pay package, to recover all educational cost just in a year or so
Flexibility in choosing from a wide range of subjects, many of which are not offered at any institute in India.
Opportunity to learn in two different cultural environments and thus becoming well-rounded learners
Opportunity to pursue Master’s degree programmes at the same university abroad or any other top university across the world, possibly with Teaching or Research Assistantship, making your Master’s degree inexpensive.

Admission Procedure
All students who are desirous of pursuing a Twinning / Transfer degree must first enroll into an equivalent degree program of SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University) through the regular admission process of SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University). After enrolling in the regular degree program of SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University), the student must register, at the earliest, with the Office of International Relations for the Twinning / Transfer degree program. The Office of IR will counsel and guide the students in choosing the right university / program  that will meet their career objectives and affordability. Admission to the Bachelors (UG) / Masters (PG) Twining Program is purely on merit based on academic performance at 12th Standard / equivalent and the first year of study at SRM, assessment of ambition and excitement level, good communication skills, good testimonials / credentials and right supportive family background.  A separate registration and application form for twinning / transfer degree program is available with the office of IR or can be downloaded from the website. To download Application
Click here
Though all efforts will be taken by office of IR to satisfy the choice of the university that the student desires to pursue the twinning / transfer degree, it is subject to acceptance by the hosting university and seat availability and students meeting their admission criteria. In the unlikely scenario of the student not getting admission to the University of his / her choice then the student can continue in the degree program enrolled for at SRM and get degree from SRM. The transfer / twinning degree option is available under all degree programs of the faculty of Engineering & Technology, Management, and Science & Humanities.
Eligibility
Undergraduate (UG) Programs Twining Program
Must Maintain a minimum CGPA of 8 out of 10 during the first two years of study at SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University)
High ambition and excitement level and good communication skills with right supportive family background
Graduate (PG) Programs Twining Program
A pass in the relevant degree or its equivalent with:
Minimum 80% aggregate at the Bachelors degree.
High ambition and excitement level and good communication skills with right supportive family background

SRM School of Law
In the words of our Founder & Chancellor
Law schools fulfill the noble obligation of imparting legal education to their students so that they can become competent, confident, and equipped to face effectively, all new challenges in their legal practice and research in this constantly
evolving era, and concomitantly, to be committed to serving society with humanity, compassion, and humility. Law is one of the oldest, noblest, and greatest intellectual professions that demands holistic and focused education and guidance beyond the ‘four walls of the classroom’. One must know that behind each great jurist, judge, eminent lawyer, other exceptional professor, and legal professional is a strong law school and a dedicated fraternity of faculties committed to building these personalities. School of Law, SRM Institute of Science & Technology is one of the leading Law Schools in India recognized by BCI which was initiated with a commitment to delivering the highest standards in legal education and training. SRMIST has consistently ranked amongst the top-ranking multi-stream universities in India and abroad, with a vision to impart quality education that ensures the products of Law school stand par excellence. School of Law, SRMIST offers quality legal education in Undergraduate (UG), Postgraduate (PG), Doctor of Philosophy (PhD), and Diploma programs as well as Certificate Courses and Value Added Courses which are focused on developing legal knowledge in a wide variety of legal areas. SRM School of Law takes pride in developing and executing a strong curriculum and pedagogies that have been framed; keeping up contemporary standards and expectations. Placements and internships are strongly facilitated, due to which, the alumni of SRM School of Law have made us proud by occupying coveted positions in different fields. The strive towards excellence of SRM School of Law is also evident in the institution’s constant endeavor of building a team of committed and qualified teachers who are equipped to impart knowledge and training to the students such that they excel not only in academics but all spheres of life. SRM School of Law has a rich legacy, having completed a decade of its establishment, and making significant strides towards excellence.
SRM School of Law was inaugurated in 2014 by the Honorable Chief Judge of the Supreme Court of Maryland, Mary Ellen Barbara along with the judicial delegates from the State of Maryland, USA which was led by the First Lady of State, Katie
O’Malley. The School ties up with many foreign universities and institutions, which incorporates a rich exchange of knowledge and research activities. SRM Law School conducts two National-level Moot Court competitions annually in which students from different parts of the country take part. The industry-academic interface is a major part of teaching pedagogy. Today’s lawyer is supposed to have exposure to different disciplines like science & technology, from medicine to literature, and from arts to sports, SRMIST is a leader in all! Being a multidisciplinary university, law students enjoy the exclusive scope of exposure to other streams of learning added to the law. The multicultural atmosphere of the campus provides a great opportunity for the students to know different cultures as students from different parts of India and the world are studying here. The environment-friendly green campus adds additional energy to the atmosphere here at SRM. Hostel facilities with high-quality hygienic food, personal care, and safety make the students feel that they are not away from their homes. Students’ talents in sports and cultural activities are well recognized through special scholarships and training that propel students to excel in their respective areas of interest. NCC and NSS schemes are active on the campus. Care is taken to shape the overall personality of the students with special importance on character building apart from professional competence. At SRM, Students get to interact with great achievers like Judges, Advocates, Civil Servants, and other eminent public personalities throughout their academic journey. As an institution striving to constantly aim higher, SRM School of Law equips, exposes, empowers, and enlightens the students to take up the challenges with confidence and commitment as they power forward in life.

SRM School of Law has completed 10 years of its existence and has made a name for itself with contributions from its students, teachers, and non-teaching staff under the leadership of earlier deans.
I believe in the vision of SRM School of Law as an institution of academic excellence having tremendous potential to be among the best in the country. In addition, I believe that SOL will also be an institution committed to community service, instilling in its students the values of professional ethics, social responsibility, and inclusiveness in addition to giving them legal knowledge and skills necessary for success in their chosen career paths.
The vision of SOL is to maintain high academic standards, develop innovative pedagogy, and create an industry-linked global curriculum. SOL aims to impart knowledge but inculcate values so that our students can contribute towards achieving social, political, and economic justice.
