Clubs
Home
Life at SRM
Student Life
Clubs
Learning & Fun Beyond Classrooms
All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy” — The SRM Institute of Science and Technology does not limit learning to textbooks and focuses on the holistic development of its students beyond the four walls of the classrooms! The students are offered opportunities to hone their skills and learn new skills through workshops, sessions and activities which are organised by the clubs. These activities promote students to experiment with their innate potential in a favourable ambience. Joining a club is easy and makes life more rewarding, stimulating and most importantly, fun. It gives students an opportunity to find people with similar interests and passions and allows them to foster them enthusiastically. SRMIST aims at building local and intercultural relationships between students, as well as their own identities, which promotes their well-being and performance over time and broadens their worldview because the mark of true education is the ability to shape students to be better human beings!
Rotaract Club
Rotaract Club
The club is based on philanthropic values and objectives and aims at bringing together young adults for the benefit and welfare of society. Frontliners aged 18 and older get a chance to trade schemes with headmen in the community and flourish initiatives and professional skills, all while serving the community. Working under the Rotary Club of Meenambakkam, young pioneers of the club make it their mission to achieve sustainable development goals for making lasting positive changes in the world.
Click here for Contact Details
Astrophilia
Astrophilia
This is a club devoted to studying stars, constellations, planets, galaxies, and all other things which twinkle in the sky. It is where students can learn and spread awareness about space and astronomy through dedicated scientific and philosophical discussions and interactions. It allows amateur astronomists and physics enthusiasts to get to know more about the vast and enigmatic universe and carry forward the legacy of the cosmos.
Click here for Contact Details
Fashion
Fashion
The club provides a place for students to express their inherent artistic flair in the fashion world. They set trends and break them too, thus, genuinely pioneering the meaning of beauty and redefining it. It is here, that students can learn to groom themselves and carry themselves perfectly down a narrow runway, right into the grandiose and glamorous world of fashion.
Click here for Contact Details
Music
Music
The club is where students with musical inclinations can come together to display and sharpen their harmonious talents. It helps students to assemble their knowledge of music to create a harmonious crescendo. Being a part of this club is a wonderful opportunity to meet people with varied tastes in music, equally passionate about music, and people who may give you a new perspective on the way you look at the world of symphony.
Click here for Contact Details
Literature Club
Literature Club
“The pen is mightier than the sword.”
While thought exists, words are alive and literature becomes an escape, not from, but into the living. The club is a utopia for thinkers, readers, and writers; it is where literary minds come together for scholarly brainstorming sessions and discussions; it showers the enchantment of poems, stories, and essays in young minds, thus, giving life to their words, thoughts, and imagination.
Click here for Contact Details
Festival
Festival
The true beauty of culture can be observed in the way we rejoice in them. The club aims in making each festival a noteworthy experience. The club celebrates and memorialises the diversity in the different cultures of the country. It helps students seek cultural enrichment, education, novelty, and socialisation by witnessing and celebrating various festivals belonging to multiple cultures and religions.
Click here for Contact Details
Dance Club
Dance Club
The club is the combination of many dynamic and talented professionals from different genres of practice, where they can nurture their talent, celebrate their diversity, and express the creative fluidity of young minds. The club makes the students adapt creative, fun, and easy ways of learning dance and enables them to be fit and socialise. It is the perfect platform for dance enthusiasts and dance professionals to come together.
Click here for Contact Details
Movies and Dramatics
Movies and Dramatics
The club collaborates with young entertainers to celebrate various aspects of the performing arts. It welcomes students on board who are engrossed to explore more about the thespian world. It aims at finding out the innate artistic talents among students, nurturing them to their fullest, and providing a platform for students who have the talent, confidence and passion to do something unique. Drama Club promotes communication skills, teamwork, dialogue, socialisation, stages terminology, and working on acting skills.
Click here for Contact Details
Sports
Sports
The club looks for zealous and talented sportspersons and aims at promoting team spirit, leadership, and fitness. The students are allowed to participate in a broad variety of sports and recreational activities and to live a balanced life academically, athletically and socially. The club provides the opportunity to athletes from any field to practice, hone and master their athletic prowess. They host numerous competitions around the year for students from all streams.
Click here for Contact Details
Creative Arts & Media
Creative Arts & Media
From cave paintings to abstract art – creativity has always been here, manifesting in various forms, and embellishing and astonishing the world in the process. The club creates an outlet for this creative energy that resides within every living soul. It provides an opportunity for creative and artistic people to express and display their true vibrant, imaginative selves and aims in enriching and fostering an interest in art and personal expression through art.
Click here for Contact Details
Women Empowerment
Women Empowerment
The club is dedicated to educating and spreading awareness amongst people about women’s issues and their empowerment. It encourages women to represent themselves and be a part of every field and creates an awareness about their capabilities. The mission of this club is to address gender inequality issues through presentations, symposiums, awareness camps, and discussions.
Click here for Contact Details
Self Defense Club
Self Defense Club
The club teaches students the basic skills and techniques required to defend themselves in times of need because self-defence is not a choice but a need. It is about educating the mind and body in martial arts for self-defence in a safe and constructive environment.
Click here for Contact Details
Social Club
Social Club
The club is dedicated to fostering the spirit of generosity, humility, empathy, camaraderie and social corporation in the youth of the institute, making them aware of their social responsibilities and encouraging them to serve the community. It organises social service events, awareness camps and volunteering events where the young people of the institute can help make the world a bit more tolerant, kind and compassionate.
Click here for Contact Details
Gaming
Gaming
Have high gaming skills but don’t know how to start? The club is devoted to teaching, promoting, and organising e-games and e-gaming tournaments. The club helps students learn the required techniques, hacks, and tricks to thoroughly enjoy e-games and give a sense of accomplishment and progression in life.

International Advisory Board
Back in 2003, SRM set up an International Advisory Board (IAB) consisting of 31 Distinguished Deans, Directors and professors from top universities across the world. SRM’s IAB is the first across the Indian University system. IAB works towards helping SRMIST set Global Standards and Internationalize through bringing globally acclaimed curriculum, research and teaching methodology to its students and faculty members.
Now over 50+ Members are on IAB and they are from the best of the universities across the world including Harvard Business School, Kennedy Public School (Harvard University), MIT, Stanford, LSE, UC Berkeley, Cambridge, NUS among others.

Career Centre is the centre point of career development, interpersonal skills and placement activities. Career Centre is a target recruiting ground for all major recruiters and has strong linkages with industry and is highly regarded by employers.
The Career Centre in SRM Institute of Science and Technology plays a vital role in making SRM a favoured destination for many national and international organizations to recruit fresh talent nurtured at the Institute. Continuous institute-industry interaction, Pre-Joining learning initiatives, participating in industrial exhibitions, fairs, seminars to promote useful interaction with the industries and alumni activities are some of the initiatives of Placement Office. The excellent infrastructure of the Career Centre facilitates activities like pre-placement talks, written tests, group discussions, and interviews as per the requirements of the recruiting organizations.

Selective Excellence Research Initiative (SERI)
Selective Excellence Research Initiative
Applications are invited from faculty members of Engineering & Technology, Management & Agricultural Sciences either individually or in groups for research proposals under the Selective Excellence Research Initiative (SERI) of the SRM Institute of Science and Technology for 2025-2026.
Applications must be written in a simple and easy-to-understand manner without using jargon. Successful proposals may be funded up to a maximum of Rs.5 lakhs for two years. The proposal will be evaluated by a committee chaired by the Dean of Research.
Priority will be given only to interdisciplinary and multidisciplinary research areas in collaboration with faculty members from other departments and schools.
The last date for applications is on or before 21
September 2025

Equal Opportunity Cell | - SRMIST

Equal Opportunity Cell
Home
Equal Opportunity Cell
At SRMIST, we believe in fostering an inclusive environment where every individual has the opportunity to thrive and excel. Our
Equal Opportunity Cell (EOC)
is dedicated to upholding this principle by ensuring that all members of our community have equal access to opportunities, resources, and support.
Vision
To create a campus environment where every individual, regardless of their background, has equal access to opportunities and resources, fostering a culture of inclusivity, respect, and empowerment. Our vision is to be a leader in promoting diversity and equity, ensuring that all members of our college community can thrive academically, professionally, and personally in an atmosphere free from discrimination and bias.
Mission
The mission of the Equal Opportunity Cell is to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion across all facets of university life. We strive to create a campus culture that celebrates differences, values diversity, and fosters a sense of belonging for every individual.
Objectives
Promote Inclusivity and Diversity
Foster an inclusive campus environment where students, faculty, and staff from diverse backgrounds feel welcomed, respected, and valued. This includes actively supporting underrepresented groups such as those based on race, gender, disability, socioeconomic status, and other identities.
Ensure Compliance with Equal Opportunity Laws and Policies
Foster an inclusive campus environment where students, faculty, and staff from diverse backgrounds feel welcomed, respected, and valued. This includes actively supporting underrepresented groups such as those based on race, gender, disability, socioeconomic status, and other identities.
Conduct Training and Awareness Programs
Organize regular workshops, seminars, and training sessions to educate the college community about equal opportunity principles, diversity issues, and the importance of creating a non-discriminatory environment. This helps in building awareness and sensitizing the community towards these issues.
Monitor and Evaluate Institutional Practices
Continuously monitor and evaluate the college's policies, practices, and programs to ensure they promote equal opportunity. This involves conducting regular reviews, collecting feedback, and implementing improvements to enhance equity and access for all members of the college community.
What We Do
Advocacy and Support
The EOC provide confidential support, guidance, and advocacy to help individuals navigate challenging situations and access appropriate resources.
Education and Training
We offer workshops, seminars, and training programs to raise awareness about diversity, equity, and inclusion issues. Through education, we aim to promote understanding, empathy, and cultural competence among members of the university community.
Policy Development
The EOC collaborates with university administrators, faculty, and staff to develop and implement policies and practices that promote equity and eliminate barriers.
Outreach and Engagement
We actively engage with students, faculty, staff, and community members to foster a culture of inclusion and belonging.

Diversity | Student Life - SRMIST

Diversity
Home
Life at SRM
Student Life
Diversity
Living and learning together
It’s a ‘mini India’ out here at the SRM Institute of Science and Technology (
formerly known as SRM University
) campus – with students from all over India and even from other parts of the world. The campus too reflects this cosmopolitan aspect of the student community, with celebrations of regional festivals.
Living and learning together instills self-confidence and a spirit of camaraderie among the students, and contributes to professional fraternity.
Mini India on Campus
Prevalence of a diverse and inclusive culture at campus enhances the learning environment by improving the ability to work in diverse groups. Each student at the campus brings his or her own unique cultural background and experience. There are several activities to keep students busy, in various areas of interest.
Across the university’s four campuses – at Kattankulathur, Ramapuram and Vadapalani in Chennai and Modi Nagar in Delhi – it’s a stimulating environment for living and learning, with a diversity of students from across India and the world. Living and learning together instills self-confidence and a spirit of camaraderie among the students, and contributes to professional fraternity.
Cultural activities, sports, fine arts and entrepreneurship are all nurtured here, encouraging students to venture beyond the realms of academics.

title: Highlights | Research - SRMIST
content:
Highlights | Research - SRMIST
Skip to content
Highlights
Home
Research
Highlights
Highlights
SRMIST has established state-of-the-art infrastructure, cutting-edge laboratories and highly sophisticated instruments to provide an environment conducive to holistic learning and ground breaking research including Single Crystal XRD facility, XPS, etc. which are recently procured.
We have been granted the Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC) BioNEST through the Department of Biotechnology with a funding value of Rs. 10 Crores. This focused Grant will facilitate start-ups in health-tech and med-tech domains and provide them with the necessary support to take their products to market. The BioNEST office space is will be set up in the SRM Medical College.
The Directorate of Entrepreneurship and Innovation (DEI) has also been shortlisted for the SPARSH initiative through the BIRAC for helping founders who are working on social entrepreneurial ventures with a fund value of Rs 1.7 Crores
We have been supporting faculty members with a total funding of Rs. 2 crore per year under the Selective Excellence Research Initiative (SERI) with a maximum of Rs. 5 lakhs per faculty member. This will help the newly joined faculty members with no funded projects to carry out preliminary research ideas that transform into novel findings.
SRMIST also supports faculty members with seed money depending on their areas of expertise to establish their labs
The Department of Telecommunication under the Ministry of Communications has rolled out the ‘100 5G labs initiative’ – an endeavor to use opportunities associated with 5G technology. Such a 5G-use case lab will soon be installed at SRMIST as announced by the Honourable Prime Minister that will promote the design and development of 5G applications that cater both to India’s unique needs as well as global demands.
We have been collaborating through joint publications with reputed International Institutions from more than 150 countries. This has resulted in signing MoUs with more than 125 Universities abroad.
Department of Civil Engineering received project title “Enabling of Academic Institutes in Technical Textiles for Private and Public Institutes” by the funding agency National Technical Textiles Mission (NTTM), Ministry of Textiles, Govt.of India, sanctioned amount Rs. 5 crores.
The Nature Index 2025 survey
placed SRM Institute of Science and Technology
2nd among the Private Universities
and 19
overall in India for its institutional outputs from 1
February 2024– 31
January 2025 in recognition of the efforts in publishing quality research works in Nature-Indexed Journals.
SRMIST secured 3
position in UI Green Metric Ranking in 2022 and maintaining 3
places for the past 3 years
, we have a dedicated Green Initiatives and Environmental Sustainable Development CELL.
36 Scientists with SRMIST affiliation were identified among the Top 2% most cited Scientists
in their research fields in year 2024, as per survey undertaken by Elsevier BV (Elsevier-Stanford University initiative)
SRMIST secured
DST-PURSE
project for the proposal entitled “Establishment of Holistic Electric Mobility Infrastructure and Supporting Networks to Promote Research and Start-ups towards National Electric Mobility” supported with
13. 63 crores.
Boots trappers Research Council (BRC) that governs the entrepreneurial activities of SRM Innovation Incubation and Entrepreneurship Centre (SIIEC) has been selected by the Start-up India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS) and sanctioned amount Rs. 3 crore
Ministry of Health & Family welfare approved for “conducting National family Health survey – round 6   for the state Tamil Nadu (North and Puducherry)-Phase I”, Sanctioned amount Rs. 7.50 crore

Collaborations | Research - SRMIST
Skip to content
Collaborations
Home
Research
Collaborations
Collaborations
Collaborations are the bedrock upon which our excellence in research is distinctly impactful and significant. We are able to work on emerging and frontier areas because we bring together the best and brightest from around the world to our par-take in research at SRMIST.
NRC
EQRC
IIISM
CENR
Nanotech Research Center
The Center has worked to establish technical & scientific collaborations with a number of national and international institutional and industrial collaborations.
Collaborations
National Academic collaboration with BiTS Pilani Goa
Industry Collaboration with Sankara Nethralaya
International academic collaborations with
Toyo University, Japan, University of Nevada, Las Vegas, USA,Free University of Berlin, Berlin, Germany
Earthquake Research Cell (EQRC)
SRMIST established an Earthquake Research cell (EQRC) in July 2012 for Advanced Research on the causes for origin, occurrence and prediction of Earthquake
Collaborations
EQRC centre has international collaborations with Taiwan, Thailand, iraq, Australia and the BRICS Project
Collaborations on EQRC
Interdisciplinary Institute of Indian System of Medicine (IIISM)
IIISM Established in 2008, this prestigious IIISM is at the forefront of promoting research in the field of traditional system of Indian Medicine, including Siddha, Ayurveda and Unani.
Collaborations
IIISM has signed a MoU with Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi and Adesh Institute of Medical Sciences, Punjab for conducting multi-centric clinical trials of the polyherbal formulations.The herbal drugs that successfully pass clinical evaluation will be manufactured by SRM Pharma Pvt. Ltd., Chennai.
SRMIST has signed a MoU with M/S. SMO Connect Pvt. Ltd, Cochin, Kerala for conducting Phase-III Clinical trial on modern medicine in the area of Endocrinology, Pulmonology, Cardiology, Dermatology, Rheumatology etc
Center for Environmental Nuclear Research (CENR)
CENR as a Center was established in 2009 with grants from the Department of Atomic Energy, Board of Research in Nuclear Science (BRNS), Mumbai and with the extensive support from Directorate of Research, SRMIST
Collaborations
CENR maintains strong collaborative links with National research organizations  such as BARC Mumbai,
Indira Gandhi Centre For Atomic Research, Kalpakkam,Zoological Survey of India, Chennai,Kings Institute of Preventive Medicine, Chennai
,Industries such as
Synkromax Biotech Pvt Ltd., Chennai, Hatsun Agro Products, Chennai
and International research organizations  such as
National Institute of Health (NIH) / National Cancer Institute (NCI) – USA, National University of Singapore, Singapore, University of Basel , Switzerland and many more.

title: Dining & Eateries | SRM Hostels - SRMIST
content:
Dining & Eateries | SRM Hostels - SRMIST
Skip to content
Dining & Eateries
Home
SRM Hostels
Dining & Eateries
Mess
Across every hostel, an exclusive mess facility is made available for breakfast, lunch and dinner under the safe and hygiene environment
Mess Timinigs
Working Days
Breakfast
07.00 AM to 9.00 AM
Lunch
11.30 AM to 1.30 PM
Tea/ Snacks
04.30 PM to 5.30 PM
Dinner
7.30 PM to 9.00 PM
Holidays
Breakfast
07.30 AM to 9.30 AM
Lunch
12.00 Noon to 1.30 PM
Tea/ Snacks
04.30 PM to 5.30 PM
Dinner
7.30 PM to 9.00 PM
Mess Rules
Once a student joins the hostel, he / she is deemed to have become a member of the mess until he / she vacates the hostel officially
No change of mess is permissible
The mess is run by the management
Strict discipline should be maintained in the dining hall
Menu will be displayed on the notice board. Changes can be made based on the decision of mess committee.
Day scholars will not be entertained as guests in the mess
Inmates can entertain their parents as guests on prior information to the hostel authorities. The guest rate is Rs.80/- for breakfast, Rs. 100/- for Veg lunch,
Rs. 40/-
for Tea/Snacks &
Rs. 100/-
for
dinner respectively. For special lunch/dinner the rate is Rs. 150/-.
Food will not be served in rooms and the inmates are not supposed to take food to their rooms. If an inmate is ill, the deputy warden will make suitable arrangements.
The inmates should not enter the kitchen
Wasting food is a crime. No diner shall waste food. Paying mess bill does not entitle a diner to waste food. If any student is found wasting food he / she will be fined Rs 500/- for the first time. If the same student is found repeating the same mistake he / she will be expelled from the hostel.
The system of self service will be followed in all the mess
The quantity of food will be unlimited except in the case of special items
All diners shall produce ID card and Mess card to dine every time in the mess
Unauthorized people and non hostelers seen in the dining hall without receipts of payment will be charged a fine of Rs.2000/-
Canteens
SRMIST Canteen (Old Campus)
SRMIST Food Joint, Fast Food & Super Market
Location:
Adjacent to the Main Entrance (Near gate No 4, Opp to the Potheri Railway Station)
Timing:
7.00 am to 5.00 pm
A restaurant type of building is a favorite eat out for most of the faculty members and the students. The tempting smell of delicious food from the canteen attracts the students and the faculty members. In the morning they serve dosa, poori, pongal, idly, samosa, puff and vada. During lunch, they serve variety rice, full meals, biryani, chapatti and paratha. Students can buy chocolates, cool drinks, and ice creams all the time. Tea, coffee and snacks are available throughout the working hours.
SRMIST Canteen (University Building)
Location:
Ground Floor of the University Building
Timing:
7.00 AM to 5.00 PM
With the capacity of over 150 students this canteen serves poori, pongal, idly, samosa, puff and vada. During lunch, they serve variety rice, limited meals, biryani, fried rice, chapatti and paratha. Students can buy chocolates, cool drinks, and ice creams all the time.
At the 5
and 8
floors of the University building two small outlets of the Canteen are functioning to cater to the needs of students and faculty members.
SRMIST Canteen (Tech Park)
Location:
Ground Floor of the Tech Park building
Timing:
7.00 AM to 5.00 PM
With the capacity of over 650 students this canteen operates with two cash counters to manage the crowd. In the morning they serve poori, pongal, idly, samosa, puff and vada. During lunch, they serve variety rice, limited meals, biryani, fried rice, chapatti and paratha. Students can buy chocolates, cool drinks, and ice creams all the time.
Java Green Food Court
Location:
Near the clock tower
Time:
7.30 am to 8.00 pm
This is like a mini food street inside the campus where one can get a variety of food items and beverages. In terms of price, it is affordable and pocket friendly. This place has around 20 stalls with all kinds of food. Every stall has some good dishes to taste. Shawarma, aloo paratha, chicken biryani, deserts, coffee etc are a delight to taste. Subway offers a variety of pizzas too.
SRM GH Café
Location:
Opposite Labour ward in the SRM Hospital
Timing:
7.30 am to 4.30 pm
CRRI Canteen
Location:
Fourth floor of the Medical College
Timing:
7.30 am to 8.30 pm
The canteen is exclusive for the final year MBBS students.
FoodExo Dental College Canteen
Location:
Behind Dental College
Timing:
7.30 am to 4.30 pm
This canteen is almost at the end of the campus and has the same menu as the other canteens. In the morning they serve poori, pongal, idly, samosa, puff and vada. During lunch, they serve variety rice, limited meals, chapatti and paratha. Students can buy chocolates, cool drinks, and ice creams all the time.
Slice Of Life Cafe (SRM Medical College Canteen)
Location:
Adjacent to the SRM Medical College
Timing:
7.30 am to 8.00 pm
Slice of Life Café is your go-to spot for a perfect blend of comfort, style, and delicious cuisine. Conveniently located adjacent to SRM Medical College, our café offers a warm and inviting atmosphere with lush greenery, high-quality tables and chairs, and an eye-catching ambiance that creates a soothing environment for chit-chats, and quality time. Accommodating up to 100 guests, Slice of Life is ideal for everything from a quick bite to a leisurely meal. Our diverse menu includes breakfast items, rice dishes, biryani, meals, fried rice, tandoori, barbecue, freshly baked goods, chaat snacks, and a variety of beverages such as juices, milkshakes, tea, coffee, hot chocolate, and whatnot.
For those with a sweet tooth or craving comfort food, we also offer delicious sweets, pizza, and burgers. Slice of Life Café invites you to drop by and enjoy a delightful experience where every moment is a celebration of good food and great company.
Madras Café
Location:
1 floor of the SRM General Hospital
Timing:
24Hrs
The Madras Café is providing canteen facility to the students, teaching, non-teaching staff and to the patients who visit the Medical College. It can cater to the demands of the students and other visitors and can accommodate around 150 persons at a time. This canteen takes care to provide a nutritious and hygienic food at a nominal cost. A variety of food and snack items which includes South and North Indian items, Variety Rice, tiffin varieties, snacks, coffee/tea etc are served here.
VEC Campus
The Royal Café Canteen
Location 1:
Near Valliammai Engineering College entrance
Location 2:
Opp to the SRM College of Pharmacy (Behind VEC)
Timing:
7.30 am to 4.30 pm
Its location near the entrance and near Pharmacy and SRM Arts & Science College keeps the canteen busy throughout the day. All essential food items are served throughout the day.

Directorate of Sports
At SRMIST, sports are a vital part of holistic education, promoting fitness, teamwork, and excellence. Guided by Founder Chancellor Dr. T. R. Paarivendhar’s vision, SRMIST provides world-class sports facilities, professional coaching, and opportunities for athletes to shine at national and international levels.
Home
Sports
Menu
At SRMIST, sports are an essential part of holistic education and student life. Guided by the vision of our
Founder Chancellor, Dr. T. R. Paarivendhar
, SRMIST aims to nurture excellence both in academics and athletics. The University offers
world-class sports facilities
including spacious playgrounds, indoor stadiums, fitness centers, and the state-of-the-art Dr. T. R. Paarivendhar Aquatic Complex. With professional coaching, modern infrastructure, and structured training programs, SRMIST encourages students to excel in national and international tournaments.
Annual intercollegiate events and intramural competitions foster teamwork, leadership, and sportsmanship across all disciplines. Through Sports Quota admissions and scholarships, talented athletes are recognized and supported to achieve their dreams. At SRMIST, sports are not just recreational activities—they are a way of life that builds discipline, determination, and character, truly reflecting the Founder Chancellor’s vision of empowering youth through education and sport.

Director - Sports
Sports play an important role in every human being’s day-to-day life and bring people together irrespective of their age, gender and nationality. Our Founder Chancellor has a great vision to make SRMIST as a Temple of Sports in India. Directorate of Sports is marching towards fulfilling his vision as a reality. Over the last few years, SRMIST has seen a lot of success like never before. Young achievers in various sports have won prizes and medals at various state, National and international level events. Our goal is to increase the participation of our teams in various competitions and win medals and bring laurels to the University and the country.
SRMIST is one of the few Universities in the country which encourages sports and games which has changed the lives of many young sports men and women. I strongly believe that sports help to inculcate teamwork, sacrifice, discipline and leadership qualities.
In addition to the regular sports activities, the Directorate of Sports, SRMIST offers a variety of courses through the Department of Physical Education & Sports Sciences and the Department of Yoga.

Immigration/FRRO
Visa Requirement
Foreigners entering India on a Student, Employment, Research or Missionary Visa valid for more than 180 days are required to register with the Foreigners Registration Officer under whose jurisdiction they propose to stay. This should be done within 14 days of arrival in India, irrespective of their actual period of stay.
Foreigners visiting India on any other category of long-term VISA valid for more than 180 days are not required to register themselves if their actual stay does not exceed 180 days on each visit. If such a foreigner intends to stay in India for more than 180 days during a particular visit, he/ she should get registered within 180 days of arrival in India.
Pakistan nationals are required to register within 24 hours of their arrival in India. Afghanistan nationals are required to register within 7 days of their arrival in India.

Skip to content
Home
தமிழ்ப்பேராயம்
தமிழ்ப்பேராயம்
Tamil Perayam
‘‘தமிழ்ப்பேராயம்” தமிழ்மொழி வளர்ச்சிக்கென நிறுவப்பட்ட ஒரு பணிப்புலம் ஆகும். தனக்கெனத் தனி அடையாள முத்திரை கொண்டதாய் இவ்வமைப்பு விளங்குகிறது.
இந்தியாவின் தலைசிறந்த கல்வி நிறுவனங்களில் ஒன்றான திரு. இராமசாமி நினைவு(SRM) அறிவியல் மற்றும் தொழில்நுட்பக் கல்வி நிறுவனம் பொறியியல், மேலாண்மை, மருத்துவம், கலையியல், மானுடவியல் வேளாண்மையியல், சட்டவியல் போன்ற பல்வேறு துறைகளில் கல்வியை வழங்கிச் சிறப்பான கல்விச்சேவையில் ஈடுபட்டுவருகிறது. வெள்ளிவிழா கண்ட நிறுவனம் அறிவியல், தொழில்நுட்பத்தில் சிறந்து விளங்குகிற நிலையில்   தமிழ்மொழியின் தொன்மை, வரலாறு, பண்பாடு ஆகியவற்றை உணர்த்த தமிழ்ப்பேராயம் என்னும் அமைப்பை 03 பிப்ரவரி 2011-இல் பல்கலைக்கழக வேந்தர் முனைவர் தா.இரா. பாரிவேந்தர் உருவாக்கினார்.
தமிழ்ப்பேராயம்
” தமிழ்மொழி வளர்ச்சிக்கென நிறுவப்பட்ட ஒரு பணிப்புலம் ஆகும். தனக்கெனத் தனி அடையாள முத்திரை கொண்டதாய் இவ்வமைப்பு விளங்குகிறது.
இந்திய நடுவண் அரசின் சாகித்திய அகாதெமி இந்திய மொழிகளுக்கு எத்தகைய பணிகளைச் செய்கிறதோ அதேபோன்று தமிழ்மொழிக்கு ஆக்கப் பணிகளைச் செய்வதை முதன்மை நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டது தமிழ்ப்பேராயம் (Thamizh  Academy). இந்தத் தமிழ்ப்பேராயத்தின் பல்வேறு பணித்திட்டங்களைத் தமிழ்ப்பேராய மையப் பணிக்குழு (Central Executive Cell – Tamil Perayam-CEC-TP) செயல்படுத்துகிறது.
தமிழ்ப்பேராய விருதுகள் 2026
நோக்கம்: (VISION)
துறைதோறும் தமிழ் வளர்ச்சிக்கான பணிகளை முன்னெடுத்தல், அரிய நூல்களையும் புதிய ஆய்வு நூல்களையும் வெளியிடல், தமிழ் வளர்ச்சிக்காகப் பாடுபடும் அறிஞர்களுக்கு விருது வழங்கி ஊக்குவித்தல், தமிழ்ப் பண்பாடு மற்றும் சமயம் தொடர்பான பட்டயம் மற்றும் சான்றிதழ் வகுப்புகளை நடத்துதல், உலக அளவில் தமிழ் வளர்ச்சிக்கான பணிகளை ஆற்றுதல்.
செயல்பாடு : (MISSION)
தமிழில் வழிபாடு நடத்துவதற்கான பட்டய வகுப்பை நடத்தி வருதல், வள்ளலார் மற்றும் திருமூலர் தொடர்பான பட்டயம் மற்றும் சான்றிதழ் வகுப்புகளை நடத்துதல், செவ்விலக்கிய நூல்களை ஆங்கிலத்தில் மொழிபெயர்த்தல், மூத்த தமிழறிஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட நூல்களை வெளியிடுதல், தேசிய மற்றும் பன்னாட்டுக் கருத்தரங்குகளை நடத்தி அக்கட்டுரைத் தொகுப்புகளை நூலாக வெளியிடல், ‘‘செவ்வி’’ என்ற காலாண்டு ஆய்விதழை வெளியிடல், பாரிவேந்தர் மாணவர் தமிழ் மன்றம் மூலமாகப் பல்வேறு நிகழ்வுகளைத் தொடர்ந்து நடத்தி மாணவர்களின் ஆற்றல்கள் வெளிப்பட வாய்ப்பளித்தல். மாணவர் மன்றம் மூலமாக ‘‘வேந்தர் நெறி’’ என்ற காலாண்டு இதழை நடத்துதல்.
முனைவர் கரு. நாகராசன்
தலைவர்
தமிழ்ப்பேராயத்தின் பக்கத்திற்கு வரவேற்கிறோம்
இந்திய மொழிகளின் வளர்ச்சிக்காகச் சாகித்ய அகாதமி என்ற நிறுவனத்தை மத்திய அரசு நடத்துவது போல் தமிழ் மொழியின் வளர்ச்சிக்காகப் பல்கலைக்கழக வேந்தர் மாண்பமை டாக்டர் பாரிவேந்தர் அவர்களால் 2011 ஆம் ஆண்டு தோற்றுவிக்கப்பட்டது தமிழ்ப்பேராயம்.
தலைமைக்குழு, செயற்குழு, பொதுக்குழு, பதிப்புக் குழு மற்றும் மையப் பணிக் குழு ஆகிய கட்டமைப்புடன் செயல்படும் தமிழ்ப்பேராயம், தமிழ்க் கல்வித் துறை, தமிழ்ச் சமயக் கல்வித் துறை, கணினித் தமிழ்க் கல்வித் துறை, நூல் பதிப்புத் துறை ஆகியவற்றுடன் ஆண்டுதோறும் சுமார் 20 இலட்சம் பெறுமான விருதுகளையும் தமிழ் அறிஞர்களுக்கு வழங்கி வருகிறது.
தமிழ்ப் பேராயத்தின் தலைவர் கலைமாமணி விருது உட்பட நான்கு அரசு விருதுகளையும், இரண்டு நூல்களுக்கான தமிழக அரசின் பரிசினையும் பெற்றவர். 75 நூல்களின் ஆசிரியரான இவர், தமிழக அரசின் உயர்கல்வி மன்ற உறுப்பினர் செயலர் உட்பட பல உயர் பொறுப்புகளில் இருந்தவர். பேராயத்தில் பணியாற்றும் பிற துணைப் பேராசிரியர்களும், கவிதை, ஆய்வு எனப் பல நூல்களைப் படைத்தவர்கள். அத்தகைய சிறப்புமிக்க தமிழ்ப்பேராயத்திற்குத் தங்களை வரவேற்பதில் பெருமிதம் அடைகிறோம்.
தமிழ்ப்பேராயக் கட்டமைப்பு
பாரிவேந்தர் மாணவர் தமிழ்மன்றம்
சான்றிதழ் படிப்பு
முனைவர் பா.ஜெய்கணேஷ்
செயலர், தமிழ்ப்பேராயம்
தமிழ்ப்பேராயம் என்னும் மாபெரும் அமைப்பானது ஐந்தாம் தமிழ்ச் சங்கமாகப் பல்வேறு பணிகளை ஆற்றிவருகின்றது. மாண்பமை தா. இரா. பாரிவேந்தர்  அவர்களால் உருவாக்கப்பட்ட இந்த அமைப்பானது தமிழின் பெருமையை, சிறப்பை உலக அளவில் பறைசாற்றிக் கொண்டிருக்கின்றது. தமிழ்ப்பேராயத்தின் தலைவர் முனைவர் கரு. நாகராசன் அவர்களின் வழிகாட்டுதலில் மிகச்சிறந்த குழு தமிழ்ப்பேராயப் பணிகளை ஆற்றிவருகின்றது. தமிழ்ப்பேராய விருதுகள் வழங்குதல், சிறந்த நூல்களை வெளியிடுதல், சான்றிதழ்ப் பட்டயப் படிப்புகளை நடத்துதல், கருத்தரங்குகள், பயிலரங்குகள் ஒருங்கிணைத்தல் முதலான பல்வேறு அரிய பணிகளைத் தமிழ்ப்பேராயம் முன்னெடுத்து வருவது பலராலும் பாராட்டப்பட்டு வருகிறது. தமிழ்ப்பேராயத்தின் அங்கமாக பாரிவேந்தர் மாணவர் தமிழ் மன்றமும் பல்வேறு பணிகளை ஆற்றிவருவது குறிப்பிடத்தக்கது. இத்தகைய தமிழ்ப்பேராயத்தின் பக்கத்திற்குத் தங்களைச் செயலர் என்ற முறையில் வரவேற்பதில் மகிழ்கிறேன்.

தமிழ்ப்பேராய விருதுகள்
தமிழகம் எங்குமுள்ள சிறந்த தமிழறிஞர்கள், படைப்பாளிகள், அரசுசார் தமிழமைப்புகளின் தலைவர்கள் ஆகியோர்களைக் கொண்ட குழுக்களின் அறிவுரைகளின்படி தமிழ்ப்பேராயம் இயங்குகிறது. இது விருப்பு, வெறுப்பற்ற நடுநிலையான செயல்பாடுகளைக் கொண்டுள்ளது.
தமிழ்ப்பேராயத்தின் பணித் திட்டங்களில் குறிப்பிடத்தக்க ஒன்று தமிழ்ப்பேராய விருதுகள் திட்டம். 2012 ஆம் ஆண்டு முதல் ஒவ்வோர் ஆண்டும் பன்னிரண்டு தலைப்புகளில் சிறந்த தமிழ் நூல்கள், தமிழறிஞர்கள் மற்றும் சீரிய தமிழ்ப் பணியாற்றும் தமிழ் இதழ்கள் மற்றும் தமிழ்ச் சங்கங்கள் பயன்பெறும் விதத்தில் விருதுகள் வழங்கப்பட்டு வருகின்றன. சாகித்திய அகாடெமி வழங்கும் விருதுகளைவிட அதிக எண்ணிக்கையிலான விருதுகளைக் கொண்டுள்ளது சாகித்திய அகாடெமி வழங்காத, தமிழ்ப்பேரறிஞருக்கான பாரிவேந்தர் பைந்தமிழ் வாழ்நாள் சாதனையாளர் விருதினையும் தமிழ்ப் பேராயம் வழங்கிவருகின்றது.
இதுவரையில் 2 கோடியே 20 இலட்சம் அளவிலான பரிசுத் தொகை இதற்காக வழங்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.
இதுவரையில் 89 படைப்பாளர்கள் விருது பெற்றுள்ளனர்.

தமிழ்ப்பேராயத்தின் பிற பணிகள்
தமிழில் வழிபாடு நிகழ்த்துவதற்குத் தகுதிவாய்ந்த அர்ச்சகர்களை உருவாக்கும் நோக்கத்தோடு
தமிழ்
அருட்சுனைஞர்
என்கின்ற கல்வி 2011 ஆம் ஆண்டு முதல் தெய்வத்தமிழ் அறக்கட்டளை என்ற அமைப்புடன் இணைந்து நடத்தப்பட்டு வருகின்றது. இதுவரை சுமார் 1200க்கும் மேற்பட்டோர் இப்பயிற்சியை முடித்து ஆங்காங்கு தமிழில் வழிபாடு நடத்தி வருகின்றனர்.
அரிய பல நூல்களை அச்சிடும் பணியையும் தமிழ்ப்பேராயம் தொடர்ந்து மேற்கொண்டு வருகிறது. புலவர் இளங்குமரனார், அறிஞர் தமிழண்ணல் போன்றோர் எழுதிய நூல்களும், சித்த மருத்துவப் பேரறிஞர் சாம்பசிவம் பிள்ளை அவர்கள் எழுதிய நூல்களும் தமிழ்ப்பேராயத்தால் வெளியிடப்பட்டுள்ளன.
சங்க இலக்கியங்களில் பல, உரிய அறிஞர்களின் மூலமாக ஆங்கிலத்தில் மொழிபெயர்க்கப்பட்டுள்ளன.
தொல்காப்பியத்தை மையமாக வைத்து 7 குறுநூல்கள் இதுவரையில் வெளியிடப்பட்டுள்ளன.
ஆண்டுதோறும் தமிழர் திருநாளாம் ‘‘
பொங்கல்
விழா
’’ பல்கலைக் கழகத்திலுள்ள அனைவரும் பங்கேற்கும் விதத்தில் சிறப்பாக நடத்தப்பட்டு வருகிறது. அதுபோல் உலகத் தாய்மொழி தினம், உலகக் கவிதை தினம், அன்னையர் தினம், மகளிர் தினம் ஆகியவற்றுடன் தேசத் தலைவர்கள் மற்றும் தமிழறிஞர்கள் பிறந்த நாட்களும் தமிழ்ப்பேராயத்தால் நடத்தப்பட்டு வருகின்றன.
வாரந்தோறும் திங்கள் மற்றும் வியாழக்கிழமைகளில் ‘‘
சிந்தனை
அரங்கம்
’’ நிகழ்ச்சி இணைய வழியில் நடத்தப்பெற்று வருகிறது. இதுவரை 70 நிகழ்ச்சிகள் நடைபெற்றுள்ளன. தமிழகத்து அறிஞர்கள் மட்டுமின்றி உலகின் பல நாட்டு அறிஞர்களும் அந்நிகழ்ச்சியில் பங்கேற்பது குறிப்பிடத்தக்கது.
மாணவர்களை வளர்த்தெடுக்கும் வகையில் பாரிவேந்தர் மாணவர் தமிழ் மன்றம் என்ற அமைப்பினை உருவாக்கி, மாணவப் படைப்பாளர்களை உருவாக்கும் பணியையும் மேற்கொண்டு வருகின்றது. இந்த மன்றத்தில் ஐந்தாயிரம் மாணவர்கள் உறுப்பினர்களாக இருப்பது குறிக்கத்தக்கது.
வேந்தர்
நெறி
என்ற காலாண்டு இதழும் மன்றத்தின் சார்பில் வெளியிடப்படுகிறது. வாரம்தோறும் மாணவர்கள் பங்கேற்கும் ஆற்றல் அரங்கம் என்ற நிகழ்ச்சியும் தொடர்ந்து நடைபெற்று வருகிறது. ஆய்வுப் படைப்புக்களை வெளியிடும் நோக்கில் ‘‘
செவ்வி
’’ என்ற காலாண்டு ஆய்விதழும் விரைவில் வெளிவரவிருக்கிறது.
தமிழ்
வளர்ச்சியில்
சைவ
ஆதீனங்களின்
பங்கு
’’ என்ற தலைப்பில் ஆய்வுக் கருத்தரங்கம் நடைபெற்றது. அதில் தமிழகத்தின் அனைத்து ஆதீனங்களும் பங்கேற்றனர்.
தமிழ்
வளர்ச்சியில்
வைணவத்தின்
பங்கு
’’ என்னும் தலைப்பில் மாநாடு நடத்தப்பட்டது. 6 ஜீயர்களும் 10 ஆசாரியர்களும் அதில் பங்கேற்று உரையாற்றினர்.
வள்ளல் பெருமானின் 200 ஆம் பிறந்த நாளை முன்னிட்டு “
வள்ளலாரின்
வாழ்வியல்
நெறிகள்
” என்ற தலைப்பில் பன்னாட்டுக் கருத்தரங்கம் நடத்தப்பெற்று அக்கட்டுரைகளின் தொகுப்பு நூலாக வெளியிடப்பட்டது.

About the Department
Established in the year 1993, SRM Institute of Hotel Management or SRM IHM has entered into the 4
decade of service in spreading holistic hospitality education reaping a bountiful harvest of successful alumni all across the globe.
Operating with a vision to achieve excellence in the field of hospitality education and to be the most preferred recruitment destination, SRM IHM emphasizes three ideologies –
Education to Employment, Learning by Doing, and Earning While You Learn.
The curriculum of SRM IHM is framed according to UGC rules and is revamped once every three years which enables the students to learn all the updated trends that are followed in the hotels. “Every branch of SRM IHM is attached to a fully operational hotel that enables the students to get hands-on training. Many leading hotels drive into the campus for interviews and besides hotels cruise lines, retailers and IT sectors also select our students, which yields an impressive 97% in placement.
The branches of SRM hotels are situated at Trichy, Tuticorin, and Ramada at Chennai allowing the students to receive their IET training and also to do their OJT and part-time evening and vacation jobs without any major fuss. Apart from SRM hotels our students also receive their training in intercontinental hotel groups like Intercontinental Hotel Groups, ACCORD, NOVOTEL, TAJ Group of Hotels, Oberoi Hotels, and many more”.

Welcome message
Our institution stands as a beacon of excellence in hospitality education, offering an enriching environment that fosters learning, innovation, and holistic growth. At SRM IHM, we are dedicated to nurturing the next generation of hospitality leaders. Our commitment to providing a world-class education is reflected in our comprehensive curriculum, which combines theoretical knowledge with practical experiences. Through state-of-the-art facilities and industry-aligned programs, we empower our students to excel in the dynamic and diverse field of hospitality.
Our esteemed faculty comprises seasoned professionals and educators who bring a wealth of industry expertise into the classroom. They are committed to guiding and inspiring students, ensuring they gain insights that go beyond textbooks and into the real world of hospitality.
One of the hallmarks of our institution is our emphasis on experiential learning. Students have the opportunity to engage in internships, industry projects, and immersive training programs that equip them with invaluable skills and a deep understanding of the industry’s nuances. These experiences are pivotal in shaping well-rounded professionals ready to tackle the challenges of the hospitality landscape. SRM IHM, believes in a holistic approach to education. Beyond academic excellence, we encourage our students to explore their passions, cultivate leadership qualities, and embrace cultural diversity.
As we continue our journey of excellence, we invite you to be a part of our vibrant community. Whether you’re a prospective student, a parent, or a collaborator in the hospitality industry, we welcome you to explore the myriad opportunities that SRM Institute of Hotel Management has to offer.
Programs Offered
Diploma
The SRM IHM has consistently led the way in delivering high-quality education within the hospitality sector, notably through its prestigious Diploma in Hotel Management and Catering Science program.
Undergraduate
The SRM IHM has consistently established itself as a trailblazer in providing outstanding education in the dynamic field of hospitality, showcasing excellence through its distinguished B.Sc program in Hotel Management.
PG Diploma
The SRM IHM has continually positioned itself as a pioneering force in delivering exceptional education within the ever-evolving realm of hospitality, epitomizing excellence through its distinguished PG Diploma in Culinary Arts.

Teaching environment and quality are central to SRMIST’s capabilities profile. Our Professors are the reason for our continued ability to foster vibrant and value adding learning experiences for our students. The success of our students’ in terms of their learning and overall development enabled by our faculty members is an area of focus of Leadership at SRMIST. Many opportunities are provided to our faculty members to conduct research and engage with the industry in consultancy and other projects. This platform brings to our faculty members an opportunity to expand their knowledge contribution as well as bring those rich experiential inputs to the classrooms and labs, therefore, benefiting our students.

About Us
SRM Medical College
Hospital & Research Centre
SRM is one of the largest multidisciplinary higher educational institutions in India, catering to over 45,000 students across 8 campuses in 5 states.
Imparting education par excellence since 1985, SRM currently offers more than 300 programs in the fields of Engineering & Technology, Medicine, Dentistry and Other Health Sciences, Science & Humanities, Management, Law, Agricultural Sciences, and Hotel Management.
About Us
Pro Vice-Chancellor (MHS) Message
Dr.Nitin M Nagarkar
Pro Vice-Chancellor (MHS)
The SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre is one of the top medical institutions in our country. It is set up in a great environment with a commitment towards excellence in patient care, teaching, research and innovation.
We have the best facilities to produce top-class medical graduates, specialists and super specialists. With the continued support of our SRM leadership, we are aiming to meet global standards in all domains.
Our approach for the hospital is always patient-centric and for teaching and learning, it is student-centric. We always encourage collaborations at the national and international level. We will continue to adopt new technologies for patient care, teaching and cutting-edge research to meet the ever-changing requirements of society.

SRM Central Instrumentation Facility (SCIF)
Home
Research
SCIF
Overview
SRMIST is continually investing and setting up laboratories in addition to enhancing the lab equipments and softwares on a regular basis. As a measure of its commitment to creating meaningful and society uplifting impact, SRMIST is open to collaborating with anybody within SRMIST as well as externally among the industry and academic segment. You are welcome to access this SCIF portal that consolidates the state-of-the-art research facilities available under the Directorate of Research in SRMIST. You may directly put through your request to us to successfully reserve your access to certain facility / equipment at SRMIST.
Dean (Research)
The Head, SRM Central Instrumentation Facility
Email: statcentre@srmist.edu.in.
Welcome to SCIF
The SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST) for over 3 decades now invested in bringing best of the learning and research enablers to its students, scholars and faculty members. SRMIST’s legacy of research excellence and impact has made a mark in the society at large and especially among the industry and government. Faculty members are actively encouraged to undertake high value, world-class research projects from various government and private sector. SRMIST given its legacy and scale of operations is ever so open to contributing to research endeavors of anybody within SRMIST or externally. It gives a great platform for our faculty members and scholars to be of assistance to other fellow researchers from the industry or academia. We welcome you to benefit from the ecosystem SRMIST offers to you and send us your request for our support. We will be more than happy to collaborate with you in so far as offering our facilities and equipments for your research endeavors. Our SCIF wishes you the very best in your research and innovation efforts.

Home
SRM Hostels
All about Student accommodation & facilities
We, at SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University), provide a wide choice in selecting the type or rooms in a hostel to suit every budget, with an aim of providing a decent stay and the best possible learning environment.
The quality of life is one of the most important factors considered by the students deciding to stay in the College/University hostels. By quality, it is not just the rooms but also the overall environment of the University campus. Ours is one of the greenest Campuses’ in the country with all the facilities that are expected from global Universities. The stay at our campus provides a wealth of experience by developing qualities such as camaraderie and social responsibility. Our students comprise a cosmopolitan mix from all parts of India as well as many countries across the globe.
The students staying at SRM hostels are provided with healthy and sumptuous food options at highly subsidized rates. They can choose to have North Indian or South Indian menu in the dining halls that are co-located. For the benefit of our international students, the hostels also offer a multi-cuisine dining facility providing Thai, Chinese and continental food.
Life on campus helps the students not only to study but also to socialize with the peers. Friendships formed on the campus last a lifetime. SRM provides a comfortable and safe housing to all its students. The students housed in the campus are encouraged to use the gymnasium, playground, and all indoor gaming facilities.
Dr. E. Poovammal
Professor and Director (Hostels)
Directorate of Hostels
SRMIST-KTR Campus
director.hostels@srmist.edu.in
+91 9940036021
Director's Message
As per our Founder Chancellor’s wish, the mission of our directorate  is to provide a safe, supportive, and comfortable living environment that fosters academic success and personal growth of every SRMISTian.
We encourage you to take care of the hostel facilities and report any concerns or needs for improvements.  Should you have any personal, academic, or social concerns, our hostel staff, including Wardens and support personnel, are always available to assist.
We also encourage students to participate in the various cultural, recreational, and educational activities hosted by the Directorate throughout the year.
A hostel is not a place: It is a state of mind- open, adventurous and full of possibilities

How and When to Apply?
Application for admission to the hostel for the first year and renewal for subsequent years should be made online through
https://sp.srmist.edu.in
only.
Online hostel booking schedules for first year students will be communicated directly and for senior students, it will be announced through the student’s portal well in advance.

Every student should submit an undertaking before occupying the hostel that he/she will abide by the rules and regulations of the hostels and the discipline policy in force.

Students who have failed and are not re-admitted as regular students
Students enrolled in a part-time, evening course, correspondence or any external course of study
Students penalized for indiscipline activities
Working men / women and ex-students

CACR | Research Wings - SRMIST
Skip to content
Centre for Advanced Concrete Research (CACR)
Home
Research
Research Wings
CACR
Overview
Centre for Advanced Concrete Research (CACR) at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Kattankulathur was started in the year 2010, to carry out interdisciplinary research in the field of concrete, a most common material of construction in any built environment and a basic necessity for accelerated economic development. At present, Portland cement is very widely used as binder in concretes. But, the high content of ‘Embodied Carbon Dioxide’ (ECO2) and ‘Embodied Energy’ in the cement are the major reasons for recent laboratory studies all over the world to find alternate binders, as there is an urgent need for making the constructions more eco-friendly and sustainable.
The Research and Development activities in this area are therefore taken as main focus of the newly formed Centre. Towards this, use of industrial wastes (such as slags, fly ash, etc.,) along with modern materials (such as nano-silica, nano-cellulose fibres, nano-alumina, etc.,) would be explored using recent developments occurring in the fields of science and technology such as nano-technology, bio-technology, chemical engineering, including usage of modern analytical instruments such as XRD, various spectroscopes, DTA/TGA, etc.,
Objectives
To identify the improvements/modifications desired in the existing conventional concrete construction practices.
To develop new materials of construction with lower 'carbon foot prints' and reduced 'embodied energy contents'
To formulate guidelines for ecofriendly constructions.
To undertake sponsored investigation studies to find solutions for specific field problems in construction industry from considerations of selection of appropriate materials and disposals of waste/by-products from industry.
To perform all type of consultancy works on concrete especially mechanical studies, durability studies, non-destructive testing studies etc.,
To conduct seminars/workshops/advanced courses to disseminate the latest knowledge in the field of concrete composites.
Dr. P.R. Kannan Rajkumar
Co-Ordinator
Phone/Extn:  1478
Email:  kannanrp@srmist.edu.in
Welcome to CACR
In over 12 years since the inception of the Center for Advanced Concrete Research (CACR) at SRMIST, there have been breakthrough research conducted by many scholars and students. CACR is amongst most advanced lab facilities in the campus. With such rapid shift occuring in the industry today, it is imperative for CACR to stay ahead. With the support of the Leadership team at SRMIST, we at CACR have been able to take up research areas and themes that are cutting edge and futuristic.
We welcome you all to our center and we look forward to exploring how we can work tigether.
Meet Our Staff
Research Areas
Concrete technology, high performance concretes (HPCs), mix design methodologies
Repair techniques/materials for resisting corrosion of embedded steel and for enhanced durability of concrete
Use of wastes such as fly ash, silica fume, blast furnace slag, rice husk, etc
Concrete technology, high performance concretes (HPCs), mix design methodologies
Repair techniques/materials for resisting corrosion of embedded steel and for enhanced durability of concrete
Use of wastes such as fly ash, silica fume, blast furnace slag, rice husk, etc
Fly ash aggregates (replacements for crushed stone aggregate concretes)
Low energy intensive geopolymeric cement concretes
Ultra high performance concretes (reaction powder concretes)
Paver/building blocks with special properties such abrasion resistance (for industrial floorings and container handling areas of harbours/ports)
Nanotechnology in constructions (nanosilica, nanocellulose fibres, nanocarbon fibres, etc for enhanced structural and durability of concretes)
Ferrocement elements with conventional resistant geopolymer concrete
High temperature resistant geopolymer and Portland cement concretes
Zero-Portland cement constructions using inorganic alumino silicate binders
Natural fibre reinforced concretes (bamboo, coconut fibres, etc)
Bacterial concretes or bio-concretes (for improving durability of existing and new concrete constructions, repair/strengthening of deteriorated/damaged monuments
Special concretes for nuclear waste disposal systems
Use of special industrial wastes such as copper slag in nuclear concretes
Self curing concretes for constructions
Carbonation studies on cement concrete and geopolymer concrete
Electrical characterizations in geopolymer and Portland cement composites
Corrosion residence special cement containing specially identified chemical admixture
Early traffic worthy concretes for fast construction and repair of roads
Self curing and acid resistant new concretes for floorings/linings/tiles etc
Self curing ecofriendly concretes for quick repair/strengthening
Shock/blast/vibration resistant structural components
Development of Electrical equipment for characterisation/evaluation of concrete microstructure
Ferrocement technology with new reinforcements and binder systems
Carbon/glass fibre reinforced plastic rods for aggressive environments
Aerated/foamed lightweight concretes with new binder systems
Quick mould release concretes for precast components
Prestressed concrete sleepers for railways with new binders
Funded Projects
There are various ongoing and past collaborations with the higher education and allied research segment. Especially for the funded projects, SRMIST has proven to be a committed and reliable partner given the high degree of academic excellence and research vigour of our faculty and scholars.
Funded Projects & Consultancy

Edit Content
Geopolymer Concrete is a zero cement concrete which replaces cement by industrial byproducts such as flyash, GGBS along with Sodium Hydroxide and Sodium Silicate as alkali precursors and other constituent materials such as M Sand and Coarse Aggregate. Geopolymer Concrete helps in reducing global warming and CO
emissions which are produced during cement production process. The Targeted Compressive Strength of 30 MPa has been achieved in 14 days with only ambient air curing (no water curing) in this construction. The cost of geopolymer concrete is almost similar to conventional cement concrete. Following Three Sustainable Goals has been achieved while constructing this building,
Goal 9 – Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and foster innovation.
Goal 11 – Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable.
Goal 12 – Ensure sustainable consumption and production patterns.
Advantages of Geopolymer Concrete is that there is no need of water curing, no cement used, strength can be achieved in shorter period of time.

Library
Overview
SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University) has an excellent library for the benefit of students, faculties and researchers. As one of the best established libraries according to International Standards, the University Central Library has a large collection of Text and Reference books covering various branches of Engineering and Technology, Medical & Health Sciences, and Science & Humanities and its related fields. The library is nearly three decades old. It is completely automated with RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) technology, Centralized Air Conditioned (AC), well protected with CCTV Security systems and fire alarms.
Resources
Incredible collection of knowledge resources across print, online, digital archives, back-volumes, proceedings, thesis & dissertations, UG/PG & Faculty Projects, etc

SRM Library
SRMIST’s Central Library is a one of it’s kind installation that facilitates teaching, learning and research endeavors of our students, scholars and faculty members. It is one of the foremost such libraries in India’s higher educational system. Our Founder and Chancellor Dr. T. R. Paarivendhar’s signature efforts are evident in making sure that the sprawling 1.50 Lakh sq ft area library premises is not just a building structure that stores books. It serves more realistically as a space for learning and knowledge exchange with users coming from diverse study and aspirational backgrounds.
For a large multidisciplinary higher educational institution, SRMIST’s Central Library is a crown jewel housed in the iconic University Building (UB Block).

Uniquely large space for learning, collaboration, exchange. We strive to make our library premises a favorite locations in the campus. We see ourselves as enabers to help our users advance in their learning and knowledge aspirations.
Building
The library is located in the 15-Storey University Administrative Block, and is spread over Ground + 3 floors of 1.50 Lakh sq ft area. The library building is

Floor Map

Automation & Services
All operations and services of the library has been automated with RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) technology using Windows based
In-House software
developed by a team of programmers and the Library Staff of SRM Institute of Science and Technology. It operates on Windows 2000 server, Oracle with J2EE. The software has excellent operational modules such as transaction, query, administration, reporting modules etc.
An OPAC (Online Public Access Catalogue) has been created and about 17 terminals are provided to facilitate access. It is also made available via LAN in the campus.

SRMIST MoUs | Strategic Collaborations with Global Universities & Industry Leaders

Memorandum of Understanding (MoU)
SRMIST is committed to fostering global partnerships that enhance educational, research, and cultural exchange. Our Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with leading universities, research institutions, and industry partners worldwide reflect this commitment. These strategic alliances enable us to offer our students and faculty unparalleled opportunities for growth, innovation, and collaboration.
Home
SRMIST Memorandum of Understanding (MoU)
About
The Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) at SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST) plays a pivotal role in shaping our global and national collaborations. These strategic partnerships with leading academic institutions, research centers, and industry giants enable SRMIST to elevate its educational and research endeavors.
Through a network of MoUs that stretches across the globe, SRMIST ensures that our students and faculty are integrated into an international academic community. These partnerships provide invaluable opportunities for global exposure, cross-cultural experiences, and access to cutting-edge resources and expertise, enriching the university’s academic and research landscape.
Previous
Next
Strategic Collaborations
SRMIST’s MoUs are designed to foster mutually beneficial relationships that contribute to academic growth, research advancements, and societal impact. These collaborations enable us to:
Expand Academic Opportunities
Joint degree programs, student and faculty exchanges, and specialized training courses to provide a global academic perspective.
Enhance Research Capabilities
Collaborative research projects that push the boundaries of knowledge, leading to groundbreaking discoveries.
Facilitate Industry Engagement
Partnerships with industry leaders to offer hands-on experience, internships, and real-world problem-solving opportunities.
Promote Innovation
Encouraging innovation through joint ventures in technology development, intellectual property, and entrepreneurship initiatives.

Board of Studies
Composition, Constitution and Functions
The Board of Studies (BoS) is the basic constituent of the academic system of an Institute. It is responsible for framing the content of various courses, reviewing and updating the content from time to time, introducing new courses of study etc.
Composition Of Board Of Studies
The Head of the Department as Chairman.
Professor / Associate Professor / Assistant Professor of the Department.
One subject expert (ACADEMIC) nominated by the Dean (CET) on the recommendation of the Head of concerned Department.
Experts should be from (i) IISc / IITs / NITs / other reputed academic Institutions (Government / Aided)
One subject expert (R&D / INDUSTRY) nominated by the Dean (CET) on the recommendation of the Head of concerned Department.
Experts should be from Central / State Organization / R&D labs or from the Industry
In addition to the above members, One Senior Alumni (ACADEMIC / R&D / INDUSTRY) to be co-opted by the BoS nominated by the Dean (CET) in consultation with Head of the Department. (Alumni Members should be at least 5 years of experience in the relevant field).
One or two Student members studying in the department.
Constitution And Functions Of Board Of Studies
The BoS shall be constituted by the department for a period of THREE years.
The meetings of the BoS shall be arranged at least TWICE IN A YEAR.
The members of the BoS will be nominated by the Dean (CET)  from the expect list  recommended by the Head of the department.
In the absence of the Chairman (BoS), the senior member of the BoS will act as Chairman with the Dean CET’s approval.
Functions of the Board of Studies:
Prepare curriculum for the programme by keeping in mind the Programme Educational Objectives.
Prepare syllabi for various courses based on the course outcomes, programme outcomes and the objectives of the programme, interest of the stakeholders and national requirement for consideration and submitting for approval in the Academic Council.
Suggest methodologies for innovative teaching and evaluation techniques.
Ensure the updation of state of the art research, adoption of technology for enabling better teaching learning methodologies and other best academic practices into the curriculum and syllabus.

About the College
The
Bachelor of Physiotherapy degree
in SRM College of Physiotherapy was started in the year 1993, under The Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University. In 1999,
Master of Physiotherapy
was started under The Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University. In the year 2005, the SRM College of Physiotherapy has been brought under the ambit of the SRM Institute of Science & Technology (MHRD NO. F 9 – 47/2004 – U.3, dated 28 January 2005).
The Institution is headed by Prof. T. S. Veeragoudhaman, Dean with well-qualified and experienced faculty members. The head of the Institution and the faculty members work effectively as a team. The strongly bonded team delivers high standard of care, learning new skills from other team members by working together and off each other.
The ability to move is as vital as life. No one knows this better than those specially trained by the SRM College of Physiotherapy. With active involvement in the community, student’s skills are enhanced to study and rehabilitate the movement of others.
The College of Physiotherapy has an experienced faculty team that specializes in orthopedics, sports physiotherapy, neurology, pediatrics, biomechanics, cardiopulmonary sciences, hand rehabilitation, community rehabilitation, and obstetrics and gynaecology. Emphasis on interactive learning ensures that every student gains an interest in the science of physical movement and participates wholeheartedly in the theoretical and clinical sessions.

Welcome message
Welcome to SRM College of Physiotherapy. It is an excellent choice to attain your education for a successful career. We are proud of our Green campus university. It provides educational opportunities for students from all backgrounds and locations. Our faculties are drawn from distinguished academia having international exposure and are reputed professionals from leading industries. It strikes the right balance between the theoretical and practical components that are benchmarked against industry standards and cover all spheres of physiotherapy. Our program is designed to meet the needs of the ever-evolving new challenges in the industry. The curriculum emphasizes skill-based experiential learning through compulsory academic projects and internship under leading physiotherapy entities across the nation. The centre offers its students hands-on training to be industry ready with well-equipped state-of-the-art laboratories. The College of Physiotherapy, SRM Institute of Science and Technology, is a pioneer among physiotherapy colleges, in terms of student strength and academic infrastructure. It nurtures growing students to reach the realm of success; it is well-equipped with state-of-art infrastructure, qualified and friendly teaching staff and a brand name that has given the right fillip to its growth. You have found the right place to learn, Lead and leap in your career through SRM College of Physiotherapy. Welcome!!!

Placement
Physiotherapy is a profession that offers a diverse range of career paths and opportunities for specializing in various areas. We are proud of our ability to arrange placements in a range of nations, including the US,UK, Ireland, Dubai, Australia, New Zealand and  Canada . These accomplishments serve as evidence of the commitment and diligence of our alumni, demonstrating their contributions to the advancement of the field on an international level. Our former undergraduate students have obtained work in a range of Government and Private  hospitals and private physiotherapy clinics.
In addition, our alumni have demonstrated remarkable initiative and determination by not only creating their own businesses in but also pursuing academic positions in diverse sectors. The dual representation effectively showcases the diverse abilities and accomplishments of our graduates. A vital cog in any medical team, a physiotherapist provide patients with disabilities, a reason to live. The institution assists in placing every successful student with a suitable remuneration package in leading organizations and industries.
Faculty
Teaching environment and quality are central to SRMIST’s capabilities profile. Our professors are the reason for our continued ability to foster vibrant and value adding learning experiences for our students. The success of our students in terms of their learning and overall development enabled by our faculty members is an area of focus of leadership at SRMIST. Many opportunities are provided to our faculty members to conduct research and engage with the industry in consultancy and other projects. This platform brings to our faculty members an opportunity to expand their knowledge contribution as well as bring those rich experiential inputs to the classrooms and labs therefore benefiting our students.

Eligibility for BCA is based on SRMIST admission norms and the academic criteria specified for the program.
What is the duration of the BCA program?
BCA is typically offered as a 3-year undergraduate program.
What subjects are included in the BCA curriculum?
The BCA curriculum generally includes programming, databases, software development, computer fundamentals, and application-oriented computing subjects.
What are the career opportunities after BCA?
Career opportunities can include roles in software support, web development, application development, testing, IT operations, and analytics support.
How do I apply for BCA at the Faculty of Science & Humanities, SRMIST?
You can apply for BCA through the official Faculty of Science & Humanities,l SRMIST admissions/application process listed on the program page.

Value Education Cell
The Value Education Cell at our university seeks to instil various initiatives to inspire and empower students and staffs to embrace universal human values, applying them in their personal and professional lives.
Home
Value Education Cell
SRMIST - Value Education Cell (VEC)
SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST) recognizes the urgent need to nurture socially responsible, self-aware, and harmonious individuals through holistic value-based education. This aligns with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 and the Universal Human Values (UHV) framework recommended by AICTE. The Value Education Cell (VE Cell) is established to coordinate this transformative agenda at all levels of the university ecosystem.
UHV Introductory Completed
UHV-I Completed Faculty Members
UHV-II Completed Faculty Members
National & Regional Level Volunteers
Total Self-Funded FDP/MDP
AICTE Sponsored FDP
UHV Conference Hosted
Vision
The Value Education Cell at SRMIST envision to evolve the university from value education to value-based education and value-based living. Its long-term vision is to develop SRMIST as a model university, a national nodal centre, and a global resource hub for value education. The Cell aims to create a supportive and transformative learning environment through self-exploration, where students develop academic excellence alongside a deep sense of social responsibility. By building a campus culture rooted in
Satya
(realization of truth),
Karuna
(compassion), and
Prema
(love for all), the Cell aspires to contribute to holistic societal transformation and uphold universal human values in all aspects of life.
Mission
The Mission of the Value Education Cell is to integrate value education seamlessly into the core fabric of the University’s Academic, curricular, co-curricular, extra-curricular (extension) and administrative activities by 2030. The Cell strives to create an environment of meaningful relationships through personal transformation among students, faculty, and staff, with the aim of promoting holistic development and a shared commitment to universal values by 2030.
Motto
The SRMIST Value Education Cell, with its
Motto ‘Wellbeing for All,
’ is committed to promoting Holistic Value-Based Education, not just within the university but extending it to the broader community.
Individual
Develop a Right understanding towards the clarity on the purpose of life and help oneself to identify their basic aspirations.
To enhance Self-Awareness, engage in Self-Directed Learning, and build Self-Confidence.
Family
Positively influenced people with Right Feeling such as Empathy, Compassion, Trust and respect for all. To improve relationships within their own families and their college communities, facilitating effective conflict resolution.
Society
Cultivates responsible individuals inclined towards positive societal contributions, development of personal traits like Humility, Integrity, and Adaptability.
To bring in a collective culture of fearless society and nurtures a harmonious and thriving community.
Nature
Focus on nature and coexistence, yields impactful outcomes such as Environmentally responsible practices, sustainability.
To adopt the best environmental practices, nurturing harmony between human activities and the natural world.
Dr. Supraja P
UHV - University Coordinator
uhv@srmist.edu.in
Welcome to Value Education Cell
Value education remains a significant need of the hour in today’s world. In the digital age, individuals navigate through this abundance of information and bombarded with information and get influenced easily. Technological advancements, medical breakthroughs, and social changes often create dilemmas. The fast-paced and competitive nature of modern life can lead to stress and mental health issues.
Education should help an individual to develop clarity on understanding (what to do?) & learning skills (how to do?) and practicing the understanding & skills will lead towards the fulfillment of human purpose.
As societies become more diverse, value education fosters inclusivity, respect for everyone and towards everything and promotes social cohesion and harmony.
Value education emphasizes the importance of self-regulation and equips individuals with the process of self-exploration it plays a crucial role in preventing social issues like violence, substance abuse, and discrimination and helps individuals to analyse and respond to these situations.
The value education helps
To develop the Right understanding of the self
To live with the feeling of a relationship with the human being leads to mutual happiness.
To live in a relationship with rest-of-nature leads to mutual prosperity.
The Value Education Cell at our university is to foster the holistic development of individuals by nurturing a strong foundation of values that will guide them throughout their lives. Over a period of time, such value-based education can contribute to the development of a humane society.
I invite all members of the university community to actively participate in the initiatives and activities of the Value Education Cell. Your contribution and commitment are vital in shaping the values-based learning environment we aspire to create. Let’s join hands to build a compassionate and socially responsible community and work together toward holistic development.
With warm regards,
Supraja
Core members
Coordinators
Resources & Useful Links
Newsletter
Impact Dashboard
Objectives
Promoting Universal Human Values:
The primary objective is to promote and instil universal human values such as Co-existence, Harmony and feelings of relationship, prosperity, self-regulation, social responsibility and mutual fulfilment with rest of the nature among, faculty, and staff.
Curriculum Integration
: Integrating value-based education modules into the university’s curriculum across various disciplines, ensuring that students are exposed to values considerations in their academic pursuits.
Solution centric approach
: Providing guidance and training to students in making decisions for fulfilling life, equipping them to navigate complex situations with integrity.
Social Awareness and Empathy
: Creating awareness about social issues and encouraging students to empathize with others’ experiences, leading to a deeper understanding of diverse perspectives and participate into societal transformation though foundational systems
Cultivating Responsible Citizenship
: Instilling a sense of responsibility towards oneself, family, society and nature  and motivating them to actively contribute to just and equitable society.
Inclusivity and Diversity
: Promoting an inclusive campus culture that embraces diversity, and promote intercultural understanding, fostering a sense of unity and harmony among the university community.
Leadership Development:
Offering leadership development programs that emphasize the world-view, world-view, human values and through human conduct
Faculty Development:
Offer training and development opportunities for faculty members to effectively impart value-based teachings in their classrooms and mentor students on  Understanding the concepts (proposal) through self-investigation.
Student Development:
Organize workshops, seminars, and events that promote character development and human consciousness among students.
Community Engagement
: Encouraging students to participate in community service, volunteering, and outreach activities to cultivate a sense of responsibility towards the society they live in.
Research and Advocacy
: Conducting research on value education, ethics, and social issues, and advocating for the integration of universal human values in education and beyond.
Collaboration and Partnerships
: Collaborating with other departments, student organizations, NGOs and external partners to create a holistic approach to leverage knowledge and resources for a broader impact

Multidisciplinary Research
SRM Institute of Science and Technology is actively engaged in multidisciplinary research involving the School of Bio Engineering, School of Civil Engineering, School of Electrical Sciences and School of Mechanical Engineering – Mechatronics – Microbiology and Pathology of SRM Medical College.
Population Health Registry - In Collaboration with Queen's University, Canada
SRM Institute of Science and Technology entered into an MOU with Queen’s University, Ontario, Canada on 15th Feb 2006 for a collaborative Project work towards developing a Population Health Registry. When completed, this registry will be comprehensive and geo-referenced to capture the key demographic and environmental data of 60 villages surrounding SRM over a period of three years. It is expected to be a research tool capable of tracking patients longitudinally and spatially, with the capacity to examine environmental correlates of various diseases.
This project is very unique because of its multidisciplinary nature involving active participation of the Departments of Community Medicine, Public Health & Epidemiology, Information Technology, Medical admissions/ records (hospitals), GIS/ Civil Engineering, Medical Microbiology, School of Public Health and Nursing.
Dr. A.R. Chandrasekaran, Faculty – Dept.of Community Medicine is the Principal and the piloting is currently in progress in two villages.

About SRMCAS
SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST) established the Faculty of Agricultural Sciences at Main campus, Kattankulathur by starting B.Sc. (Hons.) Horticulture degree program in 2018 and B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture degree program in 2019 which was approved by the Board of Mangement. Later, in 2021 the Faculty of Agricultural Sciences was shifted to Baburayanpettai, Chengalpattu District and started functioning as SRM College of Agricultural Sciences (SRMCAS) in an area of 400+ acres, which is 68 km from the Main campus SRMIST, Kattankulathur, by covering the urban, semi-urban, and rural areas.
