Vision
Emerge as an International Institution to provide science based agricultural education and related process to younger generation both in rural and urban sectors for Youth – led Agriculture in India to revolutionise Agriculture as a way of business.
Mission
Empower younger generation in quality agricultural education to learn cutting – edge farming technologies to address the needs of different stakeholders viz., farmers, employers, industries and society.
Strengthen higher education in Agriculture/Horticulture on par with international standards for innovative research, teaching and extension
Promote advanced technologies including Artificial Intelligence, Hi-tech Agriculture/Horticulture, digital agriculture, climate smart farming to ensure sustainability in production and productivity
Effectively transfer technology from lab to land to ensure water and food security, augment farmers income and standard of living of the farming community
Dr. M. Jawaharlal
Dean
Welcome message
The overall mission of the College of Agricultural Sciences is to provide knowledge and support for teaching, conducting research and capacity-building on the principles and practices for climate-smart, sustainable agriculture to produce healthy food with higher factor productivity and livelihood security. It is with a sense of commitment that our Founder & Chancellor Dr. T R Paarivendhar has personally seen to it that we empower and benefit farm community and food sector at large through extension research, pedagogy that engages students and researchers with on-field experience and lab facilities par excellence to generate pathbreaking interventions.

Career Centre Is The Center Point Of Career Development, Interpersonal Skills And Placement Activities. The Placement Cell Of SRM College Of Agricultural Sciences Comes Under The Umbrella Of Career Centre SRM IST At Kattankulathur, Chennai. The Career Centre Is A Target Recruiting Ground For All Major Recruiters And Has Strong Linkages With The Industry And Is Highly Regarded By Employers. The Placement Cell Provides Various Platforms For The Industry And Institute To Collaborate With Each Other For Mutual Benefit. The Excellent Infrastructure In The Placement Cell Of SRM CAS Facilitates The Recruitment Activities Like Preplacement Talks, Written Tests, Group Discussions, And Interviews As Per The Requirements Of The Recruiting Organizations.
It Is Our Prime Focus To Make All Our Students Industry-Ready. The Placement Cell Of SRM CAS Plays A Vital Role In Making SRM A Favoured Destination For Many Organizations To Recruit Fresh Talent Nurtured At The Institute.  The Career Centre Besides, Placement And Training Holds Workshops, Events, Conferences, Talks By Experts, Internships, And Industrial Visits To Enable Students To Be Up-To-Date With Contemporary Trends And Be ‘Market Ready’ By The Time Of Graduation. Agroecology
Agroecology is an integrated approach that simultaneously applies ecological and social concepts and principles to the design and management of food and agricultural systems. It seeks to optimize the interactions between plants, animals, humans and the environment while taking into consideration the social aspects that need to be addressed for a sustainable and fair food system. More recently, agroecology has entered the discourse of international and UN institutions. Realizing the importance of the subject SRMIST has included agroecology in the curriculum of the UG programmes in Agriculture and Horticulture. A new course “Introduction to Agroecology” has been introduced for both horticulture and agriculture programmes for the first time in India.
Crop Health
A new division of Crop Health is being introduced wherein, the following subjects are brought under: Plant Biochemistry, Crop Physiology, Agricultural Entomology, Plant Pathology, Soil Fertility and Weed Management which are related to the well-being and growth of the crops.

Community Centers
Home
Life at SRM
Student Life
Community Centers
Giving back to the Community
Students are initiated into community service at SRM, and are encouraged to actively participate in the many social initiatives such as Annsh – the school for drop-outs, Butterflies project – the cultural and sports forum for underprivileged children etc.
ANNSH School
A school for school dropouts and children of construction workers, 32 children in various age groups study in this school. Located within the SRM campus, the school is run by the students and classes are conducted in the evening hours.
Butterflies Project
Started “to inspire change among the underprivileged”, underprivileged children from 25 government and private schools in and around the SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University) at Kattankulathur are invited on specific days and sports, literary and cultural events are conducted to nurture their talents.
The children are given an opportunity to perform and showcase their skills, and are inspired to aim higher. The fun and celebration at these events helps improve the children’s enthusiasm and enhance their competitiveness.
The Butterflies Project is also an excellent platform for the children to interact with the SRM students and share their hopes and dreams. It brings about a transformation in the children – and in the students too – encouraging them to dream bigger and reach higher.
NGO Canteen
This canteen inside the SRM campus is run by a women’s self help group in the women’s hostel. It is managed under guidance from ‘Hand in Hand’, an NGO (Non-Government Organization).
The Impact on Students
These community initiatives inside the SRM campus, also benefit students in many ways. It gives them an opportunity to
Participate in student community service projects
Attain personal fulfillment
Develop strong leadership skills & self-esteem
Develop a sense of responsibility
Discover their own ability to make a difference - now and in the future

College/ University campus is a place to find valuable friendship and to cherish unforgettable moments. We, here at SRM strongly condemn any kind of ragging practices. Our students welcome the freshers with flowers and advices and they do not believe in violence or unhealthy practices. Our faculty members impart good values with education and that is what set SRM apart.
What constitutes Ragging
Ragging constitutes one or more of any of the following acts :
any conduct by any student or students whether by words spoken or written or by an act which has the effect of teasing, treating or handling with rudeness a fresher or any other student;
indulging in rowdy or indisciplined activities by any student or students which causes or is likely to cause annoyance, hardship, physical or psychological harm or to raise fear or apprehension thereof in any fresher or any other student;
asking any student to do any act which such student will not in the ordinary course do and which has the effect of causing or generating a sense of shame, or torment or embarrassment so as to adversely affect the physique or psyche of such fresher or any other student;
any act by a senior student that prevents, disrupts or disturbs the regular academic activity of any other student or a fresher;
exploiting the services of a fresher or any other student for completing the academic tasks assigned to an individual or a group of students.
any act of financial extortion or forceful expenditure burden put on a fresher or any other student by students;
any act of physical abuse including all variants of it: sexual abuse, homosexual assaults, stripping, forcing obscene and lewd acts, gestures, causing bodily harm or any other danger to health or person;
any act or abuse by spoken words, emails, post, public insults which would also include deriving perverted pleasure, vicarious or sadistic thrill from actively or passively participating in the discomfiture to fresher or any other student
any act that affects the mental health and self-confidence of a fresher or any other student with or without an intent to derive a sadistic pleasure or showing off power, authority or superiority by a student over any fresher or any other student.
Actions Suggested by AICTE against students indulging and abetting in Ragging
The punishment to be meted out to the persons indulged in ragging has to be exemplary and justifiably harsh to act as a deterrent against recurrence of such incidents. The students who are found to be indulged in ragging should be debarred from taking admission in any technical institution in India.
Every single incident of ragging a First Information Report (FIR) must be filed without exception by the institutional authorities with the local police authorities.
Depending upon the nature and gravity of the offence as established by the Anti-Ragging Committee of the institution, the possible punishments for those found guilty of ragging at the institution level shall be any one or any combination of the following.
Cancellation of admission
Suspension from attending classes
Withholding/withdrawing scholarship/fellowship and other benefits
Debarring from appearing in any test/examination or other evaluation process
Withholding results
Debarring from representing the institution in any regional, national or international meet, tournament, youth festival, etc.
Suspension/expulsion from the hostel
Rustication from the institution for period ranging from 1 to 4 semesters
Expulsion from the institution and consequent debarring from admission to any other institution.
Fine of Rupees 25,000/-
Collective punishment: when the persons committing or abetting the crime of ragging are not identified, the institution shall resort to collective punishment as a deterrent to ensure community pressure on the potential raggers.
The institutional authority shall intimate the incidents of ragging occurred in their premises along with actions taken to the Council immediately after occurrence of such incident and inform the status of the case from time to time.
Courts should make an effort to ensure that cases involving ragging are taken up on priority basis to send the correct message that ragging is not only to be discouraged but also to be dealt with sternness.
Do not be a victim or witness
Say No to Ragging

content:
EQRC | Research Wings - SRMIST
Skip to content
Earthquake Research Cell (EQRC)
Home
Research
Research Wings
EQRC
Overview
SRMIST established an Earthquake Research cell (EQRC) in July 2012 for Advanced Research on the causes for origin, occurrence and prediction of Earthquake by better understanding the geodynamical behavior of this natural disaster on the globe. Further to establish the non-plate tectonics causes for the earthquake through re-looking into the existing causes and to develop computer simulation model for geodynamic character, prediction, prevention and management model to reduce the damages on the Earth.
Vision
To be a Global Centre of Excellence in Earthquake Research, Disaster Management and Mitigation studies
Mission
To be a leading Centre for Earthquake Research of international repute for the investigation of Geodynamic activity.
To enhance the knowledge based on research, education and information transfer to reduce the damages through systematic understanding of seismological characters.
To provide capacity building to mitigate future earthquake scenario for better planning and development.
Dr. R. Sivakumar
Co-ordinator
Phone:  044 - 27455510, 47437500
Email: eqr.cell.ktr@srmist.edu.in
Welcome to EQRC
SRMIST is among the first few institutions in the country to establish the Earthquake Research Centre, thanks to the foresight of our Founder & Chancellor Dr. T R Paarivendhar. Our Centre’s focus in terms of geographic regions are Sikkim – Darjeeling, Himalaya region in the North East, Andaman Region (islands in the Bay of Bengal), Ponnair Basin area in the South and Gujarat in the West. We have 12 themes that we are actively pursuing at EQRC, SRMIST. The Researchers are senior and tenured specialists in various practice areas who contribute to the furthering of our research activity. Our students and scholars who get to work at our EQRC stand to benefit immensely from our senior Faculty Members’ guidance and applied (on-the-field) learning. At EQRC, it is our endeavor to accomplish breakthrough research and contribute new ideas, concepts and solutions.
Dr. S. S. Sridhar
Professor, Department of Computing Technologies,
SRMIST
Research Theme
Our research themes allow us to build on our existing strengths and invest in novel complementary areas. EQRC’s advantage is that our research is not confined to our center and there is a sizable proportion of our centre’s activity involving work on-field. Major themes of our research are as follows:
Seismic hazard assessment
Active tectonic study - Identification of Active fault zones.
Geomorphic and morphotectonic anomaly- analysis of geomorphic indices, paleo-seismic evidences
Crustal deformation studies and development of deformation model and 3D visualization.
Analysis of epicenter data and prediction through ANN model.
Quantification of seismic energy and simulation model
Mathematical model  through continuum / regression model.
Remote sensing based surface fault mapping and geotectonic analysis.
GIS based seismic database creation.
Development of customized Seismic Information System.
Designing seismic resistant structures.
Disaster planning and Management
Focused Areas
Sikkim- Darjeeling Himalaya, N-E region
Andaman Region
Ponnair basin, South India
Gujarat, western India
Research Highlights
Facilities
Our world-class facilities make SRMIST one of the India’s best universities for research and study. SRMIST is lead by the visionary Founder and Chancellor who has embedded research orientation and have supported us through investing in a wide range of facilities and resources to support our cutting-edge research. Whether it is subscription to internationally important knowledge inputs and reference material to state of the art labs, we have it all at our EQRC. Corporate Organizations and academics are invited to make use of our facilities and research services, including using our labs and equipment and consultancy services. Following is a selection of our research facilities

Publications & Patents
The experiential insights and research outcomes are often carried for publication in the nationally and internationally renouned Journals. Our researchers get to submit and present papers among the specialists from across the world on specialized topics connected to Earthquake Research. SRMIST is a platform for anybody seeking to create a dent through their commitment and hard work as we can count on some of the most valuable and best research ecosystem. This automatically means there are so many opportunities to pick, prepare and submit papers. We are proud that our faculty members and alumni have published book-chapters and books that are often reference literature to the current day students and research scholars worldwide. Semester Abroad Program | Outward Mobility - SRMIST
Skip to content
Semester Abroad Program
Home
International Relations
Outward Mobility
Semester Abroad Program
Overview
SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University) is recognized across the country for its high standards of education, exciting opportunities and excellent placement. To maintain its top position, the University is spearheading with Semester Abroad Program (SAP), a unique initiative providing its students an international exposure and global opportunities. This, we believe, is the first of its kind in India.
Under the Semester Abroad Program the students are allowed to take-up a few courses and /or a Major project in reputed foreign universities for ONE semester. The credits earned in the foreign university through the SAP will be translated into SRM credits, by an approved conversion procedure, and taken for consideration for the award of the degree by SRMIST. After the study period at a foreign university the students return to SRMIST to continue with the degree program for which they were enrolled, and after fulfilling all the necessary conditions laid out in the regulations of SRMIST, the student will become eligible for the award of the degree.
The benefits derived from SAP
Provides an unique opportunity to gain international learning and living experience
Brighten the career opportunities both in India and Overseas
Get an opportunity to work with eminent professors of the universities and upon proving their mettle stand a good chance of getting direct admission to subsequent higher studies in that university or in other universities.
Get an opportunity to work in cross-cultural, multi-national environment.
Acquire or improve self-confidence and independency
Fulfills one’s life time ambition to stay ahead at the top
Who can apply ?
The students who are doing their Bachelors degree as well as the Masters degree in any faculty of SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University) are eligible to enroll in SAP, provided they satisfy certain mandatory requirements laid out by the university.
The requirements are laid out considering the entry requirements of the foreign universities, high standards and competency the students are expected to encounter at the host university, the necessity to build brand image and reputation of SRM and to ensure the students have the right attitude, grit and determination to pursue his/her studies without any psychological and for academic stress. Some of the criteria are quantitative and some are subjective.
It is also emphasized that the students should have a minimum knowledge level in their chosen field of specialization to pursue SAP and therefore the students are encouraged to enroll in the SAP only after studying two full years of study at the undergraduate program or one full year of study at Masters Level.
Students can apply directly to SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University) by downloading the appropriate application form
Download
Minimum requirements
Mandatory
The student should have secured CGPA of not less than 8.0 upto the last semester for which the results are declared and available.
The students should not have any standing arrears as on the date of submission of application for SAP. The status of arrear will be considered based on the official data available with the university and consideration will not be given on the presumption that the status of the student is bound to change in future.
Should have completed two full years in undergraduate or one full year in masters program.
Desirable
Undergone additional training, apart from that offered in SRM, in the language of the country the student proposes to do the SAP.
Have a valid passport at the time of interview for SAP by SRM.
Have a good score in TOEFL, IELTS etc.
Selection Criteria and Procedure
1. It is a process giving adequate consideration to:
Academic performance
Ambition and excitement level
Communication skills
Family financial background to support
Recommendation of the concerned department
2. An information session will be held in the beginning of every semester for students.
3. After the information session the interested students should register with the Office of International Relations in the prescribed format with all supporting documents, before the deadline date
4. A one-to-one counseling and Interview will be held for the registered students by the faculty of concerned department
5. The shortlisted students should submit 2 undertakings – one by the student and the other by the parent – and proceed with all the academic and non-academic requirements of SRMIST and the host university
6. A  separate interview will be held in the instance of scholarships to select students for prestigious universities.

Skip to content
SRMIST Concludes ROM 2026, the 700 km Physio Run for Drug-Free India
Home
SRMIST Concludes ROM 2026, the 700 km Physio Run for Drug-Free India
66 runners complete a relay from Kanyakumari to Kattankulathur, taking the message of a drug-free India to more than 4,000 school students
SRM College of Physiotherapy, SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST), concluded the sixth edition of ROM 2026 – The Physio Run for Drug-Free India at the Kattankulathur campus. Bringing together 66 runners for a 700 km non-stop relay run from Kanyakumari, the initiative promoted physical fitness, social responsibility and awareness against drug abuse, in alignment with the vision of the Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan.
The run was inaugurated in the presence of Mr. Pratap, IAS, District Collector, Kanniyakumari, the Additional Superintendent of Police (ADSP), Nagercoil, and other government officials. Extending the campaign beyond the running route, the outreach activities engaged more than 4,000 school students, who participated in awareness initiatives and took pledges in support of a drug-free India.
The concluding Resonation Ceremony was held at SRMIST, Kattankulathur, with Prof. C. Muthamizhchelvan, Vice Chancellor, SRMIST, attending as Chief Guest and delivering the Presidential Address. Emphasising the wider purpose of the initiative, he said,
“The real purpose of a run like this goes beyond endurance. It lies in the social message we carry to the community and the awareness we create along the way.”
Prof. T. S. Veeragoudhaman, Dean, SRM College of Physiotherapy, highlighted the importance of sustaining the campaign’s message beyond the event. He said,
“The Physio Run may have concluded today, but our social responsibility must continue. Let the torch resonate, let the values endure, and let the message reach society.”
The ceremony featured a welcome address by Dr. S. F. Mariyam Farzana, Associate Professor and Organising Secretary, the torch resonation speech by Prof. Veeragoudhaman, and special addresses by dignitaries. A visual chronicle of ROM 2026, the release of the ROM 2026 book cover and the ROM 2025 book, and recognition of the ROM team highlighted the initiative’s journey and enduring legacy.
The event was organised under the leadership of Prof. T. S. Veeragoudhaman, Organising Chairman, with Dr. T. N. Suresh, Vice Principal and Organising Co-Chairman, and Dr. S. F. Mariyam Farzana, Organising Secretary, alongside the organising team.
Through ROM 2026, SRM College of Physiotherapy reaffirmed its commitment to community engagement and public awareness, bringing runners, students and local communities together around a shared goal: building a healthier society and advancing the message of a drug-free India.

Overview
SRM Institute of Science and Technology in collaboration with Department of Biotechnology, Govt. of India has established this advanced research facility under the project “ SRM-DBT Partnership Platform for Contemporary Research Services and Skill Development in Advanced Life Science Technologies” with the mission to create intra, inter and co-disciplinary research platform to deliver the needs of the state of the art life science research. Welcome message
SRM-DBT Platform For Advanced Life Science Technologies demonstrates SRMIST’s commitment and forward-looking orientation to work together on projects that generate significant value. This is established in collaboration with the Department of Biotechnology, Government of India. SRM DBT Platform is enriched by its highly qualified research-oriented faculty members as well as scholars and students. This is a great platform for students and scholars to benefit immensely.
The establishment and growth of the SRM-DBT Platform stands testament to the foresight and vision of our Founder & Chancellor Dr. T R Paarivendhar. SRMIST’s Leadership are always there to support academics and research of global standard and their encouragement is pertinent to the growth of our SRM-DBT Platform.
Programs Offered
Postgraduate Diploma in Genetic Counselling
The Postgraduate Diploma in Genetic Counselling is a one-year programme designed to provide high-quality training. It covers all seven competencies and 25 sub-competencies required for genetic counsellors, as prescribed by the Accreditation Council for Genetic Counselling, USA. The faculty for the programme includes genetic counsellors certified by the Board of Genetic Counselling India and the American Board of Genetic Counselling, as well as scientists with expertise in clinical genetics, genomics, and variant science. The programme encompasses shadow genetic counselling, clinical training, clinical rotations, hands-on training in genetic testing methodologies, and internships. Graduates of this programme can become certified genetic counsellors in India and abroad, subject to the requirements of the respective regulatory organizations.

Inward Mobility
Study @ SRM - Exchange Program
SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University) accepts students from overseas on short term study for one or two semesters, either during Fall( July to December) or Spring.( January to May).
As a general guide, SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University) requires a C average for entry into the Study Abroad and Exchange program. Entry to individual subjects may be dependent on prerequisites and class limitations.  The students can enrol in courses for a maximum of 25 credits per semester.
SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University) will assess the students the same way in which the regular full time degree seeking students of SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University) are assessed. There will be an end semester examination after which an official transcript will be issued indicating the credits earned and grade awarded.
Who Can Apply
Who Can Apply
A student can pursue courses as an Exchange student in SRM only if his/her home university has an exchange agreement with SRM.
A student can pursue courses as a Study Abroad student in SRM even if his / her home university does not have an agreement with SRM.
Students can apply directly to SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University) by downloading the appropriate application form
Download
The application steps
Select the courses that you want to pursue at SRM. Refer to the website (www.srmuniv.ac.in) for up-to-date information on courses. Please note that Odd semester courses are offered in Fall Term and Even semester courses are offered in Spring Term.
Complete the Learning Agreement / Study Proposal form and get it signed by the authorized official for study abroad program in your home university. In case the courses are modified upon arrival at SRM, a new Learning Agreement / Study Proposal form needs to be submitted with a month of the commencement of classes.
Fill the application form for Study Abroad / Exchange program
Attach the following documents along with the application form
signed nomination form
copy of passport pages with photo and personal details;
transcripts of academic record (in English or with English translation);
motivation/statement of purpose (in English);
two letters of recommendation;

Research
University Research Council
Fostering research has always been a priority at SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST) and to promote SRMIST as a research-driven institute of national importance. SRMIST has been supporting huge infrastructure for the researchers at SRMIST. High- performance computing facilities is one of the niche facilities offered by SRMIST, only privately funded institution created such facilities almost 5 years ago.
Given its importance to the theoretical researchers, the facility is being expanded through cloud resources as well. A separate research building is dedicated to research namely Raman Research Park with full support from the SRMIST. Central Research Facilities (CRF) host state-of-the-art facilities aimed at serving both researchers from SRMIST and outsiders as well.
The research activities in SRMIST include academic research, sponsored research, and industry consultancies. These activities are being carried out in the College of Engineering and Technology, Agricultural Sciences, Science and Humanities, and Medical Health Sciences, SRM Institute of Science and Technology. Thus, Research and Innovation happen in almost all streams in SRMIST.

Terms of Reference
To work with Faculty/Schools/Departments to improve the existing research ecosystem, creating necessary human resource and PhD scholars, required infrastructure to enable SRMIST to be positioned at the forefront of national and international developments and shaping the future research agendas
To suggest the priority areas of research in the Faculty/Schools/Departments particularly with reference to the role and responsibility of the Institute taking into account the facilities available in the Institute and expertise of the faculty members
To promote collaboration and interdisciplinary research both internally and externally, nationally and internationally, to improve the quality of research at The University Research Council (URC) could advise and help the faculty members to establish collaboration with national laboratories and premier institutions
To advise on the development of strategic research partnerships with industries
To oversee the development and delivery of appropriate staff development activities for researchers
To oversee local implementation of national research activities of national importance, for instance, Clean energy initiative, Nanotechnology, Smart Cities, Cyber-Physical Systems, Waste to Energy etc. Also, the URC could suggest and guide in establishing Centers of Excellence (CoEs)
To advise on and monitor the progress towards research grants received by the faculty members from the Government agencies, industries, etc
To develop and review policies and practices to improve the quality, impact, and quantity of research activity, monitor implementation, and evaluate outcomes
To approve procedures for allocating research funds and monitor their implementation
To formulate guidelines pertaining to the conduct of PhD and Post-Doctoral research programs offered by SRMIST on the lines prescribed by the UGC
To support IP related activities of faculty members, researchers, and students; the Intellectual Property Cell (IPC) facilitates the patent filing process, spin-off provision, licensing the know-how, and industry liaison
Frequency of the Meetings
A minimum of two meetings shall be scheduled in a year (January and July of the academic year). Additional meetings may be scheduled on a need basis.
Quorum
The quorum for meetings shall be 1/3 of the membership.
Term of the membership
Nominated members shall serve for a term of two year

In the words of our Founder & Chancellor
SRMIST’s engineering programs endeavor to be at the forefront of innovation. They also foster multi-disciplinary collaborations aimed at solving the most pressing global problems.
Our mission is to seek solutions to global challenges by using the power of engineering principles, techniques and systems. We believe that engineers should not only possess deep technical excellence, but also nurture creativity, cultural awareness and entrepreneurial skills that come from exposure to science, business, medicine and other disciplines – all integral part of the SRM experience.
Our goal is to deliver world class, solutions driven programs that inspire curiosity and generate new knowledge and discoveries. Our collaboration with over 50 of the world’s best universities and 215 corporates, strengthens our academic and research programs.

Dean's Message
Welcome to the College of Engineering & Technology at SRMIST!
At SRMIST, we are committed to academic excellence, research innovation, and holistic student development. Our college stands at the forefront of engineering education, equipping students with the skills and knowledge necessary to thrive in an ever-evolving technological landscape.
With world-class faculty, cutting-edge research facilities, and strong industry collaborations, we ensure that our students are prepared not only for successful careers but also to become leaders and innovators in their respective fields. Our curriculum blends theoretical rigor with hands-on experience, emphasizing experiential learning, interdisciplinary projects, and entrepreneurial thinking.
Beyond academics, we nurture a vibrant campus culture that fosters creativity, critical thinking, and ethical leadership. We believe in empowering our students to take on global challenges and contribute meaningfully to society.
I invite you to explore the numerous opportunities that our college offers and join us in our mission to shape the future through education and research.

Home
Dr. Ravi Pachamuthu, Pro-Chancellor (Administration), SRMIST, Honoured with Doctor of Letters (Honoris Causa) by KIIT
The prestigious Doctor of Letters (Honoris Causa) conferred by KIIT recognises Dr. Ravi Pachamuthu’s distinguished spirit of contribution to education, healthcare and institution building.
Dr. Ravi Pachamuthu, Pro-Chancellor (Administration), SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST), Chairman of the SRM Group and CMD of SIMS Hospitals, has been conferred the prestigious
Doctor of Letters (Honoris Causa)
by the
Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology (KIIT), Bhubaneswar
, in recognition of his leadership and contributions to education, healthcare, philanthropy and institution-building.
The honorary degree was conferred at a special ceremony organised by KIIT in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, on October 5, 2026. The distinction acknowledges
Dr. Ravi Pachamuthu
’s sustained efforts in building and strengthening institutions, expanding access to education and healthcare, and contributing to the wider community.
Dr. Ravi Pachamuthu has played a significant role in the growth of institutions under the SRM Group. His contributions span from institutional administration, infrastructure to strategic development. His focus on student welfare including scholarship initiatives for meritorious and economically disadvantaged students shows his thirst to spread educational nourishment for all.
Following Cyclone Thane, he was among the early contributors to the Tamil Nadu Chief Minister’s Relief Fund and supported full scholarships, including tuition and hostel fee waivers, for students from cyclone-affected agricultural families throughout their academic programmes.
His contributions to healthcare include the establishment and development of the SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre, Kattankulathur, and SRM Institute of Medical Science (SIMS), Vadapalani, Chennai, with emphasis on advanced medical infrastructure, healthcare technology and accessible treatment.
Distinguished Awards and Honours
Dr. Ravi Pachamuthu’s countless contributions to education, healthcare, institution-building and social development have earned recognition at national and international levels. His notable honours include:
Award / Honour

Leadership and achievement in the field of education
Building on these achievements, the conferment of the
Doctor of Letters (Honoris Causa) by KIIT, Bhubaneswar,
marks another significant recognition in Dr. Ravi Pachamuthu’s continuing journey of leadership and service. The honour reflects his relentless efforts on creating opportunities, supporting communities and strengthening institutions with a long-term vision.
For the students and academic community of SRMIST, the recognition carries particular significance. Dr. Ravi Pachamuthu’s meaningful and impactful journey serves as an example of how leadership in the education sector can extend beyond campuses to create a broader societal impact.

SRMIST works closely with leading universities around the world to offer an affordable way of getting an internationally recognised qualification.

Public Advisory
The official website of SRM University
www.srmist.edu.in
is the only official and recognized website for admissions to SRM University. Also
admissions.india@srmist.edu.in
is the official email ID for any communications related to admission.
Any other deceptively similar websites, or Emails / SMS / WhatsApp messages etc., sent in the name of or on behalf of SRM University, are all fake. SRM university has neither directly nor indirectly authorized / appointed any consultant or agency or individual agent for admitting candidates for any programmes.
The public is cautioned not to approach anybody or entertain other methods to seek admission into SRM University apart from the official channel. The public is informed that admissions to all programmes are done only on merit and the Directorate of Admissions is the ONLY NODAL OFFICE for all admissions.
In spite of the above advisory, if parents / students, knowingly or unknowingly, get involved in cash transactions through non-official channels, please be advised that this is at the individual’s own risk and SRM University or any of its authorities are NOT responsible for any or all of the consequences arising thereof.
SRM University does not accept cash transactions for any of its services.
Aspirants who want to pursue their higher education in SRM University are advised to directly approach the Directorate of Admissions at Kattankulathur (Near Chennai), Tamil Nadu or visit
www.srmist.edu.in
, for all relevant information.
If anyone finds any website(s) deceptively similar to
www.srmist.edu.in
and promises admission in SRM University, or if anyone demands cash promising admission in SRM, we kindly request you to bring it to our immediate attention by writing to
cyberwatchdog@srmist.edu.in
so that we can take necessary steps to weed out such websites / persons through legal channels.

Controller of Examinations
The Controller of Examinations is responsible for preparing and scheduling the university examinations for all the courses offered at the SRMIST. CoE also coordinates the central evaluation of answer scripts, the publication of results, and the issue of Grade cards, Transcripts, Provisional Certificates, Degree certificates, Migration certificates, and Duplicate certificates.
In addition, we provide genuineness and verification services to various stakeholders such as Government entities, Educational institutions, Corporate bodies, and Private verification agencies. We also arrange for pre-and post-auditing of question papers and answer booklets by both internal and external subject experts as well as maintain records related to examinations.

Life at SRM
Facilities and Operations
a wide variety of facilities related activities
The Facility & Operations  division of SRMIST is responsible for a wide variety of facilities related activities on campus to serve the needs of students. Our units include:
Maintenance
Housekeeping services

Minor Construction
Waste Treatment

Auditorium / Seminar Hall
Faculty Residential
Building Details
SRMIST prides itself to be a green campus with best spaces for research, learning and excellence. Our infrastructure is a means to bring together students and faculty members from across national and international locations. We have many buildings with state of the art facilities.
Building Details
We thrive on your feedback & suggestions
Our campus has dedicated employees working in teams to operate, maintain, repair, renovate, safety of property, security for students & faculty and housekeeping services. Our maintenance staff take care of repair of furniture, renovation of facilities and the infra-structure such as playing fields, shuttle service, waste management, elevators & lifts, DG sets, air-conditioning, event support and renewable energy. We are committed to taking care of campus through a collaborative team effort. Our aim is to provide responsive, quality services so that the staff and students in the campus remain safe and secure. Our well-maintained facilities continue to make learning and working effective. We are here to support SRMIST students, faculty and staff so as to fulfil the requirements layout by the management. Centre for Statistics | Research Wings - SRMIST
Skip to content
Centre for Statistics
Home
Research
Research Wings
Centre for Statistics
Overview
Centre for Statistics is a hub of statistical training, research, and consultancy at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Kattankulathur. Our aim is to unite multidisciplinary students, research scholars, and faculty to foster innovative thinking and collaboration, as well as address new research challenges across various disciplines within our institution. As a leader in statistical applications and data science, the Centre represents a significant step forward for our institution.
Vision
Pursue Excellence in Statistical Training and Research
Serve as an Epicenter for Statistical Activities within the Institute
Develop a Dynamic Partnership Between Academia and Industry
Promote the Use of Statistics Across Various Fields
Mission
To make numbers speak and transform data into actionable insights, for advancing statistical knowledge and contributing to the development of academic research and industrial collaborations.
2000
Established
100
Consultancy Services
Training Programs
Publications
Funded Projects
Professor and Head
Email: head.cfs@srmist.edu.in
Welcome to Centre for Statistics
The field of statistics is increasingly essential in today’s world due to its vital role in fostering evidence-based decision-making. This discipline supports decision-makers, policymakers, researchers, government and private agencies in reshaping society through informed choices. With the advent of modern computing and technological advancements, the importance and application of statistics have expanded significantly, benefiting students and practitioners alike.
Centre for Statistics in SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Kattankulathur demonstrates the intent to benefit the student and scholar community, and faculty members with world-class assistance in this subject. In addition to helping students acquire data analytic skills, the centre provides in-depth knowledge regarding the application of statistical techniques through effective supervisory training programs. Also to push forward the frontiers of knowledge by offering statistical consultancies and interacting with industries.
We encourage students, research scholars, and faculty members to utilise the resources and expertise available at the Centre for Statistics. You can find us in Room No.1303, 13th Floor, University Building. For any inquiries or further information, please write to us at
statcentre.ktr@srmist.edu.in
Meet Our Staff
Events
Projects
Programs
Basic Statistics using SPSS (Trial Version)
Advanced Statistics for Research
Introduction to Systematic review & Meta-analysis using R
Survey Design Methodology
Bio-Statistics using SPSS (Trial Version)
Statistical Cell
Statistical Training Unit
The Statistical Training Unit at the Centre for Statistics offers training programs and short courses designed to enhance statistical knowledge and skills. We provide tailored sessions for internal and external participants, including faculty, researchers, and students. Our focus is on delivering high-quality, practical knowledge to all levels of proficiency.
Data Analytic Unit
Our Data Analytic Unit specializes in translating complex research questions into clear statistical problems. We work closely with researchers to provide precise and actionable insights through advanced statistical analysis and methodological expertise. Our goal is to support a wide range of research needs through interdisciplinary collaboration and expert consultation.
Statistical Consultancy Unit
The Statistical Consultancy Unit offers professional statistical services on a fee-for-service basis. We assist with grant writing, questionnaire design, survey methodology, data analysis, result interpretation, and report writing. Our services are aimed at providing precise and impactful solutions to support your research and data needs.

SRMIST
Dr. Paarivendhar Research Colloquium
About
SRM Institute of Science and Technology has been organizing Dr. Paarivendhar Research Colloquium annually, a unique platform to foster inter-disciplinary research and encourage research scholars of the Institution to present their research findings to the peer community. The objective of the colloquium is to provide an exclusive opportunity for research scholars working in various disciplines. Research scholars are encouraged to present their latest research findings highlighting the outcomes of ongoing research in frontier areas of Sciences and Technology. Further, the platform serves as a fertile ground to inspire the scholars and generate novel ideas facilitating exchange of knowledge in different fields and inculcating multidisciplinary research culture.

Research @ SRMIST
In line with the mission of the institute, faculty and students at SRMIST are encouraged to carry out research in basic and applied areas of Technology and Sciences.
SRMIST further fosters research in a challenging, yet rewarding manner, by providing the state of art infrastructure, seed fund, selective excellence programs and recruitment of junior research fellows providing them stipend, on par with government institutions.
The areas of research span across 36 fields, including engineering & technology, science, arts, commerce, Law and medicine.
Researchers associated with various disciplines contribute in their field of expertise by way of publications, patents, industrial collaborations, startups and other valuable contributions to the serve the society at large.
SRMIST supports the research endeavors of faculty and students by providing incentives for publications and patents.

Committees & Cells | Life at SRM - SRMIST
Skip to content
Committees & Cells
Home
Life at SRM
Committees & Cells
SRM Institute of Science and Technology has constituted various committees and cells to support the effective functioning of the institution and ensure a safe, inclusive and supportive campus environment. These committees address matters related to student welfare, faculty support, compliance, grievances, equality and institutional development, with clearly defined objectives, roles and responsibilities.
The committees and cells provide appropriate mechanisms for addressing concerns and resolving grievances in a fair, transparent and timely manner. They function in accordance with applicable regulations, guidelines and institutional policies, while promoting dignity, respect and equal opportunities across the university community. Relevant information, committee members, proceedings and supporting documents are provided for reference.
Anti-Ragging Committee
Prevents and monitors ragging-related activities while promoting a safe, respectful and supportive campus environment.
Internal Complaints Committee
Addresses complaints related to workplace harassment and promotes a safe, inclusive, and respectful environment.
Students Grievance Redressal Committee
Provides a transparent mechanism for students to raise concerns, address grievances and seek appropriate resolution.
Faculty Grievance Redressal Committee
Provides a structured mechanism for faculty members to raise concerns and facilitates their fair and timely resolution.
SC/ST Committee
Promotes the welfare, inclusion and equal opportunities of SC/ST students and staff while addressing relevant concerns and grievances.
Women Development Committee
Promotes women's welfare, empowerment, equality and participation while supporting a safe and inclusive campus environment.
Equal Opportunity Cell
Promotes equal opportunities, inclusivity and a supportive environment for all members of the university community.
Socio-Economically Disadvantaged Group Cell
Supports students from socio-economically disadvantaged backgrounds by promoting inclusion, equal opportunities and access to institutional support.
Students Services Centre
Provides comprehensive support and assistance to students by facilitating essential services, addressing their needs and helping them access appropriate university resources.
Research Development Cell
The Research Development Cell (RDC) at SRMIST promotes a strong culture of research, innovation, and interdisciplinary collaboration across the institution.
It supports researchers in developing impactful projects, securing funding, publishing quality research, and translating ideas into real-world solutions.

Alumni Affairs
Home
Alumni Affairs
Overview
The Directorate of Alumni Affairs was established in September 2017 to look after the alumni needs for the entire University. It was earlier functioning as the SRMEC Alumni Office since 1996. The major objectives of the Directorate are to enhance the coordination between SRM University and its alumni, to improve the interaction of alumni with the students and the faculty members, to establish alumni chapters in India and abroad, to maintain the database of alumni and to look after the interests of SRM alumni.
Vision
Develop a fully connected, strong, SRM alumni community.
Mission
Advance SRM Institute of Science and Technology by promoting alumni relationship fostering commitment among students enabling student-alumni interactions.
India Chapters
International Chapters
Virtual Chapters
Active Members
Dr. A. Rathinam
Phone: +91 44 - 2741 7272,  2745 6726
Welcome to Alumni Affairs
SRM Engineering College, founded in 1985, has blossomed into SRMIST, a top-notch private university. Now, SRM Institute of Science and Technology is multilocational and multidisciplinary. Engineering and Technology, Medical and Health Science, Management, Science and Humanities, Law, and Agriculture are the major faculties. SRM Institute of Science and Technology now operates from three locations in Chennai and one in Delhi.
As Director of Alumni Affairs, it is my privilege and pleasure to welcome you all to be a part of the alumni community. All you need to do is join the portal.
Our chancellor quite often refers to our alumni as “our ambassadors and torch-bearers.” For any university, this is quite true. Our directorate is exclusively mandated to serve the alumni community. Here, the major thrust is on “for the alumni, by the alumni, and through the alumni.” In this endeavor, we look forward to all your help and support. We solicit your views/suggestions to strengthen our relationship. Together, let us reach greater heights.

Goals of Alumni Affairs
The goal of the SRMIST (SRM Institute of Science and Technology) Alumni Association is to foster a strong and supportive network among its alumni, promote professional and personal development opportunities, maintain connections between alumni and the institution, and contribute to the advancement and reputation of SRMIST. Some specific objectives might include:
Networking
Facilitating networking opportunities among alumni to help them establish professional connections, seek mentorship, and explore career opportunities.
Career Development
Providing resources, workshops, and events to support alumni in their career advancement, such as job fairs, resume workshops, and alumni career panels.
Lifelong Learning
Organizing seminars, conferences, and continuing education programs to help alumni stay updated with advancements in their respective fields and foster lifelong learning.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
How do I register on the Alumni Portal?
Alumni can register by visiting the official SRMIST Alumni Portal and clicking on
“Register”
. Please fill in your basic details such as Register Number, Year of Passing, Department, and contact information. Once submitted, your details will be verified by the Alumni Office and your account will be activated.
How can I update my personal or professional details?
After logging in to the Alumni Portal, go to
“My Profile”
and select
“Edit Profile”
. You can update your contact details, current employment, higher education, and other relevant information. Keeping your profile updated helps us stay connected and offer relevant opportunities.
How can I access alumni services?
Registered alumni can access various services through the Alumni Portal, including:
Alumni events and reunions
Networking opportunities
Career support and mentorship programs
Institutional updates and newsletters
Simply log in to the portal to explore available services.
How do I apply for transcripts or other academic documents?
Requests for transcripts, degree certificates, or other academic records can be made through the
SRMIST Academic Services
section on the official website. Alumni are required to submit an online application along with the necessary documents and prescribed fee.
How can I contribute or give back to SRMIST?
Alumni can contribute to SRMIST in multiple ways, including:
Financial contributions and endowments
Supporting scholarships
Participating in mentorship programs
Offering internships or placement opportunities
Volunteering for alumni events
Details on contributions are available in the
“Give Back to SRMIST”
section of the Alumni Portal.
How can I participate in alumni events and reunions?
Information about upcoming alumni meets, reunions, webinars, and networking events will be shared through the Alumni Portal, email, and official social media channels. Please ensure your contact details are up to date to receive regular updates.
I forgot my login credentials. What should I do?
Click on
“Forgot Password”
on the Alumni Portal login page and follow the instructions to reset your password. If you are unable to recover your account, please contact the Alumni Office for assistance.
How can I contact the Alumni Office?
You can reach the Alumni Office through:

alumni@srmist.edu.in
Phone:
9150867273

University Building 4
Floor, Room No 17, Alumni Affairs Office SRM Institute of Science and Technology
Office hours are Monday to Friday, during regular working hours.
Why should I stay connected with the Alumni Network?
Staying connected helps you:
Build professional networks
Receive career and learning opportunities
Stay updated with university developments
Contribute to the growth of future students
Your engagement strengthens the SRMIST alumni community.

Our Hostels
There are 8 blocks of capacity varying from 300 to 1800, allocated for Engineering girl students. The total capacity for girls’ hostel for engineering is about 4000.
Special Amenities
Each room is fully furnished with study tables, chairs, cots, and storage lockers. The hostel offers a range of amenities to ensure a safe and comfortable living environment for girls, including
purified water facilities, 24×7 CCTV surveillance, security guards, round-the-clock Wi-Fi, indoor and outdoor games, gym, power backup, and a biometric attendance system

Research and Development Cell
Research & Development Cell
The National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 envisages the promotion of quality research within the Higher Education system.
The integration of Research, Innovation and Technology Development is the foundation of Atma-Nirbhar Bharat (Self-reliant India). The establishment of Research and Development Cell (RDC) in Higher Education Institutes will enable attainment of targets of Atma-Nirbhar Bharat and is expected to play a pivotal role in catalyzing multidisciplinary/ transdisciplinary and translational research culture mandated in NEP 2020.
Vision, Mission & Objectives
Vision
To put in place a robust mechanism for developing and strengthening the research ecosystem within HEIs, aligned with the provisions of NEP-2020.
Mission
To create a conducive environment for enhanced research productivity.
To encourage collaboration across industry, government, community- based organizations, and agencies at the local, national, and international levels.
To facilitate greater access to research through mobilization of resources and funding.
Objectives
To create an organizational structure with role-based functions of RDC, formulate Research Policy for the HEIs, identify thrust areas of research, and form related cluster groups/ frontline teams/consortia of researchers.
To create enabling provisions in Research Policies for recruitment of research personnel, procurement of equipment, and financial management with adequate autonomy to the Principal Investigator(s) and disseminate research outcomes to stakeholders and the public at large.
To establish a special purpose vehicle to promote researchers and innovators, identify potential collaborators from industry, research organizations, academic institutions & other stakeholders for cooperation and synergistic partnerships.
To act as a liaison between researchers & relevant research funding agencies, extend guidance in preparation & submission of project proposals and post-sanctioning of the grants to oversee adherence to timelines.
To have better coordination among other cells/centers dealing with University-Industry Inter Linkage, Incubation, Innovation and Entrepreneurship Development and Intellectual Property Rights (IPR).
To develop an Institutional Research Information System for sharing the status of ongoing/ completed research projects/Programmes, expertise & resources, etc., making effective use of Information & Communication Technology (ICT) for preparing the database of in-house experts to provide industrial consultancy and services.
To engage & utilize the services of superannuated active faculty/scientists in research capacity building of talented young minds and promote mobility of researchers across institutions and R&D Labs.
To serve as nodal center for ideation and conceptualization of research topics/themes by organizing workshops and training programs and ensuring the integrity and ethical practices in research activities including clearance of bioethical committee wherever required.
Committee Members

FINANCE AND INFRASTRUCTURE
Dr. M. Navaneethan, Head, NRC – Chairman
Dr. V. Thirumurugan, Associate Director [CL] – Member
Mr. P. Ponnusamy, Asst. Registrar [Accounts ] – Member
Ms. C. Lavanya, Manager [Accounts] – Member
Ms. P. Jeevitha, Accounts Assistant, Office of Registrar – Member
Ms. S. Gayathri, Junior Assistant, Office of Registrar (Technical Staff)– Member
Roles of the committee members:
Finance:
RDC can facilitate resource mobilization and create a Corpus for research and development from government, industry, and other funding agencies and channelize Corporate Social 9 Responsibility (CSR) funds for sustenance and furtherance of research activities.
Apart from creating a Corpus fund exclusively for R&D, RDC can explore venture capitalists and angel investors for funding in research and innovation. It needs to liaise with funding agencies, and track funding opportunities from industrial consortia.
The HEI may make provision for research in the annual budget subject to the availability of funds.
The corpus created for research could also support the seed funding for freshly recruited faculty for developing research facilities, publications, and patenting.

Research Guidance from RDC will aim to encourage faculties to conceive ideas through enhanced industry-academia interactions and prepare research proposals for funding from various agencies.
Organizing events like capacity-building programs (Research 8 Methodology and Research Techniques) and specific research theme-based workshops and Research Internships will motivate the end-users (students, scholars, and faculties) to participate actively in the process of ideation and innovative research in emerging areas.
Research Thrust and Clustered Areas
Thrust areas for Research in an HEI should be identified, underpinning the societal needs and the availability of key resources, including in-house human resources, faculty research competencies, and support systems. This would enable HEI to consider establishing a Center of Excellence (CoE) in these identified contemporary areas of research.
Research Clusters and/or Regional Research Consortia prompted/formed by RDC to bring all researchers, faculty, students, scholars, and Post-Doctoral Fellows for joint high value (interdisciplinary and trans-disciplinary) research projects to avail national and international funding opportunities. Shared infrastructure and expertise will enable crossfertilization of ideas and mobilization of resources.
Further, forming Regional Research Consortia adds a synergistic advantage in finding solutions in inter-disciplinary, transdisciplinary, and multidisciplinary areas.
CoEs’ can serve as Incubation Centres to transform innovative ideas into processes and products administered and monitored by the proposed RDC. RDC could also provide an avenue for community talent with prior learning/expertise to engage in research and innovation activities of HEI.
Research Incentives and Recognition
Incentives play a significant role in triggering and catalyzing research interest among scholars and faculties. Incentivizing quality publications and patents by students and faculty will have an enduring positive impact.
Institution of Excellence Awards for accomplishments/achievements in the form of impactful quality research and/ or research-based teaching will further stimulate and invigorate the research and innovation activities of the HEI.
RDC should also develop a policy focussing on identifying specific incentives for research faculty and develop a unique Research Career ladder for strengthening the mission “Research”.

This is the Directorate of Student Affairs (DSA), SRMIST, Kattankulathur. Our guiding principle is to enable to our students adequate facilities and avenues to explore, understand and realize their potential. In short, DSA is all about excellence in everything beyond classroom based learning. Often, students consider their beyond classroom activity experience as valuable and memorable. About the College
Occupational Therapy is a healthcare profession that enables people of all ages to be independent in their day-to-day activities. SRM College of Occupational Therapy was started in the academic year 1996 under the Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University. In the year 2004, the college was brought under the ambit of SRM University, and the same year Postgraduate program was started. SRM College is the only occupational therapy college to offer
BOT
MOT
, and PhD programs in Tamil Nadu. It is one of the colleges in South India which is recognized by the All India Occupational Therapists’ Association (AIOTA), the National Governing body of the profession and World Federation of Occupational Therapists (WFOT), the apex professional body worldwide, and accredited by NAAC with graded A++. These recognitions give a distinct advantage of being accepted at par in the world of medicine, which allows students to seek higher studies or employment in abroad.
Occupational Therapy in SRM is committed to guiding our students through a distinct learning process that allows the individual student to think, evaluate their own learning styles and experience learning through civic engagement in emerging practice areas and service-learning opportunities. We provide our students with exceptional opportunities to learn and grow as they transition from the classroom to successful careers in Occupational Therapy.
100% Job placement is guaranteed for students who graduate every year in BOT and MOT. 80% of our graduates are well placed in countries like USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Singapore, and Middle East. We have well-equipped clinical setup & research facilities. Tie up facilities for clinical training is being provided in major corporate hospitals such as SIMS Hospital, Vadapalani and other organizations such as NIEPMD at Muttukadu, Right Hospital, MDA – a special school for Dyslexia. Students of SRM College of Occupational Therapy have been placed in overseas for clinical placement at Latrobe University, Australia. Campus placement is done for USA & India through our SRM placement cell for major hospitals and companies. Community outreach program is carried out in villages in and around Kattankulathur where our faculty and students conduct Disability Survey and Health Education to provide Occupational Therapy intervention at doorstep.

Welcome message
Welcome to the College of Occupational Therapy at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Kattankulathur campus. The College of Occupational Therapy commenced in 1996, we have numerous achievements to rejoice. Our faculty is committed in educating future leaders, generating new knowledge, improving individuals health and well-being, and serving the greater community Locally, Nationally and Internationally. We also partner with prominent scientists and Healthcare professionals in India and around the world to shape the future of the profession in an everchanging Healthcare environment.
Our reputation and influence are growing through the outstanding scholarship and advocacy of our distinguished faculty and staff.
The faculty and staff of the College of Occupational Therapy mentor and inspire our students to think, care, create, and pursue justice in our world. We do this by preparing the next generation of leaders to practice innovative, evidence-based healthcare for our diverse global community. Our students are fully engaged throughout the learning process in their in-person and virtual classrooms, through interprofessional patient scenarios in our simulation facility, clinics and research labs, community outreach and advocacy.
We are dedicated in preparing students for contemporary healthcare practice, including an interprofessional, team-based approach to person-centered care. I hope you will explore our website to discover your future path in healthcare.
Programs Offered
B.O.T
Bachelor of Occupational Therapy trains students and helps them to become skilled professional occupational therapists, capable of undertaking independent/supervised practice.
M.O.T
The Master of Occupational Therapy provides students with skills and knowledge in treating clients who have difficulty participating in everyday life activities due to neurological, musculoskeletal or mental health issues.
PhD
The Ph.D. in Occupational Therapy is a research-focused program designed to advance clinical expertise and academic knowledge. It prepares scholars to contribute to  rehabilitation and interdisciplinary healthcare.
Placement
Occupational Therapy profession provides a wide array of career options and avenues for specialization. We take great pride in the opportunities to secure placements in various countries such as the UK, Qatar, Dubai, Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. These achievements stand as a testament to the dedication and hard work of our graduates, showcasing their efforts in advancing the profession on a global scale. Our undergraduate alumni, were placed in the Jewel Autism Centre, Kerala and have also successfully secured positions in various hospitals and private therapy centers across India, with salaries averaging Rs. 6.6 lakhs per annum for BOT Graduates and Rs. 9 lakhs per annum for MOT Graduates.
We proudly would like to acclaim our recent accomplishment that in 2023, 15 of our PG students were placed in USA – Ed Theory, a top- ranked California-based company with a whopping salary package of 70,000 to 72,000 USD (approx. Rs. 58 lakhs per annum), 77 alumni are placed in UK under NHS Trust and more than 20 are placed in Middle East Countries. Furthermore, our alumni have exemplified exceptional initiative and drive by not only establishing entrepreneurial ventures across different states but also pursuing academic roles in various sectors. This dual representation truly highlights the multifaceted capabilities and achievements of our graduates.

Interdisciplinary Institute of Indian System of Medicine (IIISM)
Overview
Interdisciplinary Institute of Indian System of Medicine (IIISM) is a prestigious school of SRM Institute of Science and Technology which was established in 2008 to promote research in the field of traditional system of Indian Medicine, including Siddha, Ayurveda and Unani.
IIISM is functioning in joint collaboration with Banaras Hindu University in the development of herbal based Siddha, Ayurveda and Unani medicine. It has also signed MoU with AYUSH and Central Council for Research in Ayurveda and Siddha (CCRAS) for promoting research in Siddha, Ayurveda and Unani system of medicine. Further, 200 acres of land has been allocated specifically for the purpose of micro propagation of medicinal plants, reiterating SRMIST’s commitment in establishing a world-class research facility to validate and standardize herbal based medicinal products. Also one acre of land at the University campus has been allocated to establish AYUSH Research Centre with the financial support of the ministry of AYUSH.
Dr. R. C. Satish Kumar

IIISM is functioning in joint collaboration with Banaras Hindu University in the development of herbal based Siddha, Ayurveda and Unani medicine. We have ongoing MoUs with AYUSH & CCRAS. This is a great platform for our students, researchers and faculty members to work together on trendsetting research and experiments.

School of Public Health
The School of Public Health, established in 2007, is a premier institution dedicated to advancing public health education, training, and research. The school nurtures competent and inspired public health professionals, health managers, health data scientists, biostatisticians and thought leaders through cutting edge education technology and experiential learning methods. The students here get the opportunity to participate in ongoing research projects of the school and get hands on training and field exposure. School of Public Health, SRMIST
The School of Public Health takes pride in its multidisciplinary faculty, who bring a wealth of field experience and impactful research into the classroom, ensuring a rigorous, skill-oriented learning environment.
At the school, we place strong emphasis on building students’ confidence and enhancing their communication abilities. Our curriculum are designed to develop technical competencies through experiential and hands-on learning approaches.
Research and data analytics are key strengths of the school. Across all programs, students are actively engaged in designing research studies, collecting field data, analyzing results, and preparing comprehensive reports. A significant proportion of the school’s research publications are contributed by students, and the institution actively encourages and supports student-led research and publications.
We offer specialized academic programs tailored to emerging industry needs. Students enrolled in the Master of Public Health (MPH) and the integrated BSc–MPH programs gain expertise in designing and managing health projects, as well as monitoring and evaluation. The MPH in Applied Health Research focuses on research excellence. The MSc in Biostatistics and Epidemiology emphasizes advanced statistical software and data analytical skills. The MSc in Health Data Science is designed for those interested in leveraging cutting-edge technologies—such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, algorithms, and cloud computing—for innovative applications in the healthcare domain.
We look forward to welcoming you to the School of Public Health, where students are nurtured to excel in the highly competitive field of public health, secure rewarding careers, and make meaningful contributions to improving people’s health.
To be one of the most sought-after public health institutions in the country.
Nurture competent and inspired public health professionals who will make meaningful contributions to improving the health of communities.
Admission Procedure
Applications for Master programs are invited in January each year through a notification on the Institute’s website. Interested candidates need to register on the SRM website and appear for a written examination held in April and June. Qualified candidates proceed to an interview. Upon selection, candidates are required to submit the certificates and specified fee by a given date. Classes begin by mid-July.
Experience Life Beyond the Classroom, Discover, Connect, and Thrive in a Campus that Never Sleeps
Campus Life at SRMIST
The School of Public Health is located near Chennai at the Kattankulathur campus of the SRM Institute of Science & Technology.
The campus offers five hostels – three for girls and two for boys, where accommodation is available on a first-come, first-served basis. Due to limited availability, interested students are advised to book their accommodation immediately after enrollment. Additionally, many paying-guest accommodations are available in surrounding areas.

Placement
MPH graduates generally begin their professional journey with mid-level positions such as program officer or research officer in a national or international NGO, CSR initiatives, research organization, or government health department. Progressing in their careers, they ascend to state-level manager, eventually reaching national-level management positions. Some specialize in specific areas like Monitoring, Learning and Evaluation, Research, Community Mobilization, Advocacy, TB, HIV/AIDS, Family Planning, Gender Equity, Environmental Health, Health Communication, Health Economics etc. Some students choose to pursue a Ph.D. and get into academia.

Home
SRMIST Celebrates Gandhi Jayanti with Swachhata Pledge and Lake-Bund Cleanliness Drive
SRMIST commemorates Mahatma Gandhi’s birth anniversary with a floral tribute, cleanliness pledge and community-driven campus sanitation initiative.
SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST), Kattankulathur, commemorated Gandhi Jayanti on 2 October 2026 with a programme highlighting the values of cleanliness, personal responsibility and community service. The programme brought together 150 students and more than 40 faculty members at the campus.
The programme commenced with a welcome address by Sub Lieutenant
Dr. G. B. Sakthi Prasath
, Associate NCC Officer (ANO), Navy Wing, SRMIST. A floral tribute was offered to Mahatma Gandhi by
Dr. V. Thirumurugan
, Associate Director (Campus Life), SRMIST and Nodal Officer, Unnat Bharat Abhiyan (UBA-SRMIST), at the Gandhi statue near the campus entrance.
Dr. A. Rathinam
, Director of Alumni Affairs, and Dr. P. Jekan, Associate NCC Officer (ANO), NCC, SRMIST, along with faculty members, participated in the tribute.
The participants subsequently took the Swachhata Pledge, reaffirming their commitment to cleanliness and responsible waste management. The programme then continued with a lake-bund cleanliness drive, in which students, faculty members and NCC Naval Wing cadets worked together to collect waste from the designated area. The collected waste was handed over to the SRMIST Solid Waste Management (SWM) Team for appropriate disposal.
During the drive, participants also raised awareness through messages such as “Cleanliness Begins With Me,” “My Waste, My Responsibility,” “Keep It Clean, Keep It Green,” and “Cleanliness Is Not an Event; It Is a Habit.” These messages reinforced the importance of making cleanliness a regular practice rather than limiting it to occasional campaigns.
The programme concluded with a vote of thanks and distribution of participation certificates. The Gandhi Jayanti observance highlighted the importance of translating values of cleanliness, responsibility and service into everyday action, with students and faculty coming together to contribute to a cleaner and more responsible campus environment.
