content:
Student Counselling Services | Life at SRM - SRMIST
Skip to content
Counselling Services
Our counseling services are aimed to cater to your needs. Your mental wellness is our priority. These services will help you deal with and address any Tension, Anxiety, Academic Stress, Family issues, Loneliness, Frustration, Low Self-Esteem, lack of concentration, Sleeplessness or  Suicidal thoughts, and more.
Home
Life at SRM
Student Counselling Services
Our Team
We have a team of competent and qualified counselors who will cater to your specific needs.
This facility is completely free
and dedicated to the mental wellbeing of the students. We are requesting you to make use of it whenever you need it without any hesitation whatsoever.
Counselling Services
Our counseling services are aimed to cater to your needs. Your mental wellness is our priority. These services will help you deal with and address any Tension, Anxiety, Academic Stress, Family issues, Loneliness, Frustration, Low Self-Esteem, lack of concentration, Sleeplessness or Suicidal thoughts, and more.
We have a team of competent and qualified counselors who will cater to your specific needs. This facility is completely free and dedicated to the mental wellbeing of the students. We are requesting you to make use of it whenever you need it without any hesitation whatsoever.
The Directorate of Student Affairs
This Directorate has been providing the counseling services to the Students for the past 13 years. This facility is to help students to deal with their personal problems that affect their education and campus life. it may be fear, anxiety, learning difficulties, self doubts, low self esteem, problems due to comparisons, friendship and relationship issue and habits related issues. The counseling will help them to feel mentally at ease so as to pursue their studies effectively and also have stress free campus life.
The Directorate is involved in almost all student related activities that help to promote the wellbeing of students by promoting talents at individual and group level. The department is conducts  cultural activities; sports activities in the campus for all disciplines. This is to give an opportunity to express their hidden talents and nurture them. It is also involved in maintaining discipline in the Campus.
The Department of Psychiatry
The Department of Psychiatry, SRM Hospital, headed by Prof. Dr. M. Thirunavukarasu and guided by Prof. Dr. R. Arul Saravanan is the pivotal centre for mental health care.  With its team of eminent Psychiatrists and young enthusiastic residents who are available in the Hospital 24/7 for addressing any problem related to your Mental Health and Psychological wellbeing, we also offer individualized  counselling, therapy and training for Students and Faculty of SRMIST.
We have also created “
Here For You
” – the mental health app, which is a reliable, simple and quick solution to answer your worries and queries, conceived by a Psychiatry Postgraduate Dr. Manik Inder Singh, in liaison with students from Microsoft Learn Student Ambassadors & Team Envision Aarrush from SRMIST.
The Department of Clinical Psychology
The Department of Clinical Psychology, started in the year 2011, is in SRM Hospital, D – Block extension on the 5th floor.  The Department provides mental health services, such as psychological testing to understand the personality, evaluate the levels of intelligence of individuals. It offers psychological interventions like individual and group psychotherapy, supportive psychotherapy, Cognitive Behavior Therapy (CBT), Solution Focused Behavior therapy (SFBT), Mindfulness Based Therapy, and behavior Therapy to manage anxiety, Sleep problems, Procrastination, depression, relationship problems, academic difficulties, addiction to substances as well as Smartphone and Internet addictions. Positive psychological techniques are also offered to improve self confidence, personality, problem solving and decision making, self-esteem and mental health.
Wellness Centre
We at SRM believe that there is a triad to a healthy lifestyle. That is "perfect medication, a healthy diet that does not spike one's blood sugar and a moderate, consistent exercise program".  Through a collaboration with doctors and dieticians, the wellness center, gives wellness and fitness routines to clients based on their level of fitness, aliments, and age. The wellness center believes wellness is an act to practice healthy habits on a daily basis, to attain better physical and mental health, and lead to a healthier lifestyle.
The School of Public Health (SPH)
The  School of Public Health (SPH) aims to create public health leaders through interdisciplinary education and research. The University Wellness Program (UWP) launched by SPH aims to achieve wellness of all students on campus. We look at factors that affect students’ wellbeing and ways to address them.

Muthucharam
About Muthucharam
Muthucharam Community Radio, operating at the frequency of 90.4 Mhz, has been established inside the SRM University campus to serve the source of the people in the coverage area. The programs focus on education, health, environment, agriculture, rural and community development. Today, this has become the pulse of the community, which serves to create an informed, educated and a confident community. The format, presentation, language and subject will reflect and project the local flavour and fragrance. The members of the community, who frequently take part in the production of shows, fulfill the objective of improving lives and thoughts of target audience and provide to their specific interests and demands.
Broadcasting Schedule
Coverage
Muthucharam Community Radio operates at the frequency of 90.4 MHz, loud and clear to all the users in the coverage area
Programs
Muthucharam Community Radio broadcasts a plethora of programs, including Nalamai Vazhvom, Therindhu Kolvom and a lot more.
Our Team

Reducing recombination losses in planar organic photovoltaic cells using multiple step charge separation
T. D. Heidel
, D. Hochbaum
, J. M. Sussman
, V. Singh
, M. E. Bahlke
, I. Hiromi
, J. Lee
, and M. A. Baldo
Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Cambridge, Massachusetts 02139, USA.
Department of Material Science and Engineering, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Cambridge, Massachusetts 02139, USA.
(Received 1 February 2011; accepted 30 March 2011; published online 16 May 2011)
Abstract: We enhance the efficiency of heterojunction organic solar cells by introducing a thin interfacial layer between the acceptor and donor layers. The interfacial layer energy levels are chosen to provide a gradient for charges crossing the interface, approximating a conventional p-n junction with three organic semiconductors. Devices with interfacial layers exhibit increased open circuit voltage (Voc) and increased short circuit current (Jsc). The increase in Voc is due to a reduction in dark current and charge recombination. The increase in Jsc is correlated with an increase in the conversion efficiency of excitons originating in the donor or acceptor layers. The interfacial layer destabilizes charge transfer states at the donor-acceptor interface, yielding reduced exciton recombination. The introduction of thin interfacial layers may prove to be an important probe of the physics of exciton separation in organic photovoltaic cells. VC 2011 American Institute of Physics.

Life at SRM
Arts & Culture
Arts & Culture
It’s our firm belief at SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University), that to enhance the skills of our students, they must be provided with opportunities to explore their creativity. Cultural programs are organized several times during the year to encourage creative pursuits and nurture talent. Students form teams and share responsibility in organizing the events.
Milan
A four-day national-level inter-college cultural festival, characterized by a footfall of 50,000+ students, encompasses a diverse array of over 100 competitions and high-caliber pro shows, including DJ nights, live music performances, and comedy nights featuring top-tier artists. This event draws participants from various states and districts, fostering a rich exchange of talent and cultural diversity.
2020
2019
2018
Shuru
Shuru is a talent hunt festival organized by the Directorate of Student Affairs, featuring a range of competitions in various cultural art forms, including dance, music, creative arts, dramatics, fashion etc, specifically designed for first-year students from all departments. Additionally, the event includes host performances by clubs to enhance the entertainment experience for newcomers.
2020
2019
Jhalak
Jhalak is an intracollege cultural event where students from diverse academic departments within the university showcase their talents. This event features participation from eight distinct houses, namely Agni, Astra, Brahmos, Nag, Prithvi, Aakash, Shaurya, and Trishul, who compete in various cultural activities.
2023
2018
Rendezvous
Rendezvous is a club showcase event, representing approximately 16 diverse clubs encompassing areas such as dance, music, fashion, and dramatics. This event is dedicated to welcoming and engaging new students and is conducted by the Directorate of Student Affairs.
2023
Ace
ACE is a talent hunt festival organized by the Directorate of Student Affairs, featuring a range of Sports events like Cricket, Football, Badminton, Table Tennis, etc, specifically designed for first-year students from all departments.
Josh
The Directorate of Student Affairs arranged JOSH’23, a cultural event for both teaching and non-teaching staff, with a participation of 450+ individuals.
Butterflies
Butterflies, an altruistic undertaking by the Directorate of Student Affairs seeks to instill inspiration and motivation in underprivileged children regarding education. This initiative offers a platform for students from government schools to exhibit their skills in sports, culture, literature, and more. It’s a day brimming with enjoyable activities, competitions, and rewards, with approximately 500 students taking part every year .
Khel
Khel is an Intra college sports event where students from diverse academic departments within the university showcase their talents. This event features participation from eight distinct houses, namely Agni, Astra, Brahmos, Nag, Prithvi, Aakash, Shaurya, and Trishul.
Celebrations
All major Indian festivals are celebrated in the campus with complete enthusiasm and enjoyment. Lushing lunches are explicitly made in students’ hostels to mark these festivities and to give the students a taste of the region’s culinary traditions.

About SRMCAS
SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST) established the Faculty of Agricultural Sciences at Main campus, Kattankulathur by starting B.Sc. (Hons.) Horticulture degree program in 2018 and B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture degree program in 2019 which was approved by the Board of Mangement. Later, in 2021 the Faculty of Agricultural Sciences was shifted to Baburayanpettai, Chengalpattu District and started functioning as SRM College of Agricultural Sciences (SRMCAS) in an area of 400+ acres, which is 68 km from the Main campus SRMIST, Kattankulathur, by covering the urban, semi-urban, and rural areas.

Empower younger generation in quality agricultural education to learn cutting – edge farming technologies to address the needs of different stakeholders viz., farmers, employers, industries and society.
Strengthen higher education in Agriculture/Horticulture on par with international standards for innovative research, teaching and extension
Promote advanced technologies including Artificial Intelligence, Hi-tech Agriculture/Horticulture, digital agriculture, climate smart farming to ensure sustainability in production and productivity
Effectively transfer technology from lab to land to ensure water and food security, augment farmers income and standard of living of the farming community
Dr. M. Jawaharlal
Dean
Welcome message
The overall mission of the College of Agricultural Sciences is to provide knowledge and support for teaching, conducting research and capacity-building on the principles and practices for climate-smart, sustainable agriculture to produce healthy food with higher factor productivity and livelihood security. It is with a sense of commitment that our Founder & Chancellor Dr. T R Paarivendhar has personally seen to it that we empower and benefit farm community and food sector at large through extension research, pedagogy that engages students and researchers with on-field experience and lab facilities par excellence to generate pathbreaking interventions.
–> Chairs/Deans and HoDs
Programs Offered
Undergraduate
The Undergraduate programs impart students with mastery in the diverse fields of Agricultural & Horticulture
Postgraduate
The Postgraduate programs equip students with advanced knowledge and expertise across diverse fields of Agriculture and Horticulture.
Ph.D
The Ph.D. programs empower students with advanced research expertise across diverse fields of Agriculture and Horticulture.

Placements
Career Centre Is The Center Point Of Career Development, Interpersonal Skills And Placement Activities. The Placement Cell Of SRM College Of Agricultural Sciences Comes Under The Umbrella Of Career Centre SRM IST At Kattankulathur, Chennai. The Career Centre Is A Target Recruiting Ground For All Major Recruiters And Has Strong Linkages With The Industry And Is Highly Regarded By Employers. The Placement Cell Provides Various Platforms For The Industry And Institute To Collaborate With Each Other For Mutual Benefit. The Excellent Infrastructure In The Placement Cell Of SRM CAS Facilitates The Recruitment Activities Like Preplacement Talks, Written Tests, Group Discussions, And Interviews As Per The Requirements Of The Recruiting Organizations.
It Is Our Prime Focus To Make All Our Students Industry-Ready. The Placement Cell Of SRM CAS Plays A Vital Role In Making SRM A Favoured Destination For Many Organizations To Recruit Fresh Talent Nurtured At The Institute.  The Career Centre Besides, Placement And Training Holds Workshops, Events, Conferences, Talks By Experts, Internships, And Industrial Visits To Enable Students To Be Up-To-Date With Contemporary Trends And Be ‘Market Ready’ By The Time Of Graduation. The Holistic Development Of The Students Makes SRM Graduates Stand Apart. We Are Passionate About Grooming The Students Not Only As Efficient Professionals But Also As Responsible Citizens.

Future focus
Agroecology
Agroecology is an integrated approach that simultaneously applies ecological and social concepts and principles to the design and management of food and agricultural systems. It seeks to optimize the interactions between plants, animals, humans and the environment while taking into consideration the social aspects that need to be addressed for a sustainable and fair food system. More recently, agroecology has entered the discourse of international and UN institutions. Realizing the importance of the subject SRMIST has included agroecology in the curriculum of the UG programmes in Agriculture and Horticulture. A new course “Introduction to Agroecology” has been introduced for both horticulture and agriculture programmes for the first time in India.
Crop Health
A new division of Crop Health is being introduced wherein, the following subjects are brought under: Plant Biochemistry, Crop Physiology, Agricultural Entomology, Plant Pathology, Soil Fertility and Weed Management which are related to the well-being and growth of the crops.
Infrastructure & Facilities
SRM Institute of Science and Technology has been consistent to maintain excellence in the academic standard since its inception. Learning is an Enjoyable experience here, with experienced Faculty, Inspiring Libraries and Stimulating discussion rooms, Large Playgrounds and State-of-the-art Labs.

In the Words of Our Founder & Chancellor
We can’t predict the future, but we can ensure that our students become the most knowledgeable leaders, capable of making a difference, and creatively and skillfully guiding the next century of progress and excellence.
Vision
To emerge as a world-class university in creating and disseminating knowledge and providing students with a unique learning experience in science, technology, medicine, management, and other areas of scholarship that will best serve the world and the betterment of mankind.
Mission
TO MOVE UP through international alliances and collaborative initiatives to achieve global excellence.
TO ACCOMPLISH A PROCESS that advances knowledge in a rigorous academic and research environment.
TO ATTRACT AND BUILD A COMMUNITY in a rewarding and inspiring environment by fostering freedom, empowerment, creativity, and innovation.
More on FSH
Dr. A. Duraisamy
Dean, Science and Humanities
Dean's Message
I am delighted to share some of the highlights of the Faculty of Science and Humanities (FSH) at SRMIST, Kattankulathur. Since its inception in 2003, FSH has blossomed into a vibrant bastion of erudition and scholarly pursuit, epitomizing an unwavering dedication to excellence and ingenuity.
With a formidable array of 24 departments, a flourishing student body of 6000 plus, a cadre of 200 devoted faculty members, and 180 esteemed research scholars, FSH stands as a monument to our collective quest for knowledge and scholarly rigor. Our interdisciplinary ethos promotes an ambiance where myriad perspectives converge, fostering not only intellectual growth but also the nurturing of environmental consciousness.
Central to our principles at FSH is the veneration of mutual respect, where we recognize and celebrate the intrinsic worth that each member of our community brings. This value infuses our interactions, engendering a culture of inclusivity and collaborative endeavor.
A primary tenet of our mission is to equip our students with the requisite skills to navigate the tumultuous seas of an ever-evolving world. To this noble end, we offer specialized courses in fields such as entrepreneurship, coding, and strategic studies. Our fervent emphasis on skill cultivation ensures that our graduates emerge poised to surmount the challenges that lie ahead.
Of particular pride to us are our distinctive programs, notably those in Commerce, Computer Applications, Media, Biotechnology, Economics, Psychology, Fashion Designing, Literature, Social Work, Defence, and Strategic Studies, alongside our laudable efforts in Disaster Management. These ventures underscore our steadfast commitment to confronting global exigencies and advancing the frontiers of knowledge in these pivotal domains.
The Faculty of Science and Humanities at SRMIST stands as a beacon of scholarly distinction and intellectual fervour. With unwavering dedication and a steadfast commitment to excellence, we shall continue to chart new horizons and make indelible contributions to the realm of academia and beyond.
Welcome to FSH, SRMIST – KTR
Dean FSH
Meet our Chairs & Deans
Meet our Chairs & Deans
Explore our Programs
Students seeking interdisciplinary programs and flexibility in course curriculum will find precisely that at SRMIST. The structure of programs is meticulously crafted in accordance with recommendations, guidelines, and directives from esteemed bodies such as the National Knowledge Commission and the University Grants Commission (UGC). These structures are built upon:
(a) The Outcome-Based Education Framework (OBE), and
(b) Evaluation Reforms in Higher Education Institutions in India.
The Learning Outcome-Centric Framework (LOCF) is devised to ensure that a defined set of learning outcomes is attained, thereby enhancing employability and providing avenues for further education and research. SRMIST upholds exemplary practices such as fostering enhanced learning and research capabilities through:
(a) Critical Thinking
(b) Problem Solving
(c) Analytical Reasoning
(d) Scientific Reasoning
(e) Reflective Thinking
(f) Design Thinking
(g) Team Work
(h) Self-Directed Learning
(i) Lifelong Learning
These elements are seamlessly integrated into the curricula, reflecting SRMIST’s commitment to holistic education and skill development.

The Faculty of Science & Humanities (FSH) at SRMIST, Kattankulathur, is dedicated to providing an exceptional learning experience that empowers students to excel. Our commitment to Teaching & Learning Excellence is reflected in several key aspects:
Evolving Curriculum:
We offer a well-designed curriculum that keeps pace with the latest advancements in science and humanities. This ensures students acquire the most relevant knowledge and skills for their chosen fields.
Faculty Development:
Our faculty are continuously supported in their professional growth. We provide opportunities for them to develop new teaching methods, stay updated on recent discoveries, and integrate innovative practices into their classrooms.
Resource-Rich Environment:
Students have access to a wealth of resources to enhance their learning. This includes well-equipped laboratories, a modern computer lab, and a comprehensive library with a vast collection of books, journals, and online databases.
Collaborative Learning:
We foster a collaborative learning environment that encourages active participation, critical thinking, and peer-to-peer interaction. This approach not only deepens understanding but also hones communication and teamwork skills.

FSH bridges the gap between academia and industry. We collaborate with leading companies to offer internship and placement opportunities, ensuring our graduates are well-prepared for successful careers

About College of Pharmacy
SRM College of Pharmacy, SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University), Kattankulattur is one of the premier institutions for pharmaceutical education and research in the country. The college was started in the year 1992 affiliated to the Tamil Nadu Dr.M.G.R. Medical University and was later brought under the ambit of SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University) in 2005. The College offers B.Pharm, M.Pharm. (Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Analysis, Pharmaceutics, Pharmacology, Pharmacognosy, Pharmacy Practice, Pharmaceutical Quality Assurance and Pharmaceutical Regulatory affairs), PhD and Pharm.D and Pharm.D (Post baccalaureate) courses. The programs of the College are approved by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI) New Delhi.
SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University) offers great opportunities in skilled pharmacists in pharmaceutical industries and health care MNC’s both in India and abroad. It is one of the leading institutions in India with an exceptional curriculum designed to prepare quality pharmacists with professional capabilities so as to reach great heights in the ratios healthcare system. The pharmacist of 21st century possess a significant role in managing drug therapy, counselling patients on proper use of medications and monitoring drug therapy outcomes for which the new Pharm.D program prepares the students.
The faculty and staff are the pride of SRMCP, who by their expertise teach and promote the learning process and also serve as an inspiration to the students to their research activities. They mould the student community into the outstanding professional by the advanced teaching techniques and learning aids. The college is vested with state-of-the-art infrastructure and provides top-notch facilities to the budding pharmacists.
The programme is supplemented by a refreshing breath of co-curricular and extra-curricular activities to ensure that the students acquire personality excellence and leadership qualities in addition to the technical expertise, which are vital to excel in a competitive world.

Home
Medicine & Health Sciences
Excellence in Medical Education
The SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre is situated on the NH 45 GST road at Potheri between Tambaram and Chengalpattu in a sprawling 33.61-acre campus. The proximity of the Medical College Hospital campus to other Institutions of the SRM Institute of Science and Technology namely Engineering, Management, Dental, Arts & Science and Biotechnology is strategic in facilitating collaborative research.
Mission
To make available preventive, curative, and rehabilitative medical care to everyone at minimal cost
To teach clinical skills to medical and health science graduates and post graduates while performing focused clinical research for ‘Bench to Bedside’ application
Medical College and Hospital Research Centre
Pro Vice-Chancellor (Medical)
Pro VC's Message
The medical world is full of miracles. But behind every medical miracle lie the keen eyes and the steady hands of a medical professional. Here, at the SRM Medical & Health Sciences Faculty, you will constantly push the limits, exploring new ways to combat diseases and life threatening ailments. As a medical student, you will need to build a solid foundation while also staying in tune with the latest medical trends.
SRM’s Medical & Health Sciences Faculty consists of a variety of specialized departments. Each has its own library along with a laboratory and a museum. One of the few institutions to have a full-fledged multi-specialty hospital on campus, the faculty equips you with the latest and best tools for providing primary, secondary and tertiary care.
I extend a warm welcome to SRM Medical & Health Sciences.
Meet our Chairs & Deans
Meet our Chairs & Deans
Explore our Programs
Students seeking inter-disciplinary programmes and flexibility in course curriculum will find just that at SRMIST. A student shall have an option of choosing any one of the following pathways
(i) Major
(ii) Major with Specialization
(iii) Major with Minor or Major with specialization and a Minor
The core philosophy that is practiced in SRMIST as part of teaching-learning process is Inter Disciplinary Experiential Active Learning (IDEAL)

Programs Offered
We provide treatments across 52 departments including Superspeciality departments like Cardiology, Nephrology, Urology, Neurosurgery etc. It is the largest hospital in Chengalpattu district and can serve over 3,00,000 in and around Kattankulanthur. The hospital is a brilliant platform to change the world for better by offering excellent treatment while improving the careers of our healthcare experts.

Medicine
SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre (SRM MCHRC) offers a plethora of opportunities to climb the career ladder as well as to change this world to better healthier providing the sophisticated treatment.
Dentistry
SRM Kattankulathur Dental College and Hospital consists of various departments such as Dental Surgery, Community Dentistry, Oral Pathology and more.
Pharmacy
The college is vested with state of the art infrastructure and provides top-notch facilities to the budding pharmacists.
Physiotherapy
The College of Physiotherapy has an experienced faculty team that specializes in orthopaedics, sports physiotherapy, neurology, paediatric neurology, biomechanics, cardiorespiratory, hand rehabilitation, community rehabilitation, and obstetrics and gynaecology.
Occupational Therapy
The college has well-equipped clinics and learning aids for undergraduates and state of the art research facilities for postgraduate students.
Nursing

Research
The environment necessary to making teaching and learning a seamless, enjoyable and productive venture requires all the aids, facilities and infrastructure. At SRMIST, our students, scholars and faculty members get best resources and infrastructure.
The infrastructure facilities are quite commendable and a computer laboratory with more than 600 computers, a Biotech lab with sophisticated instruments, a visual studio, editing and dubbing suites and a preview theatre are all made available to our students cutting across disciplines.
Our students and scholars have an opportunity to benefit from a uniquely productive learning ambience at SRMIST. Students are exposed to such a wide ranging multi disciplinary learning & research facilities and infrastructure that helps them attain an integrated educational experience.

National Cadet Corps (NCC)
The objective of National Cadet Corps is to develop character, comradeship, and capacity for leadership among youth in India.
Home
National Cadet Corps (NCC)
NCC Overview
The objective of the National Cadet Corps is to develop character, comradeship, and capacity for leadership among youth in India. NCC at SRM motivates the students with the best training and the ideals of selfless service. The training inculcates team spirit, a sense of nationalism, and it also helps in developing the overall personality of an individual.
The organization is under the command of
Col. Prof. C. Muthamizchelvan
, Vice Chancellor of SRMIST.
The SRM NCC Senior Division (SD) Army Wing was established in August 1998, followed by the Senior Wing (SW) in 2005. The sub-unit of SRMIST is affiliated with the 1 (TN) Signal Company NCC, Madras Group ‘A’, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry & Andaman and Nicobar Directorate.
The SRM NCC Navy Wing for both Senior Division and Senior Wing was established in 2021. This sub-unit of SRMIST is affiliated with the 4 (TN) Naval Technical Unit, Madras Group ‘B’, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry & Andaman and Nicobar Directorate.
Meet Our Officers
Meet Our Senior Under Officers
Achievements
Announcements
Aims Of NCC
To Develop Character, Comradeship, Discipline, Leadership, Secular Outlook, Spirit of Adventure, and Ideals of Selfless Service amongst the Youth of the Country.
To Create a Human Resource of Organized, Trained and Motivated Youth, To Provide Leadership in all Walks of life and be Always Available for the Service of the Nation.
To Provide a Suitable Environment to Motivate the Youth to Take Up a Career in the Armed Forces.
Objectives Of NCC
To fulfill the requirements expected in the latest socio-economic scenario in India.
To develop character, discipline, comradeship, secular outlook, ideals of selfless services and adventure spirits amongst large numbers of young citizens.
To create a pool of trained, organized and motivated youth with various leadership qualities in every walk of their life and serve the Nation irrespective of the career they choose.
To provide a sound environment conducive towards motivating large numbers of young people of India to join armed forces.
Orientation 2024
The National Cadet Corps (NCC) at SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST) usually holds an orientation program to introduce new cadets to the NCC’s objectives, rules, and activities. The orientation covers key areas such as leadership development, discipline, physical fitness, national service, and the benefits of NCC enrollment.
During the event, cadets are informed about the NCC’s training schedule, the different camps and certificates they can pursue (A, B, and C Certificates), and how it can enhance their academic and career prospects. Senior officers or NCC alumni often share their experiences to motivate new cadets.

title: SRMIST Athletes Shine at Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026 with 5 Medals for India - SRMIST
content:
SRMIST Athletes Shine at Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026 with 5 Medals for India - SRMIST
Skip to content
SRMIST Athletes Shine at Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026 with 5 Medals for India
Home
SRMIST Athletes Shine at Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026 with 5 Medals for India
SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST) athletes made their mark on the international stage at the 20th Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026, held in Japan from 19 September to 4 October 2026. Representing India in archery, squash and sailing, the athletes secured a combined tally of five medals – one Gold and four Bronze – highlighting their achievements across three sporting disciplines.
Thirumuru Ganesh Mani Ratnam, a III-BCA (Data Science) student, led the medal tally with Gold in the Compound Men’s Team event and Bronze in the Compound Individual event. Shameena Riaz, a II-B.Tech ECE student at the Vadapalani Campus, earned Bronze in Women’s Squash. Nethra Kumanan, an SRMIST MBA alumna from the 2023 batch, secured Bronze in the Women’s ILCA 6 sailing event.

The performances represent the culmination of years of preparation, competitive experience and commitment to their respective disciplines. Competing at the Asian Games places athletes among the leading sporting talents from across the continent, making these podium finishes significant milestones in their careers.
The
Directorate of Sports
at SRMIST plays an important role in fostering sporting talent and encouraging students to pursue competitive excellence alongside their academic goals. The achievements of current students and an alumna at this international event also demonstrate the lasting impact of the institution’s sporting environment.
These medals bring the vision of the Honourable Founder Chancellor closer to reality, with SRMIST athletes representing India and achieving podium finishes at one of Asia’s major multi-sport events. Their performances stand as a source of pride for the university community and an inspiration to aspiring athletes preparing to compete at national and international levels.

content:
Getting Around & Campus Safety | Life at SRM - SRMIST
Skip to content
Getting around & Safety
Home
Life at SRM
Getting Around & Campus Safety
Getting around & Safety
Our Leadership’s vision is to ensure top quality student life in a well maintained serene safe and secure campus. We constantly keep maintaining and improving the upkeep of our campus. It is the Leadership vision, support and our efforts that make SRMIST the best campus with lakes, greenery, bio-diversity and is a source of many wonderful memories and experiences for most of our students, staff, residents and visitors.
Policies - SRM Green Initiatives
Policy on Transportation Facility
Use of Bicycles
Barrier Free Environment
Ban on Plastic
Landscaping
Pedestrian Walkway Policy
Restricted Entry of Automobile
Serene Green campus
This sprawling 250+ acres has in its midst an old world charm on the one end (main campus) to the ultra modern buildings, gardens, lawns, sitout areas, cafes and walkways with trees on the either side giving a wonderful ambience to students and staff. The lakes around, gardens and greenery all around give a perfect balance to the life at SRMIST. Do visit our Campus here at Kattankulathur to get a first hand feel of our green campus!
Cycling across the campus
This is a delight to cyclists who not only gain good health but also find it absolutely relaxing to ride along the length and breadth of this campus. There are a variety of flora and fauna as well as roads named after inspiring personalities from across India and all over the world. While one is at it, don’t miss out on the blending of ancient with the modern as you see monolithic statutes of Raja Raja Chola, Swami Vivekananda, Mahatma Gandhi, Thiruvalluvar, Socrates, Anna, among others. The upcoming Vendhar Square will be a big attraction in the coming months!
Transport Facility
Such a vast campus does require our students and staff to move from one location to another and to enable easier transit, we have our SRM Coaches to the service. Not just within the campus, the transport facility is optional for students and faculty to come to the campus from Chennai and near by areas and get dropped back to their localities. We operate 100s of buses, AC and Non-AC buses, to ensure timely and convenient transit to and back from the campus.
Easy and Convenient Accessibility for All
The goal for SRMIST is to constantly review and invest in removing barriers to create an inclusive and accessible campus for all. Lack of easy access is the greatest road block that prevents empowerment of people with Disabilities (PwD). Barrier free environment enables the PwD to develop in the field of their interest. Towards this, SRMIST provides ramps, low floors in buses, elevators to reach classrooms and labs, Battery run cars, wheelchair friendly network, among others.
Safe & Enjoyable Housing Facilities
SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University) has housing facilities to meet the requirements of International, NRI and the Indian students. Each Hostel is self-contained with amenities such as a spacious room, a lounge and a dining hall with mess.
The quality of life is one of the most important factors considered by the students deciding to stay in the College/University hostels. By quality, it is not just the rooms but also the overall environment of the University campus.
SRM provides a comfortable and safe housing to all its students. The students housed in the campus are encouraged to use the gymnasium, playground, and all indoor gaming facilities.
The students staying at SRM hostels are provided with healthy and sumptuous food options at highly subsidized rates. They can choose to have North Indian or South Indian menu in the dining halls that are co-located. For the benefit of our international students, the hostels also offer a multi-cuisine dining facility providing Thai, Chinese and continental food.
Round the clock security
The Security Service of the Kattankulathur campus of SRM Institute of Science & Technology, which has a cluster of Institutions under different streams is secured with best in class security personnel and advanced surveillance and reporting mechanisms. The security and sanctity of the campus is handled by a qualified professional force operated under a senior chief security officer.

Complaints & Redressal
Student Grievance Redressal Committee (SGRC)
SRMIST has constituted a Committee for handling and solving the grievance to express constructive & genuine concerns/grievances. To promote and maintain a sustainable, unbiased & Positive Educational Environment. It involves a process of investigation in which ‘Student’s Grievance Redressal Committee’ enquires and analyses the nature and pattern of the grievances in a strictly confidential manner.
UGC Regulations, 2023 Definition
Grievance Redressal Cell
SRMIST has constituted a Cell for handling and solving the grievance to express constructive & genuine concerns/grievances.
Grievance Portal
Internal Committee
The committee’s primary responsibilities include handling complaints, conducting inquiries, and organizing gender sensitization programs. It operates in accordance with the UGC (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal of Sexual Harassment of Women Employees and Students in Higher Educational Institutions) Regulation, 2015. The ICC plays a crucial role in fostering a safe and inclusive environment for employees and students, ensuring that incidents of gender-based harassment are effectively addressed and prevented.
Internal Committee
Women's Grievance Redressal Committee
SRMIST established a Women’s Grievance Cell to address any grievances of the female students, staff, and faculty. We are committed to provide a fully confidential and supportive environment to all the female members of our campus community.

content:
Dual Degree | Outward Mobility - SRMIST
Skip to content
Dual Degree / Pathway Program
Home
International Relations
Outward Mobility
Dual Degree
A dual degree program involves a student working for two different university degrees in parallel, either at the same institution or at different institutions, may be in different countries, completing them in less time than it would take to earn them separately.  The two degrees might be in the same subject area or in two different subjects.  The dual degree concept is more popular in European Union, as the gaining of qualifications from more than one country is seen as an advantage in the European labour market.  India, after opening its higher education to private players, is seeing a growth in the dual degree programs with foreign universities.
Dual Degree programs allow
SRMIST
to offer Bachelors (UG) or Masters (PG) degree programs which will have their regular curricula. The existing curricula may be supplemented by additional curricula of the partnering universities if required. Dual Degree students will be charged the prevailing tuition by the partnering universities. Students who do not plan to go to the partnering universities and students who have been unable to get visas will complete their program of study in
SRMIST
, would be awarded degrees by SRMIST.
SRM  Academy  for International Program (AIP)  is designed to stimulate curiosity for and love for learning , which  widens  the  scope  of  educational opportunity and access  for  students.
SRMIST
works  closely  with leading universities around the world to offer an affordable way of getting an internationally recognised  qualification. In response  to enquiries from parents  and  students  across the country  for (i) Twining (Transfer)  Degree overseas (ii) Dual Degree overseas, AIP is well positioned  to offer such programs in collaboration with world’s best universities to provide students with skills necessary to be successful in the 21st century ans well as empower all students to be engaged citizens of the world.. The eligibility requirements are different for the regular programs.
Program Structure
The Dual  Degree is structured at undergraduate and  post graduate entry levels.
B.Tech and  MS
Students   enrolling   with SRMIST   for  B.Tech  will complete three years of study at SRMIST satisfying all credit requirements and apply during 3
year and go abroad to continue with our partnering university for fourth and fifth year to continue with their masters in the same university.  The credits of the fourth year studied at our partnering university are considered by SRMIST and SRMIST awards the B.Tech degree. Upon satisfying the credit requirements for the Masters degree of our partnering university the student also gets MS from the partnering university.
M.Tech and MS
This is structured as 1+1 program. For instance, students enrolling with SRM for M.Tech will complete one year of study at SRM satisfying all credit requirements and later go abroad for one more year.  Upon satisfying the credit requirements of both SRM and its partnering university for the Masters degree, mutual credit transfer is performed and the student gets M.Tech from SRM and MS / MSc from the partnering university.
Benefits
Besides shorter tenure for Masters Degree, Dual degree benefits students in many ways:
Unique opportunity to pursue part of Bachelors degree overseas
GRE / GMAT requirement is waived in some cases
Brightens the future with clear set goals even at entry level
Parents would have enough time to organize funds
The progress can be constantly reviewed to provide adequate support
Gaining one year for MS can result in additional income

Admission Procedure:
All students who are desirous of pursuing Dual degree must first enroll into an equivalent degree program of SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University) through the regular admission process of SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University). After enrolling in the regular degree program of SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University) the student must register, at the earliest, with the Office of International Relations for the Dual degree program. The Office of IR will counsel and guide the students in choosing the right university / program  that will meet their career objectives and affordability. Admission to the Bachelors (UG) / Masters (PG) Dual Degree Program is purely on merit based on academic performance at 12th Standard / equivalent and the third year of study at SRM, assessment of ambition and excitement level, good communication skills, good testimonials / credentials and right supportive family background.  A separate registration and application form for Dual degree program is available with the office of IR or can be downloaded from the website. To download Application
Click here
Though all efforts will be taken by office of IR to satisfy the choice of the university that the student desires to pursue the Dual degree, it is subject to acceptance by the hosting university and students meeting their admission criteria. In the unlikely scenario of the student not getting admission to the University of his / her choice then the student can continue in the degree program enrolled for at SRM and get degree from SRM. The Dual degree option is available under certain degree programs of the faculty of Engineering & Technology and Management.
Eligibility
Bachelors – Masters Dual Degree Program
Must maintain a minimum  CGPA of 8.0 out of 10 during the first three years of study at SRM
There must not be any backlogs of papers at the time of applying to the partnering university
Good Score in TOEFL at the time of applying to the partnering university
High ambition and excitement level and good communication skills with right supportive family background
Masters – Masters Dual Degree Program
A pass in the relevant degree or its equivalent with:
Minimum 80% aggregate at the Bachelors degree.
Must maintain a minimum  CGPA of 8.0 out of 10 during the first year of study at SRM
There must not be any backlogs of papers at the time of applying to the partnering university
Good Score in TOEFL at the time of applying to the partnering university
High ambition and excitement level and good communication skills with right supportive family background

National Service Scheme (NSS)
The ideals of Mahatma Gandhi provide inspiration for the NSS’s ideological stance.
“NOT ME, BUT YOU” is the NSS motto.
Home
National Service Scheme (NSS)
NSS Overview
National Service Scheme (NSS) is a widely recognized and influential youth-centric program in colleges across the country.  NSS was established in 1969, the year Mahatma Gandhi celebrated his birth, with the primary goal of fostering the character and personality of student youth via volunteer community service. The ideals of Mahatma Gandhi provide inspiration for the NSS’s ideological stance. “NOT ME, BUT YOU” is the NSS motto.
NSS was commissioned by SRM Institute of Science and Technology in 2003. The activities of the SRMIST NSS mainly focus on Community Development Services, Social Services, Environmental Awareness Programs, Health Awareness Programs and Technology Transfer Programs. The NSS at SRMIST has guidelines to conduct various Regular and Special Camping activities.
Apart from social activities, SRMIST NSS Cell offers NSS Course 21GNM102L to Engineering students during their first-year course of study. Every Semester around 800 students take up the course and gets benefitted.
Prof .T.  Lakshmanan
Advisor /  NSS CELL
nsscell@srmist.edu.in
Advisor's Message
As the Advisor of the NSS Cell, I take this opportunity to share some important information and updates regarding our activities and initiatives.
The NSS is a platform that encourages civic involvement, social responsibility, and personal growth among our students. We firmly believe in the ability of service to effect holistic transformation. We work to improve the world for everyone as a group.
We regularly engage in activities and programs designed to address a range of social concerns and improve the well-being of our communities. These programs include a wide range of topics, such as efforts to promote good health and hygiene, educational support programs, and environmental conservation activities. Serving the community benefits people in need while also fostering leadership potential, social responsibility, and Personal development among the students.
The Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports GOI’s National level training and development programmes are another thing I strongly advise you to utilize. These programs are designed to improve your abilities, broaden your knowledge, improve your communication skills, open up your uniqueness towards servicing the society.
I would like to remind everyone to stay in touch with our NSS team so they can be informed of the most recent news, activities, and volunteer opportunities. Our dedicated team is here to support you and provide guidance throughout your journey with the NSS.
Small acts of kindness can ignite a flame of change in our communities. Together, let’s be the spark that lights up lives and creates a brighter future for all.
NSS Programme Officers
NSS Course Faculty
NSS Annual Reports
NSS Course - Activity Book
Activities and Initiatives
Achievements
Events
Dr. Prakash V
Programme  Coordinator /  NSS CELL
nsscell@srmist.edu.in
Coordinator's Message
National Service Scheme (NSS) is a voluntary organization for young students that plays a crucial role in shaping character and fostering social responsibility to serve society without bias. It aims to inculcate social welfare in students, and through community services, it helps in building their personality. By engaging in various community service activities, NSS aims to instill a sense of empathy, compassion, and commitment to social welfare among students.
Overall, the diverse range of regular activities undertaken by NSS volunteers demonstrates their unwavering commitment to serving the community and making a positive impact on society, contributing to building a better world for all.
NSS volunteers work to provide help in natural and man-made disasters by supplying food, clothing, and first aid training programmes, arrange blood donation camps to fulfil the shortage of blood requirements in hospitals, engage in tree plantation to protect the environment and save Mother Earth, participate in cleanliness campaigns for hygiene and a healthy life, conduct road safety awareness campaigns to reduce road accidents, and organize street plays and awareness campaigns to save the girl child and educate her etc.
NSS Special Camps serve as transformative experiences that not only broaden volunteers’ perspectives but also equip them with essential life skills and values. By immersing themselves in rural communities and actively engaging in service-oriented activities, volunteers emerge with a heightened sense of social responsibility and a deeper understanding of the principles of value education.
With all the experiences from NSS, I am sure that volunteers will learn how to lead a life of dignity with a positive mindset. NSS provides volunteers with a transformative experience that not only enhances their personal growth and sense of responsibility but also equips them with the skills and values needed to contribute meaningfully to the nation’s development. By fostering a culture of service, leadership, and citizenship, NSS empowers volunteers to lead lives of dignity and make lasting contributions to the progress and prosperity of their country.
with Warm Regards,
Dr. Prakash V
Motto of NSS
The Motto of NSS “Not Me But You”, reflects the essence of democratic living and upholds the need for self-less service. NSS helps the students development & appreciation to other person’s point of view and also show consideration towards other living beings. The philosophy of the NSS is a good doctrine in this motto, which underlines on the belief that the welfare of an individual is ultimately dependent on the welfare of the society as a whole and therefore, the NSS volunteers shall strive for the well-being of the society.
Objectives of NSS
The SRMIST NSS programme in colleges operates with a set of well-defined objectives. These include:
Community Service
: Encouraging students to actively engage in community service activities, addressing social issues such as education, healthcare, environmental conservation, rural development, and more.
Personality Development
: Providing a platform for students to develop leadership skills, enhance interpersonal communication, and build a strong ethical foundation through various training programs and workshops.
Empathy and Social Awareness
: Promoting a sense of empathy, compassion, and understanding towards the needs and challenges faced by marginalized sections of society, encouraging students to become responsible citizens.

SRM Global Immersion Program
Home
International Relations
SRM Global Immersion Program
Understanding the Challenges of Developing Country: Culture, Identity and Development
Global Immersion Program facilitates direct contact with the culture of the host country. Through a series of activities, participants will be able to find commonalities through shared experiences. The SRM IST Global Immersion is designed to promote, albeit in a small way, understanding and, eventually, a better world.
The SRM Global Immersion delivered by India’s No 1 multi stream university, located near the ancient and historic city of Chennai( previously known as Madras), in the state of Tamil Nadu, builds on a legacy of previous short term immersion programmes delivered to students from the UK, Singapore, Indonesia and South Korea.
The 2 week programme
The 2 week programme will involve a combination of the following:
Learning a local language for conversational purposes , and understand how language and culture are inextricably linked
Learn about local culture, customs, religion and why cultural identity is important and how it gives identity to the country and its people.
Exploring cultural and historical sites such as the Pallava Dynasty Mahabalipuram, and taking part in exciting cultural activities, ancient temples, and the city of Chennai which was the base for the establishment of the British East India Company that led to Britain’s colonization of India
Giving back to the community teaching English and Science to children in a rural school
Learning how to evaluate the socio-economic needs of a local village to design appropriate technology tools for local solutions, eg drinking water, sanitation, pollution control, etc
Learn about the University’s Entrepreneurship Program, being run in partnership with the University of California, Berkeley, and equip yourself with the cultural knowledge and skills needed to succeed in the emerging Indian industry.
Visit an Agricultural Farm and learn about the agricultural practices being adopted , in a country where over 70 % of the country lives in rural areas, with Agriculture forming the backbone of the industry
Accommodation, meals, and all in-country transport are included, so you can focus on making the most of this unique experience.

content:
Public Service | Life at SRM - SRMIST
Skip to content
Public Service
There are many opportunities at SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University) for students to engage in service to the community – through healthcare camps, blood donation, advocacy campaigns or working with schools for the underprivileged.
Students are encouraged to take up community service through NSS or join any of the community service projects, to give back to the community.
Home
Life at SRM
Public Service
Public Service and Activities
Vast number of opportunities are made available at SRM Institute of Science and Technology for students and staff to engage in service to the community and country. Any service minded person would have avenues to learn, toil and create impact and make lives better for the less fortunate as well as develop a sense of responsibility towards nation building. Some of these opportunities that exist are through healthcare camps, blood donation, advocacy campaigns or working with schools for the underprivileged, NSS, NCC among others.
National Service Scheme (NSS)
The NSS unit at SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University) has more than 1000 registered students.
The NSS volunteers at SRM are involved in a wide spectrum of activities such as
Social service – the community around the campus
Planting trees
Conducting health camps in rural areas
Organizing blood donation camps
Advocacy on community health Creating AIDs awareness, helping NGOs to raise sponsorship and funds
The NSS unit also adopts government schools in Chengalpattu district and works closely with the school authorities and students.
Know More
National Cadet Corps (NCC)
The objective of National Cadet Corps is to develop character, comradeship, and capacity for leadership among youth in India. NCC at SRM motivates the students with best training and the ideals of selfless service. The training inculcates team spirit, a sense of nationalism and it also helps in developing the overall personality of an individual. The SRM NCC (Senior Division-SD) under 1 (Tamil Nadu) Signal Company NCC [1 (TN) SIG COY NCC] was started in August 1996. The first and the second year students are enrolled for the duration of three years. We also enroll girls in the NCC since 2005 and the total allotted strength including girls is 83. The Obstacle Area was established in the year 2009 to train the cadets. NCC parades are regularly conducted in Dr. T. P. Ganesan Auditorium Ground on every Saturday from 7.00 to 11.00 AM as per Parade Schedule. Pre-parade meeting is also conducted in front of the NCC Office on every Friday from 5.30 to 6.30 PM
The NCC cadets actively participate in the Independence Day and Republic Day celebration in the campus. Annual Training Camp, Republic Day Camp (RDC – New Delhi), Inter Group Competitions (IGC), National Integration Camp (NIC) and special camps like Trekking Camp, Firing Camp are held periodically. The NCC cadets also get the opportunity to visit various countries like Singapore, Srilanka, Bangladesh, Maldives and Taiwan through Youth Exchange Program (YEP) to represent our country. SRM NCC cadets also organize social service events like Anti – Drug Rally, Blood Donation Camp, Anti – Plastic Rally, visiting orphanages and old age homes and creating awareness among the public regarding Consumer Awareness, Cancer & AIDS awareness, etc. The Cadets are encouraged to complete “B” and “C” certificate examinations and to join in Defense Services like Army, Navy and Airforce.

About Us
About the College
SRM Kattankulathur Dental College and Hospital, which is located within the secure and high-tech campus of the SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University), is the renowned dental college under the SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly known as SRM University) banner.
Started in 2007 with an annual intake of 100 BDS students, we have now grown into a very successful postgraduate institution. Accredited with an A++ grade by the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC), SRM Kattankulathur Dental College and Hospital is placed in category ‘1’ by the Ministry of Human Resource Development.
One of the most trusted dental schools in the country, with UG/PG courses recognized by the Dental Council of India. Ranked among the country’s finest dental schools with state-of-the-art infrastructure and research facilities, it started in 2007 for undergraduates and in 2014 for the postgraduate course.
The annual intake of 100 BDS students through a transparent admission process: NEET ELIGIBLE CANDIDATES REGISTERED THROUGH DGHS (www.mcc.nic.in) SRM Kattankulathur Dental College and Hospital is an extremely successful postgraduate institution with MDS courses in six specialties of dentistry.
